title: Kannika Massage
address: 717 19 Charoen Krung 30, Sipraya Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

reviews.name: Annie Dullum
reviews.text: Great decision to stop here on our way to our hotel for a massage. They are trained and great massage therapists. Marina asked where my pain was and I walked out with my feet and back feeling so much better. Thank you! I hope to return soon.

reviews.name: peter lam
reviews.text:
If you have a leg fetish this is the place to be. After an half hour rubbing my leg a my foot for 3 min a was done here and walked out.
The worst massage in my life. And still had to pay the whole hour.

reviews.name: Andrew Hampton
reviews.text:
Reasonably good massage and clean and presentable shop. This massage house is lady and ladyboy massage so preferences are available but I didn't like being asked about extra services two minutes into the massage.
There is no number for advance appointments.
Decided to give the shop a second chance. Sadly I was met by surly staff, attached to mobile phones, who simply had no enthusiasm for the service they offer.
There is a row of massage shops on this road, near River City, all overpriced and staff strangely docile staff. These shops also seem to have no customers . . . I wonder why??

reviews.name: Daniel Araki
reviews.text: Me and some friends had great massages here for a really good price. The staff is very friendly and worked well. It's not super upscale, but they do give you a water at the end, which is nice. If you want a no frills massage it is a true bargain. My friends came back for another the following day, and I would go again as well.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you krub

reviews.name: Allison Erwin
reviews.text: Amazing foot massage!  The therapists are very skilled, found all the tight spots and my feet, ankles, calves and even lower quads/above the knees were all worked. They feel so good now.

reviews.name: Safazzaro
reviews.text: Once I visited to this spa in 2019 December. I got a nice ladyboy staff and best service.. this place is very clean and neat

reviews.name: Vadym Topalov
reviews.text: Skillfull massase, comfortable chairs

reviews.name: visay chaigam
reviews.text: Very nice, very clean, very comfortable and services excellent

reviews.name: Vip Jacht Solina
reviews.text: W trakcie masażu obsługa bawi się telefonem. Nie ma ucisku tylko wcieranie olejku. Nie warto. Zimno. Cena 450 Oil.
reviews.textTranslated: During the massage, the staff plays with their phones. There's no pressure, just oil rubbing in. Not worth it. Cold. Price: 450 Oil.

reviews.name: Jin joo Lee
reviews.text:
감기가걸렸는지 어찌나 기침을 하던지
마스크는 기본아닌가여? 마스크도 안끼고 그렇게 기침을 하면 난 어떻하라고
그리고 기침을 하도해서 마사지가 아예 안됨
마사지 기술도 없는거 같고 다신안감
reviews.textTranslated:
They were coughing so much, I wonder if they had a cold.

Isn't wearing a mask a basic necessity? If they cough like that without even wearing a mask, what am I supposed to do?

Also, they coughed so much that I couldn't get a massage at all.

It seems like they don't have any massage skills, and I'm never going back.

reviews.name: H L
reviews.text: 爛透了，一小時油壓只按30分鐘，又不知道在按什麼，還收超過一半的費用。
reviews.textTranslated: It's awful. They only press the hydraulic pump for 30 minutes out of an hour, and I don't even know what they're pressing, yet they charge more than half the price.

reviews.name: 戸田和宏
reviews.text:
マッサージ屋さんです。
付近にたくさんマッサージ屋さんがあるので、比較するのが大変です。
reviews.textTranslated:
It's a massage parlor.

There are many massage parlors in the area, so it's difficult to compare them.

reviews.name: sかおり
reviews.text: 施術中に携帯触るだけのやる気のないレディボーイ
reviews.textTranslated: A lazy ladyboy who only uses her phone during the treatment.

reviews.name: Il Rokoko
reviews.text: Sehr schlechte erfahrung habe ich in einem dieser 2 massagesalons auf der rechten seite gemacht.direkt der erste salon, bevor man weiter die strasse hochgeht um auf die hauptstrasse zu gelangen.auf google ist nur dieses geschäft zu sehen,daher bitte berücksichtigen,dass ich den ersten salon rechts meine,wenn man vom sheraton hochgeht.2 junge frauen, von 90 min ölmassage wurden quasi  70% nur unterbeine massiert,während ich die ganze zeit auf bauch lag und mich wunderte,wann sie endlich sagt umdrehen. Grund,sie sah die ganze zeit auf ihr handy hab ich festgestellt.mir wurden auch nicht die füsse gewaschen,erst als ich sie während massage aufmerksam machte,dann tat sie es mit wenig begeisterung.also unmöglich...nie wieder
reviews.textTranslated: I had a very bad experience at one of the two massage parlors on the right-hand side. It's the first one before you continue up the street to reach the main road. Google Maps only shows this one establishment, so please note that I'm referring to the first parlor on the right when coming up from the Sheraton. Two young women performed a 90-minute oil massage, and for about 70% of the time, they only massaged my lower legs. I lay on my stomach the entire time, wondering when they would finally tell me to turn over. I realized the reason was that they were looking at their phones the whole time. They also didn't wash my feet; only after I pointed it out during the massage did they do so, and even then, with little enthusiasm. Absolutely unacceptable... never again.

title: Thai house massage
address: PHQ5+3FQ, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Tim
reviews.text: Great Place, Very good price and many of the ladies speak english. I've been  to other shops and usually leave feeling as though I wasted my money, but the Thai House was different and much better. While I admit, the decor is not the best the friendly staff as well as technique make up for it. I've been three times and plan to go again. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: A Qadri
reviews.text:
One of the best professional massage therapy
Experiences therapists

reviews.name: Love White Teeth
reviews.text: Had a foot massage - very professional and relaxing !

reviews.name: Luigi Puca
reviews.text:
It doesn't have the plus of luxury which is perhaps better and surely the services are offered at a fair price. The fact that the place doesn't face the street is another plus for me.

The therapist was nice and performed the massage with a lot of grace.

I want to go back!

reviews.name: Matt M
reviews.text: Been dropping in each day for a foot massage.  Got a good experienced therapist each time.  The shop is in the basement at times square is very quiet and relaxed.  Good value at 250 baht on Sukhumvit Rd.  You will see the ladies near the stairs going down underneath the Starbucks.  Watch your head on the way down the stairs it's low clearance!

reviews.name: Adam Merry
reviews.text:
Very experienced, capable and responsive. Despite no common language the practitioner was able to identify and treat soreness from multiple old injuries. Good natured and friendly... Able to laugh at my limited mobility also.

Would definitely recommend

reviews.name: Yaron Naor, Master luthier
reviews.text: Not recommend at all. Lazy worker, on the phone all time....

reviews.name: Tracey Britton
reviews.text:
Only massage I have ever had where therapist was on her phone talking. At other times chatting to other therapists
Other than that technique was fair

reviews.name: Yong Lun Wong (Mr Ah Lun)
reviews.text: Average experience,  not skillful enough

reviews.name: おかきせんべい
reviews.text:
2019.10
お店はビルの地下にあります。女の子が地上のスタバの下あたりで客引きをしています。
フットマッサージ中心の比較的小さなお店です。
真面目にしっかりやってくれます。
歩く旅にはフットマッサージが不可欠だと確信しました。フットマッサージ初体験のお店です。
施術中にスタッフがペチャクチャするのはタイの文化です。イチイチイラついてるとタイを楽しめなくなります。日本のタイマッサージ店も同じです。
reviews.textTranslated:
October 2019
The shop is located in the basement of a building. A girl solicits customers from below the Starbucks on the ground floor.
It's a relatively small shop that specializes in foot massages.
The staff are diligent and thorough.
I'm convinced that a foot massage is essential for any walking trip. This was my first experience with a foot massage.
It's part of Thai culture for staff to chatter during the treatment. If you get annoyed at every little thing, you won't enjoy your time in Thailand. It's the same at Thai massage parlors in Japan.

reviews.name: Min
reviews.text:
얘들아 여기는 맛사 받는곳이 아니고 맛사샵을 가장한 떡집이데이
근데 밤 7-9시 사이에 가면 간혹 이쁜애 있더라 맛있더라
reviews.textTranslated:
Hey guys, this isn't a massage place; it's a brothel disguised as a massage shop.

But if you go between 7 and 9 PM, there are occasionally some pretty ones. They're good.

reviews.name: 김효정
reviews.text:
1점도 아깝네요.
전신 마사지 해서 삼백밧 주고 커튼처져있는 어두운 방안에서 받았는데 제가 안보고있다고 생각하는지 중간중간 마사지사가 자기 핸드폰을 하면서 맛사지를 해주네요? 정말 하나도 안시원하고 설렁설렁 완전 대충해줍니다. 같이 옆에서 해주던 다른 마사지사랑 엄청 수다떨면서 하고 외국인이라고 의사소통 안되니까 설렁설렁하는건지  시간도 1시간 다 안채우고 끝냄. 3번 받은 맛사지샵 중에서 최악중의 최악. 절대 가지마세요.
reviews.textTranslated: It's not even worth a single point. I paid 300 baht for a full body massage in a dark room with curtains drawn. The masseuse must have thought I wasn't watching because she was on her phone intermittently. It was completely unsatisfactory, completely sloppy, and completely inaccurate. She chatted a lot with the other masseuse next to her, and since she was a foreigner, she must have been sloppy because she couldn't communicate, and she finished before the hour was up. Of the three massage parlors I've been to, this one is the worst. Never go there again.

reviews.name: lovely sohee
reviews.text:
마사지하면서 자기들끼리 웃고떠들고 정말 대충하는것 같았음.
하나도 시원하지않고,심지어 10분 남았는데 마사지 끝냄.
여기 신용카드안되고 현금만 받음.
방콕여행중 최악 마사지 받은곳이 여기임.
reviews.textTranslated:
They were laughing and chatting amongst themselves during the massage, and it seemed like they were doing a really sloppy job.
It wasn't refreshing at all, and they even finished with 10 minutes left.
They don't accept credit cards, only cash.
This was the worst massage I had during my trip to Bangkok.

reviews.name: Yuna Lee
reviews.text: 걍 마사지사가 양아침니더 계속 시끄럽게 폰 만지고 대충 하길래 맘에 안들었는데 팁 적게 줬더니 굿피플은 100밧씩 팁 준다고 마지막까지 지롤을 하네요 저ㄹ대 갖지마세용
reviews.textTranslated: I didn't like it because the masseuse kept talking loudly on her phone and doing a sloppy job, but when I gave her a small tip, she kept telling me to give her a 100 baht tip until the end. Don't take that.

reviews.name: 문지영
reviews.text: 최근리뷰가 안좋아서 걱정했는데 생각보다는 괜찮았어요 그래도 마사지사들끼리 웃고 떠들고 편안한 분위기는 아니네요~ 그래도 절 해줬던 마사지사는 좀 과묵하고 괜찮았구요 팁도 무리하게 요구하지 않는 분위기였어요~
reviews.textTranslated: I was worried because the recent reviews weren't good, but it was better than I expected. Still, the masseuses were laughing and chatting amongst themselves, so it wasn't exactly a relaxed atmosphere. However, the masseuse who treated me was a bit quiet but nice, and they didn't seem to ask for an unreasonable tip.

reviews.name: 내 구독자 수.문재인과 좌익새끼들 뒤질 숫자
reviews.text:
여기는 올때마다 느끼지만 마사지 너무 잘합니다.
매우 강추합니다. 압도 쌔고 대충하지도 않고 금액도 저렴합니다! 강추!
reviews.textTranslated:
Every time I come here, I feel the same way: the massage is excellent.

I highly recommend it. The pressure is strong, they don't cut corners, and the price is affordable! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: 박민성
reviews.text: 절대 가지마세요 다른곳 풀예약이라길래 그냥 여긴 바로 되길래 갔는데 마사지 시간 남았는데 끝내고 너무 별로고 마사지 받고 몸이 더 뻐근함  남자손님대할때랑 태도부터 너무 다르네요 최악입니다 여태까지 타이마사지 받으러 많이 다녔는데 여긴 최악이에요
reviews.textTranslated: Absolutely do not go there. I heard other places were fully booked, so I just went here because they had an opening right away. I had time left on my massage, but they finished it abruptly, and it was terrible. My body felt even more stiff after the massage. Their attitude is completely different from how they treat male customers. It is the worst. I have been to many Thai massage places, but this is the absolute worst.

reviews.name: 오영선
reviews.text:
별루입니다.
웨스틴호텔과 터미널21사이길로 들어가면 촛집 로터스마사지 평균이상으로 잘합니다
reviews.textTranslated:
It's not very good.

If you go down the street between the Westin Hotel and Terminal 21, the Candle House Lotus Massage is better than average.

reviews.name: Alex Kim
reviews.text:
최악입니다. 절대비추.
초짜인듯 마사지 엉망,옆의 노래방 소리는 시끄럽고.
reviews.textTranslated:
It's the worst. Absolutely not recommended.

The massage was terrible, as if they were inexperienced, and the karaoke next door was loud.

reviews.name: 김은수
reviews.text: 처음와봤는대 정말 친절하고 마사지 진짜 잘합니나 강추!
reviews.textTranslated: It's my first time here, and they are really friendly and the massage is really good. Highly recommended!

title: Patcharee Massage
ownerDescription:
ร้าน Patcharee Massage
เป้นร้านนวดเพื่อสุขภาพ/นวดผ่อนคลาย
ร้านอยู่ตรงข้ามโรงแรมเพิร์ล โฮเต็ล
address: 41/7 Montri Rd, Tambon Talat Yai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand
plusCode: V9JV+R3 Phuket, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Mustafa Abu-hijleh
reviews.text: Just got off a flight and our necks and shoulders were super tight , we are staying at the Marriott and this place was a 2 min walk so we said why not !! Went in with a friend for 1 hour each , we had a very bad experience !! Met the man outside waited for 10 min till we got in. Very Old women that seem to hate their jobs( from their attitude) !! But still gave it a shot !! Both women kept giggling and laughing ( one of them was actually burping while giving my freind his message ). multiple times they were asked to concentrate on neck and shoulders and put some pressure. Unfortunately this is one of these places where they put excessive oil and do a very soft massage !! Ended up leaving half way and payed 400bhat for both even though the disappointment was not worth that !! Would not recommend this place at all !! Very unprofessional.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The shop is sorry that the customers were not impressed and will improve.

reviews.name: Ramy
reviews.text: Don’t waste your money… have been Here before 2 years ago, was great. Now 2 young lady’s all the time on the phone and very bad massage. Leave you full with oil and wasted money. 0 stars.

reviews.name: Saithida Wongrueachai
reviews.text: I paid 400 thb for foot massage and didn’t worth it. Massage that i got was too soft and too oily. I I told a masseuse to put more pressure but still too soft. She might need more experience.

reviews.name: Sara Femenia
reviews.text:
I did Thai massage, and that is definitely not a Thai massage. I gave the benefit of the doubt after reading few bad reviews, and I can confirm it isn’t good. I’ve wanted to tell her to stop and leave but I’ve waited to don’t be rude and hoping at some point would actually change. My bad.
The only reason I gave it a go is because they are open until midnight and my accommodation is next door.

reviews.name: Rayn Sajahan
reviews.text: paid 300 for 1 hour foot massage. Definitely worth it! They did extra massage on the neck and shoulders. 100% recommend come to this spot, they were so nice

reviews.name: Alabama
reviews.text:
Nice thai massage but the boxes are separated only with a curtain and the staff is talking to each other so you can not relax completely because you hear everything.
At the end of my massage some tourist entered for happy ending massage, luckily i was gone by the time and didn’t have to listen to the process.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The shop apologizes and will improve.🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Sebastien
reviews.text: Very friendly people and best massage we had during our holiday ! We did 1 hour oil body massage for 400 baths, definetly worth it ! And  another positive point the place close later compare to the others so we were able to have our massage after our dinner ;) enjoy at 💯
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Patcharee Massage shop would like to thank you very much for the customers who come to use the service and are impressed. We hope that customers will come back to use the service again.

reviews.name: AP reviews
reviews.text: Very good massage and friendly team 🙏🙏

reviews.name: Canazian /Azian Gypsy
reviews.text: This place is open late and easy to find. Staff are super friendly and accommodating.  Reasonably priced.  I enjoy coming here just before close as it not busy, and the massage is required for a great sleep. Free street parking.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ทางร้านขอขอบคุณลูกค้าที่แวะมาใช้บริการและประทับใจกับบริการของเราหวังว่าโอกาสหน้าลูกค้ากลับมาใช้บริการอีกครั้งนะค่ะ🙏🙏

reviews.name: mergen bind
reviews.text: Massage was very good! Also nice that the opening time is till midnight
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ทางร้านขอขอบพระคุณลูกค้ามากๆที่มาใช้บริการนวดเพื่อสุขภาพแล้วประทับใจหวังว่าโอกาสหน้าลูกค้าจะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกครั้งค่ะ
thank you🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Clamss Mallton
reviews.text: Very bad massage
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The shop must also apologize and will improve the next day.

reviews.name: Diones Da Silva na Espanha (vivendo na europa)
reviews.text:
Very nice feet massage
Exactly what we need after walking so much
Two very nice ladies.
Me and my wife loved it
God bless

reviews.name: Chaimae Yakhlef
reviews.text:
De ervaring was erg slecht. De masseuses waren voortdurend aan het giechelen en zaten op hun telefoon. Op zich vond ik dat nog niet eens het ergste, maar de massage zelf was echt van slechte kwaliteit. Ik zat helemaal onder de olie en er was niets om dit fatsoenlijk af te vegen, terwijl dit normaal gesproken door de masseuses zelf wordt gedaan.

Het felle licht en de muziek werden wel aangepast toen ik erom vroeg, maar de muziek stond in eerste instantie veel te hard, waardoor ik moeilijk kon ontspannen. Al met al een hele vreemde en onprettige ervaring.
reviews.textTranslated:
The experience was very bad. The masseuses were constantly giggling and on their phones. I didn't even find that the worst part, but the massage itself was of really poor quality. I was covered in oil and there was nothing to wipe it off properly, whereas normally this is done by the masseuses themselves.

The bright lights and music were adjusted when I asked for it, but the music was initially much too loud, making it difficult for me to relax. All in all, a very strange and unpleasant experience.

reviews.name: Ольга Емельянова (Olala)
reviews.text: Массаж мне понравился. Делала классический тайский массаж. Хорошая цена. Мастер взрослая женщина была любезна, мне понравилось качество массажа, достаточно глубокое воздействие как Я люблю. Я сама массажист и хорошо чувствую тело и с какими слоями работает мастер, меня все удовлетворило. Оформление салона довольно простое, на момент массажа в 11 дня я была в салоне единственным клиентом, моему массажу ничего не помешало. После массажа ощущаю лёгкость в теле и расслабление в мышцах.
reviews.textTranslated: I enjoyed the massage. I had a classic Thai massage. The price was good. The therapist, an older woman, was kind, and I liked the quality of the massage; it was deep enough, just the way I like it. I'm a massage therapist myself and have a good sense of the body and the layers the therapist works on, so I was satisfied. The salon's decor is quite simple; at the time of my massage at 11 a.m., I was the only client there, so nothing interfered with my massage. After the massage, I felt lighter and my muscles relaxed.

reviews.name: Ana Belen Saura
reviews.text:
Qué buen sitio para acabar el día 😃
Buen ambiente entre las chicas y muy profesionales. Tienes que venir👌
reviews.textTranslated:
What a great place to end the day 😃
Great atmosphere among the girls and very professional. You have to come 👌

reviews.name: smiley
reviews.text:
オイルマッサージをしたけど、全然一生懸命やってる感じではない。
マッサージ後も乾いた小さいタオル渡されて体拭けって感じでシャワーも貸してくれない。
ここに行ってお金払うくらいなら他に行った方がいい。
reviews.textTranslated:
I had an oil massage, but it didn't feel like they were trying hard at all.
After the massage, they just gave me a small dry towel to dry my body with, and they didn't even let me use the shower.
I'd rather go somewhere else than pay that money to come here.

reviews.name: Saerom Kim
reviews.text: 마사지사분들이 떠드는 소리가 시끄러워서 편히 쉴 수 없었다. 잡담을 하며 마사지에 집중하지 않았다. 고객은 그것을 감각으로 느낄 수 있다. 시설이 안락하지 않았다. 마사지사의 긴 손톱에 의해 피부가 아팠다. 그래도 마사지가 시원했다.
reviews.textTranslated: I could not rest comfortably because the masseuses were chatting loudly. They were chatting away and not focusing on the massage. A customer can sense this. The facilities were not comfortable. My skin hurt from the masseuse's long fingernails. Nevertheless, the massage was refreshing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 저희 매장은 고객님들께 사과의 말씀을 드리며, 보다 나은 서비스를 제공하도록 노력하겠습니다.

reviews.name: zegna zegna
reviews.text: Un véritable havre de paix où le stress s'efface au profit d'une détente profonde et bienfaisante. Chaque visite est un voyage sensoriel unique, grâce à des mains expertes qui révèlent le bien-être ultime. Un salon où le temps semble suspendu, laissant place à une expérience inoubliable de relaxation et de soin. Merci pour ce moment de pur bonheur.
reviews.textTranslated: A true haven of peace where stress melts away, giving way to deep and restorative relaxation. Each visit is a unique sensory journey, thanks to expert hands that reveal ultimate well-being. A salon where time seems to stand still, allowing for an unforgettable experience of relaxation and pampering. Thank you for this moment of pure bliss.

reviews.name: Susan Chung
reviews.text:
這次在普吉島遇到一次非常不愉快的按摩經驗，想提醒大家多加注意。

原本我是走進去詢問「泰式指壓」，店家當下也確認是傳統的泰式按摩，價格也合理。但一開始按摩不到兩分鐘，按摩師就直接塗上精油，完全沒說明，等於強行改成了「精油按摩」。結束後才告知是油壓價錢，費用直接翻倍，讓人覺得被惡意誤導、甚至是強迫消費。

不僅如此，按摩師的手法也非常不專業，按壓沒有節奏、毫無技巧可言，過程中只是隨意搓揉，完全感受不到放鬆，反而讓人更加不舒服。

整體來說，這是一家黑心店家，誠信有問題、技術也不專業。如果你到普吉島想按摩，務必要特別小心這類手法不清、價格不透明的店家，避免和我一樣被坑。
reviews.textTranslated:
I had a very unpleasant massage experience in Phuket and want to warn others to be careful.

I went in to inquire about "Thai acupressure," and the shop confirmed it was a traditional Thai massage at a reasonable price. However, less than two minutes into the massage, the masseuse applied essential oils without explanation, essentially turning it into an "oil massage." Only after it was over did they tell me it was an oil massage, doubling the price, making me feel maliciously misled and even forced to buy.

Furthermore, the masseuse's technique was extremely unprofessional. The pressure lacked rhythm and skill; the massage was just random rubbing, offering no relaxation whatsoever and making me feel even more uncomfortable.

Overall, this is a dishonest business with questionable integrity and unprofessional skills. If you're in Phuket and want a massage, be extremely careful of shops with unclear techniques and opaque pricing to avoid being ripped off like I was.

An A-Grade experience that sets the bar high.

I came here on the recommendation of a Thai work colleague back in Sydney, and it is definitely a top-tier establishment. From the moment you walk in, the service is impeccable—we were greeted with soothing tea and cold towels which immediately melted the stress away.

It is slightly pricier than other local spots, but you get so much more for your money. The hygiene standards are incredible; I get a lot of massages, and I have honestly never seen a spa this clean. The ambiance is lovely, featuring beautiful aromatic oils.

While the massage itself was good (though not "to die for," which is always subjective), the overall experience was fantastic. They provide full details upfront and even allow you to customize your treatment. Pro tip: Book in advance as they are popular for a reason.

The cherry on top was the post-massage service: delicious jasmine tea and mango sticky rice that is, not gonna lie, up there with the best I've had! Highly recommended and will definitely be visiting again.

reviews.text:
Ein richtig guter Massage-Laden!

Alles noch sehr neu, sehr sauber und der Service ist exzellent. Die Massage selbst eine Wucht - für mich die richtige Mischung aus sanft und gewissenhaft.

Was mich nicht gestört hat, aber: Wer absolute Ruhe möchte, sollte an diesem Standort bedenken, dass man - entsprechend der Großstadt - den Verkehrslärm hört.

Vorab gab es ein köstliches Getränk und im Anschluss an die Massage einen Tee, Klebreis und Mango.

Ich hatte eine 120 Minuten-Massage für Füße und Hände - sehr zu empfehlen.
reviews.textTranslated:
A truly excellent massage parlor!

Everything is very new and spotlessly clean, and the service is outstanding. The massage itself is fantastic – the perfect blend of gentle yet thorough.

One thing that didn't bother me, but if you're looking for absolute peace and quiet, keep in mind that, as is typical for a large city, you can hear some traffic noise.

Beforehand, I was offered a delicious drink, and after the massage, I was served tea, sticky rice, and mango.

I had a 120-minute foot and hand massage – highly recommended.

reviews.name: Biel Roig
reviews.text: He contratado un masaje de espalda y hombros y ha sido genial. Muy atentos y un local con buen gusto y a buen precio. La verdad es que solo se puede decir que un poco más aislado del bullicio de la calle haría la experiencia perfecta. A pesar de eso queda compensado por la muy grata experiencia. Lo recomiendo si estáis por silom
reviews.textTranslated: I booked a back and shoulder massage and it was fantastic. Very attentive, a tastefully decorated space, and reasonably priced. The only downside was that being a little more secluded from the street noise would make it the perfect experience. Even so, the very pleasant experience more than made up for it. I recommend it if you're in Silom.

reviews.name: Nuttapon TRIHATTAKARN
reviews.text: Avoid! Unprofessional masseuse. For Thai massage, it is dangerous if the masseuse is really not knowing where to lay hands on. หมอนวดน่าจะมือใหม่ นวดไทยที่เดิมซ้ำๆเป็น 30-40 ครั้ง อยู่แค่ 4-5 จุดเป็นชั่วโมง ถ้านวดไทยประจำจะคุ้นเคยวิธีการไล่จุดต่างๆ ซึ่งละเอียดมาก และจะรู้ทันทีถ้าถูกนวดโดยคนที่นวดเหมือนไม่ได้เรียน ผิดหวังกับชื่อเสียง
reviews.textTranslated: Avoid! Unprofessional masseuse. For Thai massage, it is dangerous if the masseuse doesn't really know where to apply pressure. The masseuse seems inexperienced, having massaged the same spot 30-40 times, focusing on only 4-5 pressure points for an hour. Regular Thai massage practitioners would be familiar with the intricate techniques of pressure points and would immediately recognize if they're being massaged by someone untrained. Disappointed with the massager's reputation.

ownerDescription:
Kaew Pilates คือสตูดิโอพิลาทิสที่มุ่งเน้นการพัฒนาความแข็งแรงของร่างกาย การปรับบุคลิกภาพ และการสร้างสมดุลของร่างกายผ่านการฝึกพิลาทิสอย่างถูกต้องโดยผู้สอนที่มีประสบการณ์

คลาสของเราถูกออกแบบให้เหมาะกับทุกระดับ ตั้งแต่ผู้เริ่มต้นจนถึงผู้ที่มีประสบการณ์ โดยเน้นการเคลื่อนไหวอย่างปลอดภัย ช่วยเสริมสร้างกล้ามเนื้อแกนกลางลำตัว (Core Strength) เพิ่มความยืดหยุ่นของร่างกาย และปรับสมดุลของท่าทาง

ไม่ว่าคุณต้องการฟื้นฟูร่างกาย เสริมสร้างสุขภาพ หรือพัฒนารูปร่าง Kaew Pilates พร้อมดูแลและช่วยให้คุณบรรลุเป้าหมายด้านสุขภาพในระยะยาว

reviews.name: Coffee& Pudding
reviews.text:
แนะนำให้แจ้งควา ต้องการให้เจ้าหน้าที่ เทรนเนอร์
ครั้งแรก เราเข้ามาใช้แบบ 1-1
เทรนเนอร์ให้ ฝึกหายใจขยับตัวเข้าออก
เรารุสึกว่า เบื่อมาก แบบตรงๆนะ
ครั้งที่สองมา เทรนเนอร์อีกท่าน ทราบว่าเราเคยเวทมา เลยแบบที่ตรงจุดเราชื่นชอบมากขึ้น รุสึกเกร็งถึงจุดได้จริง ชอบขึ้นค่ะ

จึงแนะนำให้แจ้งความต้องการกับเทรนเนอร์คะ เค้าสามารถดูและแนะนำให้ได้
reviews.textTranslated:
I recommend informing the trainer of your needs.
The first time, we used a 1-on-1 training session.
The trainer had us practice breathing exercises and body movements.
To be honest, I found it very boring.
The second time, a different trainer, knowing that I had weight training experience, was able to tailor the training to my preferences. I felt the tension and could really feel the movement. I liked it much more.

Therefore, I recommend informing your trainer of your needs. They can assess your requirements and provide recommendations.

reviews.name: P J
reviews.text:
ซื้อแพคเกจ 6+6 มาด้วยเห็นว่ามีสาขาเยอะและคลาสน่าสนใจค่ะ พอมาดูรีวิวคือตกใจมาก แบบจะดีมั้ย 😂

ด้วยความที่บ้านอยู่โซนราชพฤกษ์ เลยมีโอกาสได้ไปเล่น Airfit Bungee ที่สาขาราชพฤกษ์ ต่อด้วย Reformer Foundation ที่สาขาเจริญนคร เข้าคลาสที่สาขานี้อีก 3 ครั้ง HIIT Pilates, Reformer Upper Body, Reformer Full Body คลาสออกแบบมาแบบกลุ่มเล็กๆ ซึ่งประทับใจมากค่ะ ครูดูแลดี คลาสออกแบบมาดี (สำหรับเรามือใหม่หัดพิลาทิสนะคะ) โดยรวมชอบมาก ดีใจที่ใกล้บ้านสุดๆ มีคลาสให้เลือกและทดลองหลากหลายมากๆเลยค่ะ เลิฟๆ ❤️

รับไปเลย 5 ดาว 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.textTranslated:
I bought the 6+6 package because I saw they have many branches and interesting classes. But after reading the reviews, I was shocked – I wondered if it would really be any good 😂

Since I live in the Ratchaphruek area, I had the opportunity to try Airfit Bungee at the Ratchaphruek branch, followed by Reformer Foundation at the Charoen Nakhon branch. I also attended three more classes at this branch: HIIT Pilates, Reformer Upper Body, and Reformer Full Body. The classes were designed in small groups, which I really appreciated. The instructors were attentive, and the classes were well-designed (for me, a Pilates beginner). Overall, I loved it! I'm so glad it's so close to home and offers a wide variety of classes to choose from and try. Love it! ❤️

5 stars! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.name: Jenny Shaviv
reviews.text: The reviews here are conflicting, but for me it always was and still is the best massage in Chiang Mai. Definitely the cheapest. Yes it highly depends on the therapist. I had four throughout several times I've visited over seven past years and two of them (both were males) were exceptionally good. The purpose of Thai massage is to release blocks in physical and metaphysical bodies. This is the only massage place that successful does this for me.

reviews.name: h chen
reviews.text:
I have had 3 sessions of massages in 2 places by 3 masseuses and my advise is: if you haven't tried one trusted masseuse already, go for foot massage first and don't be tempted by the price however cheap it seems. 1. the qualification of masseuse varies even in the same place. So pick the masseuse, not the shop. You don't want to end up seeing a doctor. 2. We all have different physical conditions and level of strength tolerance. Unless you are really lucky or you have tried, don't put your health and safety in the hands of a total stranger. 3. Although language is not required, but if you need more specific care, being able to communicate matters. Find someone who can at least converse on a basic level in this case.

I had my first massage in a place not far from this temple massage. Due to a severe headache, I requested a head, neck and shoulder massage. All I can say is that I was in fear of being paralyzed because the force used, especially in some critical point in the spin( I don't even know why the massage extended to my back ) and areas around the back of my neck which are full of important nerves! I paid 250 Baht and barely escaped that horror house. Not to mention my headache was all the worse because I felt like a meat on the chopping board all the 60 minutes.

Then I had another two foot massage at this temple massage. The first one was good and the second one left my left foot bruised even after 3 days ( see picture ). Some of them seem to think that the more force, the better. That's not proper massage and might lead to serious harm if placed in the wrong place. I don't mean to harm the business but my advise is trying foot massage first until you are satisfied with the person working on your body. Don't go full Thai or body massage first unless you have skin and bone as think as an elephant. ( or simply very lucky )

I gave 3 stars for the price and the one masseuse which I am happy with.

reviews.name: Sebastien Bertrand
reviews.text:
Don't go there for massage. Therapists have no skills and the manager cares only about money (this business doesn't belong to the temple).

I've lived in Chiang Mai 10 years and have a Thai massage every week. I even used to have my own massage place. So I know about real Thai massage.

I had the worst experience at this place. I came for a Thai massage and asked for a good therapist. She started to do oil massage on my back very painfully. When I told her this is not thai massage, she changed but I could quickly understand she has no skills at all. Thai massage is very precised and with experience this is easy to know if therapist knows it or not. Looks like this one has never had any proper training and certificate.

I'm afraid all therapists are the same because the manager told ne beforehand she was good then didn't care or understood the issue aftehand. She just asked me to leave. Looks like offering good Thai massage is not her job.

reviews.name: Willy Generotzky
reviews.text:
Eine ganze Woche jeden Tag eine  traditionelle Thai-Massage von 1,5 Stunden Dauer. Das Resultat war überwältigend positiv, wobei die Massage manchmal auch etwas schmerzhaft war.
Die Anwendungen finden auf dem Tempel-Gelände in einer öffentlichen Halle auf jeweils 7 bzw 6 Matten und Sesseln (Fussmassage) statt. Keine Privatsphäre, dafür aber viel sichtbare und spürbare Freude der professionell arbeitenden Masseure und Masseurinnen.
Die Ausbildung der MasseurInnen ist gut, trotzdem immer etwas unterschiedlich in der Ausführung. Dein Hinweis, wie sanft oder kräftig die Anwendung sein soll, sorgt für ein perfektes Ergebnis.
Die Preise hier liegen etwas unter dem Durchschnitt. Es ist anständig und fair gegenüber den MasseurInnen, das Trinkgeld dafür etwas großzügiger zu gestalten. Wir haben bei 1,5 Stunden immer einen Tip in Höhe von 100 THB gegeben.
reviews.textTranslated:
A whole week of daily 1.5-hour traditional Thai massages. The result was overwhelmingly positive, although the massages were sometimes a little painful.

The treatments take place on the temple grounds in a public hall with 7 or 6 mats and chairs (for foot massages). There's no privacy, but the professional masseurs and masseuses clearly enjoyed themselves.

The masseurs are well-trained, but their technique varies slightly. Your preference for gentle or firm pressure ensures a perfect result.

The prices here are slightly below average. It's polite and fair to tip the masseurs a bit more generously. We always tipped 100 THB for our 1.5-hour massages.

お寺の敷地内にあるマッサージ店でオープンな店内で扇風機をかけてましたが、午前中だった事も有り心地よかったです。今回はフットマッサージ1時間とタイマッサージを1時間やって貰いましたが、めちゃくちゃ上手かったです。色んな国やタイでもかなりの回数色んなお店に行ってますが、今回のマッサージは本当に最高でした！
是非また来てみたいです。
reviews.textTranslated: This massage parlor is located on the temple grounds and has an open interior with a fan on, but it was comfortable, especially since it was mid-morning. I had a one-hour foot massage and a one-hour Thai massage, and they were incredibly skilled. I've been to many different massage parlors in Thailand and in many other countries, but this massage was truly the best! I'd definitely like to come again.

reviews.name: Thierry

Je retrouve un petit peu les massages que l’on faisait, il y a 20 ou 30 ans en Thaïlande, entre autres wat pho de Bkk.
Enfin, un endroit non climatisé avec des gros ventilateurs au prix imbattable, 190 bahts l’heure. J’ai fait deux massages et à chaque fois je suis tombé sur une bonne personne un bon masseur.  Au final, la réussite du massage ne tient  qu’au masseur donc les avis peuvent diverger…
reviews.textTranslated:
It reminds me a little of the massages we used to get 20 or 30 years ago in Thailand, especially at Wat Pho in Bangkok.

Finally, a place without air conditioning but with big fans at an unbeatable price: 190 baht an hour. I had two massages and each time I was lucky enough to get a good person, a good masseur. Ultimately, the success of a massage depends entirely on the masseur, so opinions may vary…

reviews.name: Leo van de Water
reviews.text:
Wij waren hier voor de tweede keer maar nu slecht getroffen. Waren wat laat, na tienen, maar waren toch welkom. Direct naar binnen zonder het wassen van de voeten. Kregen vooraf de rekening 800 Thb. Masseuses kwamen luidruchtig binnen en begonnen gelijk over dat het beter was om een massage van twee uur te nemen. Compromie was anderhalf uur.
Dames bleven luidruchtig en communiceerden met collega’s buiten onze ruimte. Gevraagd of zij wat minder luidruchtig wilden zijn terwijl ook de telefoon regelmatig overging. Massage viel tegen en werd niet afgerond. Na een uur en tien minuten was het klaar en kregen we de extra rekening van 400 Thb. Uiteraard niet betaald en ons ongenoegen kenbaar gemaakt. Toch, uit goed fatsoen. 100 Thb tip gegeven waar ik achteraf spijt van had.
Ondanks dat deze salon er goed verzorgd uit ziet, pas opgeknapt, gaan we hier niet meer naar toe. Slechte leiding en verkeerde keuze van opgeroepen masseuses. 😩😩😩
reviews.textTranslated:
This was our second time here, but this time we were in for a disappointment. We arrived a bit late, after ten, but were still welcomed. We were let in straight away without having our feet washed. We received the 800 THB bill upfront. Masseuses came in loudly and immediately started suggesting a two-hour massage would be better. The compromise was an hour and a half.

The women remained loud and talked to colleagues outside our room. We asked them to be a bit quieter, while the phone rang regularly. The massage was disappointing and didn't finish. After an hour and ten minutes, it was over and we received an additional 400 THB bill. Of course, we didn't pay and expressed our dissatisfaction. Still, out of good manners. I left a 100 THB tip, which I later regretted.
Although this salon looks well-maintained and recently renovated, we won't be going back. Poor management and the wrong choice of masseuses. 😩😩😩

У меня кровавые синяки по телу, и начала неметь левая рука и лопатка.

Это ХУДШИЙ массаж!!! Я сомневаюсь, что у массажистов есть реальные лицензии на оказание услуг. Это подделка.

Я встала и после меня положили на мое место другую девушку, это нормально??
Берегите себя и своих близких.

reviews.textTranslated:
This used to be my favorite massage parlor.
A year later, we returned to the island and went for another massage. The therapists had all changed, and the massage was incredibly mediocre (they just pressed down on you with their hands).

After a massage, my mother suffered a torn ligament in her leg. When she cried out, the therapist responded, "What can I do? You must have been walking a lot?" - "No, we drive." We ended up having to contact the insurance company and call emergency services because my mother's leg was swollen and she couldn't put any weight on it. The result: a torn ligament and treatment. After a foot massage!!!!!😱 What are you doing????

I have bloody bruises all over my body, and my left arm and shoulder blade are starting to go numb.

This is the WORST massage!!! I doubt the massage therapists are actually licensed to provide this service. It's a fake.

They don't change the sheets between clients, they don't change the blankets, and I'm not sure they wash the towels. Absolute disregard.
I stood up and another girl was put in my seat after me. Is that normal?
Take care of yourself and your loved ones.
The place has deteriorated greatly, I'm so upset and hurt. The owner didn't respond or help at all. The service is absolutely terrible.

reviews.text: 这家店的环境和设施还算过得去，房间整洁度尚可。技师水平参差不齐，确实能遇到几个手法专业、服务认真的，但也会碰到明显敷衍了事、急于结束的。价格方面，算是市场中等水平，但性价比不算高，毕竟服务质量不稳定。最大的问题是不透明和误导性宣传，实际体验与承诺常有出入。建议消费者事先明确所有细节，最好能有熟人推荐具体技师。总的来说，如果降低期望值，偶尔体验一下也无妨，但不宜抱太大希望，更不适合作为长期选择。管理上还需要加强标准化培训，提升整体服务一致性。
reviews.textTranslated: The shop's environment and facilities are passable, and the rooms are reasonably clean. The skill level of the technicians varies; you can encounter a few who are professional and attentive, but you'll also find those who are clearly perfunctory and eager to finish. In terms of price, it's about average for the market, but the value for money isn't high, given the inconsistent service quality. The biggest problem is the lack of transparency and misleading advertising; the actual experience often differs from the promises. Consumers are advised to clarify all details beforehand and ideally have someone recommend a specific technician. Overall, if you lower your expectations, an occasional visit is fine, but don't have high hopes, and it's definitely not suitable as a long-term choice. Management needs to strengthen standardized training to improve overall service consistency.

reviews.name: Chaganti Navyaneethu
reviews.text:
WORST WORST WORST service I’ve ever experienced.
The staff was extremely rude:

We booked a couple’s aromatherapy massage, but the experience was far from relaxing.Therapists started laughing during the massage. Although we don’t understand Thai, it was clear they were laughing at us, making us feel uncomfortable.
Their massage technique was terrible. Instead of relieving tension, it felt rough and painful. They didn’t even stretch the joints properly, and the pressure was unbearable. I almost asked them to stop midway.
The head massage was by far the worst I’ve ever experienced.
During the couple’s massage, the two therapists continuously chatted with each other, completely ruining the ambiance.
The lighting was too bright for a massage room. It would have been more relaxing with dimmer lights.
The music was way too loud for a massage place; it felt more like we were in a café than a spa.
The staff showed no empathy or care for the customers.
I deeply regret not checking the Google reviews before coming here.
I would never recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.name: Polly Paint pot
reviews.text: Had my nails gel. Polish at the end of my holliday.. Was a beautiful place.. I only experienced very friendly staff, and my nails were excellent, been home 3 weeks and they are still amazing. Picture is my nails after 3 weeks, although I have growth they still  are standing strong.

reviews.name: Nika Nguyen
reviews.text: Finally a place where they actually apply pressure and you feel everything cracking, and not just gentle rubbing. Great foot massage and shoulder/back massage. Would come back for another one!

reviews.name: Catherine Dougall
reviews.text: First time I’ve not checked reviews beforehand & learnt my lesson 😭 got pulled in by the appearance, however, wouldn’t recommend here at all. Had to pay the money before getting the treatments, then they just rushed the whole thing and gave a terrible service. I got a pedicure & gel polish, my pedicure lasted 2 minutes and didn’t involve any foot file, soak, nail scrub, or oil/lotion. The lady was rude and seemed visibly annoyed at any of my responses to her questions, and just generally little care. My boyfriend also got a pedicure and we noticed they do not use single use disposable kits and the general hygiene of equipment use was poor. Ended up asking her to finish early as wanted to leave.

reviews.name: Scott H
reviews.text: I have had 2 massages at this place, both were amazing , had a Thai massage, was only 300 baht, was so good , my therapist was peso, very plesant, not sure why this place get a low score

reviews.name: Havle Güney
reviews.text: I rarely add comments on Google, but I have to do it this time: I received many real Thai massages in my life, this was by far the worst one. Throughout the session, she was so so so in hurry, as if we were going to be kicked out of the room in a second. I had to keep myself calm during the entire session, to also not interfere her craft. But I must unfortunately say that somebody should make her aware that this is really not how it should be done... Plus she didn't even give me a couple minutes to come back to myself at the end of the session and get dressed. She said I needed to hurry up and leave the room because they need to clean it. Very bad experience.

Overall, I guess you can find better options in the area, as the entire experience from end to end wasn't as good as we had in other massage spots.

reviews.text: Had a Thai massage with oil and the second time a massage with oil. Both were amazing, and as my sister said, “you’re bent in places you didn’t think you’d bend.” Value for money, and I could’ve slept during the massage. I see bad reviews but I must’ve gone of good days.

reviews.text: It was my first time having a massage in Thailand. It was really bad. The masseur was a dark-skinned, rather plump woman with very long fingernails. I chose foot massage and Thai massage. The whole process was very rude and impatient. It was a very bad experience.

reviews.name: Dani
reviews.text:
I have never left a review like this but sadly this was the worst massage I have received. I feel it is important to warn others and hope the company can learn from this and make serious improvements.

The staff were genuinely lovely but sadly they are not experienced or skilled when it comes to sports massages.

I walked in for a head, neck, shoulders and back massage. The pressure was very intense - especially on my arms and upper back. When I got back to my hotel that same evening, I had developed severe bruising across both my arms. This bruising has now lasted a week and they are black and dark purple in colour :(

The beautiful and clean looking interior drew us in but sadly the masseuse was inexperienced and used far too much pressure.

My suggestion is that the establishment urgently implements training for all massage therapists. Otherwise more people will get hurt!

reviews.text:
I had a session here today and it has been fantastic! The trainer was Ole. I did some rounds on the pads, sparring and bagwork with him. He did a very good job in explaining flaws in techniques and showed me how to improve them. I would consider myself advanced, but I definately learned a lot and I am sure beginners will also be taken good care of.

If you book the Muay Thai session you can also use the fitness gym which I didn't use but which looked very clean and with new equipment.

reviews.name: Naveen Arivazhagan
reviews.text:
Olay and his son, Hon, are exceptional trainers with a deep passion for teaching effectively. Olay, in particular, is fluent in English and provides an outstanding training experience. Unlike many gyms that rehearse flashy impractical combinations, Olay tailors each session to your specific level and progress in Muay Thai.

For me, he emphasized mastering the basics and refining techniques that will serve me throughout my Muay Thai and martial arts journey. His attention to detail is remarkable—every kick, jab, and foot placement receives immediate feedback. Initially, I planned to train here for just a couple days before heading to Phuket. However, his exceptional coaching and individualized attention compelled me to stay in Bangkok for over two weeks to train with him daily. If you're serious about muay Thai, this is the place to be.

reviews.name: Oliver L
reviews.text: Had an awesome family experience here. We booked a group session and it was only the four of us on the day... we had two instructors and they were soo good with the kids, who really loved it. Great workout!! Recommended!

reviews.text:
I had two massages. I really enjoyed the first experience. The masseur, Guy, had good pressure and he gave the right mix of massage and sensual. He was awesome.
Went back the next night and decided to try someone different (my mistake). I had Jeff. Not only was the massage 20 minutes short of the 90 I paid for, his massage was basically rubbing my legs up and down for about 20 minutes. He only massaged my legs and back. Not my feet, not my arms, not my head. Nothing else. He also stayed at my feet for the first 30 to 40 minutes so I couldn't touch him or interact with him. Then, when he moved up, he asked me to put my arms above my head, again I couldn't interact with him.
Careful which masseur you choose. Some are great, some don't know how to massage.

reviews.text: The guy who provided service on 8/24 was very gentle, and the entire experience was delightful. I still can't forget him, and I regret not asking for his name. The next time I visit Bangkok, I would like to book his time.

I was very pleasantly surprised. He’s indeed strong and knows what he’s doing. He gave me a professional sports massage which is exactly what I wanted. As for the “extra”, well he’s not shy. Overall a great experience. With the mandatory THB1000 tip, this was still half of what I pay at home, and equally, if not, better. Well done Ken.
Update. Went back for the third time in several months, still with Ken. I was very disappointed this time that despite paying for 2hrs, Ken finished the massage in about 95min. That’s unusual, and not a practice I encountered before at Nine Spa.

reviews.name: Karim Ismail
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 – Avoid This Place. Scammy and Extremely Unprofessional

We booked in advance for 3 people and arrived on time at 6:00 PM. Instead of welcoming us, the staff immediately told us that because we had selected “special” masseurs, we must pay a minimum 1,000 THB tip per person. This was never mentioned during booking. When we refused and said any masseur is fine, their attitude completely changed—cold, rude, and dismissive.

Despite arriving on time, they kept us waiting:
•	First person taken at 6:20
•	Second 5 minutes later
•	My session started around 6:30 because the masseur was late

When my massage finally started, it was a disaster. The masseur was non-stop talking, completely unprofessional, and his phone kept ringing throughout the session. After only 10 minutes, staff came in and told me they had to change my masseur because another client booked him.

At that point, I refused to continue and stopped the massage. Instead of apologizing, they were rude, defensive, and refused to refund any money from the 90-minute session I had fully prepaid, even though the service was clearly not delivered.

This place feels like it’s designed to pressure customers for extra money, then treat them badly if they don’t comply. No professionalism, no respect for reservations, and terrible customer service.

I absolutely do NOT recommend Nap Bangkok Spa.
This was a complete waste of time and money, and it felt like a straight-up scam.

reviews.name: Anchalee Gandhi
reviews.text:
ไปสระผมครั้งแรกบริการแย่มากค่ะ nap salon = สระผม + นวด แต่พูดตรงตรงนะคะอันนี้คือนวดแบบทรมานมาก  เค้าไม่ได้นวดเค้าแค่แตะแตะศรีษะ 45  นาที ค่ะ  เสียงก็ดังมาก พนักงานก็คุยกัน  ไม่ผ่อนคลายเลยค่ะ
ตอนเสร็จแล้วจ่ายเงินไปตั้งเยอะไม่พอใจเราก็เลยขอคุยกับเจ้าของร้านแล้วอธิบายให้เค้าว่าบริการควรดีกว่านี้นะค่า เค้าก็เลยบอกว่า จะปรับปรุงแต่ขอ แถมให้เป็นครั้งหน้าเค้าจะทำให้ดีกว่านี้ เราก็คุยกับเค้าดีดีเลยนะเกรงใจมากแต่ก็ขอบคุณเขาที่เขาเข้าใจเพราะบริการมันไม่ดีจริงๆค่ะ
ครั้งหน้าก่อนไปเราโทรไปบอกเขาว่างั้นขอเข้ามาใช้บริการนะค่า เราไปกันสองคนแต่คนนึงเราจะจ่ายนะ เค้าบอกว่าเข้ามาได้เลย
ตอนไปถึงนั่น พนักงานนั่ง เอาขาขึ้นบนกวีเล่นโทรศัพท์กันอยู่เราเข้าไปแล้วบอกเขาว่ามีนัดนะเมื่อกี้เพิ่งโทรคุย พนักงานก็งงเหมือนไม่รู้เรื่อง หลังสักพักเค้าก็บอกว่า ต้องทำทีละคน เพราะช่างอีกคนนึงไม่พอใจว่าครั้งที่แล้วเราคอมเพลเรื่องเขา ก็เลยเค้าไม่อยากทำให้ แบบนี้คือไม่ professional เลยค่ะ
เราก็เลยโทรไปหาเจ้าของร้านแล้วถามเค้าว่าเค้าไม่คุยกันหรอเราเสียเวลาเดินทางมา เค้าก็เลยบอกว่าขอคุยกับพนักงานหลังสักพักโทรกลับมาบอกว่า จริงๆมันใกล้เวลาปิดแล้วพนักงานเค้าก็เหนื่อยเลยเค้าไม่ทำให้ งงมากเลยค่ะถ้าจะไม่ได้ทำให้ไม่น่าจะรับงานเลย ถ้าบอกกันตรงตรงว่าไม่อยากให้แถมหรือยังไงก็ได้น่าจะบอกนะคะไม่น่าจะทำให้คนอื่นเสียเวลา แล้วเสียความรู้สึกเลยค่ะ
ร้านนี้ควร ปรับปรุงให้ดีขึ้นนะคะไม่งั้น ไม่มีลูกค้ากลับมาแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
My first time at Nap Salon was a terrible experience. The salon's motto is "hair wash + massage," but honestly, the massage was torture. They didn't really massage; they just touched my head for 45 minutes. It was also very noisy, and the staff were chatting amongst themselves. It wasn't relaxing at all.
After paying, and despite paying a lot, I was very dissatisfied and asked to speak to the owner. I explained that the service should have been better. They said they would improve and offered a free service next time. I spoke to them politely, feeling very apologetic, but also grateful that they understood because the service was truly poor.
Next time, I called to let them know I could come in for a service. There were two of us, but one of us would be paying. They said I could come in.
When I arrived, the staff were sitting with their legs up on the chair, playing on their phones. I told them I had an appointment and had just spoken on the phone. The staff seemed confused and didn't know what was going on. After a while, they said they had to do each person individually because another stylist was unhappy about a complaint I had received last time and didn't want to serve me. This was completely unprofessional.
I called the owner and asked if they hadn't communicated with each other, as I had wasted my time traveling there. They said they would talk to the staff and call me back later to explain... Actually, it was almost closing time and the staff were tired, so they didn't do it. I'm very confused. If they weren't going to do it, they shouldn't have accepted the job in the first place. If they had just said directly that they didn't want to give a freebie or something, they should have said so. It's not right to waste other people's time and make them feel bad.
This shop should improve, otherwise, they won't have any customers coming back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We would like to take legal action against false and damaging comments that are posted in public. For untrue information that damages the image of our company, we ask that you immediately remove your unfriendly posts. In the event that we still find your posts appearing on our page tomorrow during business hours, our legal department will file a complaint for defamation and entering false information into a computer system in accordance with Thai law.

reviews.name: Warakorn T
reviews.text:
- น้ำกระเด็น ใส่หน้า (เรื่องพื้นฐานที่ไม่ควรเกิด)
- สระผม แชมพูเลยมาถึงหน้าค่ะ
- ไดรผมไม่แห้ง ตอนไดรผม เหมือนแบ่งช่อผมไม่ถูก กิ้บที่หนีบผมจิ้มหนังศรีษะหลายครั้ง
พนักงานเป็นผู้ชาย ไม่ละเอียดในการทำผม ไม่คล่อง
(ไม่ได้โทษเพศนะคะ แต่อาจต้องฝึกพนักงานที่ทำให้มีความละเอียดมากกว่านี้)
- สถานที่ อยู่ในระดับ 2-3 ดาว ตั้งเตียงไว้ข้างกัน และไดรผมตรงเตียงเลย หากรับลูกค้าหลายๆคนจะรบกวนลูกค้าท่านอื่นหรือเปล่า
- เสียงจากถนนดังเข้าร้าน อาจแก้ด้วยการซีลประตู หรืออื่นๆ แบบนี้อาจไม่เรียกว่า nap sleep
- เสียงจากโซเชี่ยลที่พนักงานเล่นอยู่ด้านหน้า เข้ามาถึงเตียงที่นอน
- พนักงานรีเซปชั่นนั่งคุยโทรศัพท์ ฟีลนั่งอยู่บ้าน
-  1 ชม /999บาท สำหรับนวดศรีษะและสระไดร
จะไม่แพงเลยค่ะ สำหรับโลเคชั่นนี้
หากได้รับบริการที่เหมาะสม 😭

เสียดายแทนค่ะ ร้าน nap,sleep salon ไม่ค่อยเยอะในย่านนี้ ติเพื่อก่อนะคะ สู้ๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
- Water splashed in my face (a basic thing that shouldn't happen).
- Shampoo got on my face during the hair wash.
- My hair wasn't completely dry after blow-drying. It seemed like they didn't section my hair properly, and the hair clips poked my scalp several times.
- The male staff member wasn't meticulous or efficient in doing my hair.
(I'm not blaming his gender, but perhaps he needs more training to be more precise.)
- The location is only 2-3 star level. The beds are placed next to each other, and hair is blow-dried right on the beds. Wouldn't this disturb other customers if they're serving multiple clients?
- Noise from the street is loud in the shop. This could be solved by sealing the doors or other measures. This might not really be considered a nap/sleep salon anymore.
- Noise from the staff's social media activities in the front area reaches the beds.
- The receptionist was talking on the phone; it felt like she was at home.
- 1 hour for 999 baht for a head massage and wash/blow-dry.
This wouldn't be expensive at all for this location.
If the service had been more appropriate. 😭

It's a shame there aren't many nap/sleep salons in this area. This is constructive criticism. Keep up the good work!

reviews.name: Y
reviews.text: gowabiを取得して、予約していったら当日買ったクーポンではできないと言われた。どこにも記載はない。理由も説明されない。オーナーが不誠実な店です。gowabiではなく、店のプロモーションで使えと言われた。ちなみに規約など書いていなかったし、到着する三時間前には購入していました。必要であればもっとわかりやすく記載するべきです。交通費が無駄になりました。
reviews.textTranslated: I obtained a Gowabi coupon and made a reservation, but on the day of my visit I was told it couldn't be used with the coupon I bought. There was no mention of this anywhere. No explanation was given. The owner of this shop is dishonest. I was told to use it for the shop's promotion, not Gowabi. By the way, there were no terms and conditions written down, and I had purchased it three hours before arriving. If it's necessary, it should be written more clearly. My travel expenses were wasted.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We apologize for the inconvenience. We understand for customers who want to buy cheap promotions from the website, but since the price is for a reservation one day in advance, but the customer just bought the coupon when they arrived at the store, we cannot violate the terms and conditions set for the website. However, the shop would like to apologize again for the inconvenience. 

ご不便をおかけして申し訳ございません。ウェブサイトからお得なクーポンを購入したいというお客様の気持ちはよくわかりますが、前日予約の価格であり、お客様は店舗に到着してクーポンを購入しただけなので、ウェブサイトに設定されている利用規約に違反することはできません。しかし、お店としては、ご不便をおかけしたことに改めてお詫び申し上げます。

reviews.name: Miles
reviews.text: There are two other massage places (Anda and Thip) just a bit further up the road. But Kim's massage is No 1 for me. For the foot massage the reclining chairs are so comfortable and the sound of water running into the small fish pond is very relaxing. You get what you pay for, a little more expensive at 500 Bht for the one hour oil massage (Anda 450 Bht and Thip 400 Bht). Anda is next best but Thip not very good as you have curtained booths instead of a private room, but more importantly the massage therapist I had didn't seem very experienced and was rather heavy handed. Go to Kim's.

reviews.name: 난1조인
reviews.text:
남자마사지사가 제 가슴과 팬티를 지속적으로 쳐다봤습니다.
커플로 오늘 발마사지 받고왔습니다.
전 여자마사지사가, 남자친구는 ‘콧수염과 턱수염이 난 남자마사지사’가 해줬습니다.
날이 더워서 민소매 원피스를 입고갔는데 다리를 위로 뻗어 마사지 받는 동작을 할때 “남자 마사지사가 계속 팬티를 쳐다보더군요.”
처음엔 인지를 못했어요. 돈 내고 받는 마사지숍에서 마사지사가 자기 옆에있는 고객 몸을 계속 쳐다볼줄은 몰랐거든요.
마사지가 거의 끝날때쯤 압이 세서 너무 아파 고개를 올리고 알았어요. 저랑 눈이 마주친 이후에도 그때만 잠시 안보다가 어김없이 계속 쳐다봤어요. 가슴을 보다가 가슴을 가리면 팬티를 보고, 손마사지를 해야해서 가슴 가리던 손을 떼면 가슴을 보고.
너무나 불쾌했습니다. 처음부터 알아챘다면 마사지 도중 나갔을거에요.
reviews.textTranslated:
The male masseur continuously stared at my breasts and underwear.

We went for a foot massage today as a couple.

A female masseur treated me, while a male masseur with a mustache and beard treated my boyfriend.

It was hot, so I wore a sleeveless dress. When I stretched my legs upward to receive the massage, "the male masseur kept staring at my underwear."

At first, I didn't realize it. I never imagined that a masseur at a massage shop, where I was paying for a massage, would keep staring at the body of the customer next to him.

Towards the end of the massage, the pressure was so strong that it hurt so much that I looked up and realized it. Even after our eyes met, he didn't look for a moment, but then he continued to stare without fail. He would look at my breasts, then when I covered them, he would look at my underwear; and when I removed my hand to perform a hand massage, he would look at my breasts again.

It was extremely unpleasant. If I had noticed from the beginning, I would have walked out in the middle of the massage.

1시간에 300바트이고 남자는 남자 마사지사가 여자는 여자 마사지사가 해주는데 다들 베테랑인지 진짜 잘해요:)
심지어 그나마 초보티나는 사람도 매우 잘해서 받으면서 숙면했습니다ㅎㅎ
reviews.textTranslated:
During my trip with my parents, we each got massages three times at different places, and my family couldn't forget this place ㅠㅎㅎ👍
It must be famous even among locals, because there was a constant stream of customers. There were no forced tips, and the Thai owners were very friendly!!
It costs 300 baht per hour, and there were male and female masseuses for men and women, respectively. They were all veterans, so they were really good :)
Even my novice friend was so good that I slept soundly while getting the massage. ㅎㅎ

title: Anantara Spa at Anantara Chiang Mai
