reviews.name: Kylia West
reviews.text: The hostpitality at Anantara is unmatched. This was my first experience with Thai massage. They graciously explained the process to me, welcomed us with iced lemongrass tea and gave us hot ginger tea after the massage. The room is spacious and beautifully serene. They gave us cotton clothing to put on for the massage. I recommend that anyone plus size wear a stretchy jumpsuit of sweats because  the Thai sizes are small. The massage starts with a foot scrub and wash and then you are covered with towels for the massage. Bea was truly wonderful! The stretching and body weight pressure of a Thai massage gave my neck real relief unlike sweedish massages have in the past.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Kylia,

Thank you very much for sharing such a thoughtful and detailed review, along with your lovely photos. We are delighted to hear that your first experience with Thai massage was memorable and that our team made you feel welcomed and well taken care of from the moment you arrived.

It is wonderful to know that you enjoyed our herbal welcome drinks, the serene treatment room, and the traditional Thai massage rituals starting with the foot scrub. We are especially pleased to hear that Bea provided you with such excellent care and that the stretching and pressure techniques offered real relief for your neck.

Your helpful tip regarding attire for plus-size guests is greatly appreciated and will certainly benefit future visitors.

Thank you once again for choosing Anantara Spa. We hope to welcome you back for another deeply relaxing and rejuvenating experience.

Warm regards,
Arnaud Béril
Cluster General Manager

reviews.name: Win Tai
reviews.text: I tired out the spa it's not worth it. The therapist here can not compare to the spa outside if you can find the right one. Pressure not there it's relaxing but seriously did nothing to release tension in muscles. They really need proper therapist to survive.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Win Tai,

Sawasdee jao!

Thank you for sharing your feedback regarding your recent visit to our spa. We genuinely appreciate your input as it helps us improve our services. We apologize for not meeting your expectations and for any inconvenience caused during your experience.

We understand the importance of skilled therapists who can provide the appropriate pressure and effectively release tension in muscles. Our team is dedicated to continuously enhancing our services, and your feedback will be invaluable in this process.

We would love the opportunity to make it up to you and ensure your next visit is a more satisfying one. Please feel free to contact our management team directly, and they will be happy to discuss your concerns in detail and explore how we can better meet your expectations.

Thank you again for your feedback. We hope to have the chance to exceed your expectations in the future and provide you with a truly rejuvenating spa experience.

Best regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: Brinda Govindarajan
reviews.text:
We recently experienced Yam Khang Massage at Anantara Resort Chiang Mai with high hopes, but unfortunately our experience fell short of expectations. While the concept of an outdoor massage amidst nature is lovely, the location overlooking guest rooms steals privacy, the swimming pool filled with kids screaming and a wedding area blaring loud music made it challenging to relax and enjoy from the peaceful ambiance we were seeking.

This unique foot massage technique demands a high level of skill and practice. Specifically, I felt that my therapist lacked the finesse and experience required for it. The pressure and strokes were uneven, it didn't quite meet my expectations. In contrast, my husband was very pleased with his therapist’s massage skill.

To conclude, both of us couldn't fully enjoy the experience due to the environment. Perhaps considering a more secluded or soundproof area would enhance the overall experience and credit this rare, ancient Lanna Thai fire massage, where therapists use their feet dipped in herbal oil to massage, to relax and rejuvenate the muscles. We appreciate the effort and courtesy of the staff and hope these suggestions are helpful for future improvements.

reviews.name: Chris Cheng
reviews.text: I had a 90 mins Spa and it was fantastic, the staffs are warmhearted and polite. I enjoyed the massage very much as well, definitely will come back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Chris Cheng,

Thank you for taking the time to share your positive experience with us! We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your 90-minute spa session and felt well taken care of by our warmhearted and polite staff. Providing exceptional experiences for our guests is our top priority, and we're thrilled to know that we met your expectations.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating and enjoyable spa. If there's anything specific you would like on your next visit, feel free to let us know. We appreciate your feedback and value your continued patronage.

Best regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: HangDong Farang
reviews.text: My wife and I had super time here today. Her therapist was Pii Mintra and my therapist was Pii Bee. Both of the ladies were excellent. Perfect pressure that was very relaxing and therapeutic. Also, these are the most comfortable massage beds we have been on. Great atmosphere. Very highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear HangDong Farang,

Thank you for taking the time to share your kind feedback. We're delighted to hear that you and your wife had such a wonderful experience at Anantara Spa.

Pii Mintra and Pii Bee will be so pleased to know their care and technique made your visit relaxing and therapeutic — we’re very lucky to have them on our team. We're also glad you appreciated the comfort of our massage beds and the peaceful atmosphere.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you both back again soon for another rejuvenating escape.

Warm regards,
Arnaud Béril
Cluster General Manager

reviews.name: Vasilisa
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Anantara Spa! I had a Tok Sen massage and it was so relaxing & rejuvenating.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Ms. Vasilisa Motsiou,

Thank you for sharing your wonderful experience at Anantara Spa! We’re thrilled to hear that you loved your Tok Sen massage and found it relaxing and rejuvenating. Our spa team works hard to provide guests with a truly soothing experience, and we’re glad to know it made such an impression on you.

We hope to welcome you back for another relaxing visit soon!

Warm regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: Dej DJ
reviews.text: Top spa in Chiang Mai. Well built and designed. Quality products. Well trained therapist and receptionist.

reviews.name: Amanda Francis
reviews.text: There are many other spas / massage providers across Chiang Mai that provide better value for money and a more superior massage. We went here on New Year’s Eve and were told on arrival only there would be a little bit of noise during the massage - this was despite having booked the massage weeks in advance (they could have told us at that point, as they would have known there would be loud resort celebrations - we were not guests at the hotel). There was actually extensive noise from the New Year’s Eve celebrations at the hotel which meant we could hear the base of music during our massage. The massage itself wasn’t as relaxing as we had hoped, and despite being asked which areas they should focus on, they barely focused on these areas. We were also not allowed to shower after the massage as the oil is meant to be good for us, but they should be aware that this is not everyone’s preference. For 4000 plus baht per person, it was not worth it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Amanda Francis,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback regarding your recent massage experience at our spa on New Year's Eve. We're incredibly sorry to hear that it fell short of your expectations and did not leave you feeling relaxed and rejuvenated.

We understand your frustration over the unexpected noise from the resort celebrations. It's completely unacceptable that we didn't inform you about this possibility during your booking, especially considering you booked weeks in advance. We acknowledge that we let you down in this regard, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and disappointment it caused.

We also take your concerns about the massage itself seriously. It's disheartening to learn that the therapists didn't focus on the areas you requested and that the overall experience wasn't as relaxing as you had hoped. We prioritize tailoring treatments to individual needs and preferences, and we clearly missed the mark in this instance.

Additionally, we appreciate your feedback regarding the post-massage showering policy. While we believe there can be benefits to allowing the massage oils to absorb, we understand that this isn't everyone's preference. We will definitely discuss this internally and consider offering guests the option to shower after their treatments in the future.

For the price you paid, it's understandable that you feel the experience did not offer good value for money. We strive to provide exceptional service and value at all times, and we clearly fell short on this occasion.

We deeply value your feedback, and we assure you that we are taking your concerns seriously. We are actively reviewing our communication and service protocols to ensure that guests are clearly informed of any potential disruptions and that massages are tailored to individual needs. We are also considering revising our post-massage showering policy to accommodate guest preferences.

Thank you once again for your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the disappointment and hope to have the opportunity to regain your trust in the future.

Sincerely,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: jk jk
reviews.text:
아로마오일 했어요.
가격은 좀 비쌌지만 적당한 압으로 마사지 해줘서 좋았어요.
오일은 네가지 향중에 선택할수 있고 룸에 머리빗 헤어드라이어 등 기본 시설은 다 있어서 좋아요.
마사지 후 윗층으로 이동해서 쉬다갈수있게 자리를 마련해줘서 더 좋았어요.
reviews.textTranslated:
I had the aromatherapy oil massage.

It was a bit expensive, but I liked that they massaged me with just the right amount of pressure.

You can choose from four different oil scents, and it is nice that the room is equipped with basic amenities like a comb and hairdryer.

It was even better that they arranged a space for me to rest upstairs after the massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun JK,

Thank you very much for sharing your feedback on your spa experience. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the aroma oil massage, the choice of scents, and the well-equipped treatment room. It is also wonderful to know that the relaxation area after your treatment added to your comfort.

Your kind comments will be shared with our spa team as encouragement. We look forward to welcoming you back to Anantara Chiang Mai Resort for another relaxing and enjoyable visit.

Warm regards,
Arnaud Béril
Cluster General Manager

reviews.name: Siripan H.
reviews.text:
Therapist เก่งมาก​ ทุกครั้งที่มาเชียงใหม่จะต้องมานวดไทย​ 2 ชั่วโมง​ ที่นี่ทุกครั้ง​ นวดเสร็จตัวเบา​ สบาย​ มากๆ​ ระหว่างนวดก็รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย​ บรรยากาศ​และการตกแต่งห้องสมกับที่เป็นสปาช่วยผ่อนคลาย​ได้มาก

The therapist here is excellent. Every time I come to Chiang Mai, I always get a 2-hour Thai massage at this place. After the massage, my body feels so light and comfortable. During the massage, I feel very relaxed. The atmosphere and the room decoration are truly spa-like, which greatly helps with relaxation.
reviews.textTranslated: The therapist is excellent. Every time I come to Chiang Mai, I always get a 2-hour Thai massage here. After the massage, I feel so light and comfortable. During the massage, I felt very relaxed. The atmosphere and room decoration are truly spa-like and very conducive to relaxation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Siripan H,

Thank you so much for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that our therapist and spa atmosphere keep you coming back every time you visit Chiang Mai.

It’s wonderful to know that the massage helps you feel relaxed, light, and comfortable. We truly appreciate your continued support and look forward to welcoming you again soon for your next 2-hour Thai massage!

Kind regards,

Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager
Anantara Chiang Mai Resort

reviews.name: HSIN
reviews.text:
Best spa ever. 超級推薦！服務、細節、環境滿分！
芳香療法或深層組織按摩 [90 分鐘]Aromatic or Deep tissue Massage [90 Minutes]
買Klook按摩通票，選這家是最好的！超級划算！
按摩師Bee按的非常好，在我多次來泰國旅遊裡的按摩第一名！非常舒服！
按摩躺的床是恆溫的，蓋眼睛是熱敷墊子，音樂也選的很好，這些細節是以往高級按摩店所沒有的
reviews.textTranslated:
Best spa ever! Highly recommended! Service, attention to detail, and ambiance are all perfect!

Aromatic or Deep Tissue Massage [90 Minutes] Buying a Klook massage pass, this is the best choice! Super cost-effective!

Massage therapist Bee's massage was excellent, the number one massage I've had during my many trips to Thailand! Very comfortable!

The massage bed is heated, the eye covers are covered with heated pads, and the music is well-chosen. These details are something I haven't seen in other high-end massage parlors.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear HSIN,

Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback and for sharing your experience with us! 

We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your massage and found it to be the best during your visits to Thailand—what an honor! Bee will be so pleased to know her skillful massage made such a positive impression on you.

We’re glad you appreciated the thoughtful details, such as the heated massage bed, the soothing eye compress, and the carefully selected music. Your kind words affirm our commitment to creating a relaxing and unforgettable spa experience for our guests.

Thank you also for recommending us and highlighting the value of the Klook massage pass. We hope to welcome you back soon for another exceptional and relaxing session! 

Sincerely,

Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager
Anantara Chiang Mai Resort

reviews.name: Tonic Chau
reviews.text:
超級喜歡ANANTARA Spa，她環境舒適，首先可以讓客人選擇自己喜歡的香薰油，而房間設施更一流！床喺電動嘅，床褥仲要非常之舒服💯當瞓上床時，技師已經幫你開了適當溫度嘅暖墊，空調校得非常恰當，每樣剛剛好💯最意想不到的係技師每次替你身上塗上按摩油時，那些按摩油是溫暖的💯超級細心♥️好鐘意ANANTARA Spa😍按完之後就可到旁邊的The Service 1921 Restaurant晚餐！清邁最享受的一天😍
特別要讚揚兩位技師：Yim and Nadear 貼心服務非常之好🙏🏼感謝她們
reviews.textTranslated: I absolutely loved ANANTARA Spa! The environment was so comfortable, and they let guests choose their own aromatherapy oils. The room facilities were top-notch! The bed was electric, and the mattress was incredibly comfortable 💯. When I got into bed, the masseuse had already turned on the heated mattress at the perfect temperature, and the air conditioning was set just right – everything was perfect 💯. The most unexpected thing was that the massage oils the masseuse applied were always warm 💯. So thoughtful! ♥️ I love ANANTARA Spa 😍 After the massage, I went to The Service 1921 Restaurant next door for dinner! My most enjoyable day in Chiang Mai 😍. Special praise to the two masseuses, Yim and Nadear, for their excellent and attentive service 🙏🏼 Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun Tonic Chau,

Thank you for taking the time to share your incredible experience at the Anantara Spa. I am delighted to learn that every aspect of your visit exceeded your expectations and provided you with a truly luxurious and memorable day in Chiang Mai.

Your praise for our comfortable environment and personalized touches, such as allowing guests to choose their preferred aromatherapy oil, is greatly appreciated. We understand that these little details can make all the difference in creating a truly indulgent and tailored experience for our valued guests.

I'm thrilled to know that you found our room facilities to be exceptional, from the electric bed and comfortable mattress to the thoughtful touches like the pre-heated massage bed and perfectly calibrated air conditioning. Our team takes great pride in ensuring that every element is meticulously prepared to provide you with the utmost relaxation and comfort.

Your commendation of our attentive technicians, who went the extra mile to ensure your massage oils were warmly applied throughout your treatment, is truly heartwarming. Their dedication to delivering a seamless and personalized experience is a testament to the high standards of service we uphold at the Anantara Spa.

Thank you for highlighting the convenience of being able to seamlessly transition from the spa to our renowned The Service 1921 Restaurant for a delightful dining experience. We strive to create a holistic journey of indulgence for our guests, and I'm pleased that we were able to deliver on that promise.

Your glowing recommendation and intention to return to the Anantara Spa is the highest compliment we could receive. We look forward to welcoming you back and continuing to provide you with exceptional experiences that exceed your every expectation.

Sincerely,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: Gamberi tour 감베리의 밤새우는 여행
reviews.text:
아난타라 치앙마이 리조트 숙박하면서
저녁 9시 타임 마지막 시간대 예약해서 다녀왔어요.

편한차림으로 방에서 몇발자국만 나가면 스파라 매우 편해요. 1층 데스크에서 예약확인하고 종이에 앞뒤로 마사지 관련한 (집중하고 싶은 부위/피하고싶은부위) 정보 기재한 후 오일마사지로 예약해서 원하는 아로마오일 선택이 가능했어요.

지하1층으로 내려가서 옷갈아입고 입구에 놓은 조그만한 징(?)을 치면 마사지사분들이 들어와주세요.
룸안에 샤워실 화장실 파우더룸 있어편해요!
마사지 마친 뒤 1.5층 올라가면 간단한 과자와 따뜻한 차를 주시는데 과자가 누룽지 튀긴거 위에 한과처럼 약간 끈적이는 느낌인데 고소하고 맛있어요 (빅C마켓에서도 팔더라구요) 서비스 매우 친절하고 프라이빗한 공간에서 온전히 집중해서 마사지 받을수있었어요!
reviews.textTranslated:
While staying at the Anantara Chiang Mai Resort, I made a reservation for the last slot, 9 PM.

The spa was just a few steps from my room, so it was very convenient. I confirmed my reservation at the desk on the first floor, filled out a piece of paper with information about the massage (what areas I wanted to focus on and what areas I wanted to avoid), and then booked an oil massage, choosing my preferred aroma oil.

I went down to the basement level to change, and then struck the small gong at the entrance to have the masseuses come in.
The room had a shower, bathroom, and powder room, which was convenient!
After the massage, I went up 1.5 floors to the spa, where they served snacks and warm tea. The snacks were slightly sticky, like fried rice cakes with a Korean twist, and were delicious. (They're also sold at Big C Market.) The service was very friendly, and I was able to fully focus on the massage in a private space!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Gamberi tour,

Thank you for sharing your experience at Anantara Chiang Mai Resort's spa. It sounds like you had a truly relaxing and convenient spa experience.

It's great to know that you found the spa facilities to be easily accessible from your room and that the reservation process was straightforward. Being able to choose your preferred aroma oil is a nice touch, allowing you to personalize your massage experience.

The availability of a shower, toilet, and powder room in the spa room adds to the convenience, and it's wonderful that you enjoyed the post-massage snacks and warm tea. Your description of the snacks is quite vivid!

We're pleased to hear that the service was friendly, and you were able to fully relax and enjoy your massage in a private setting.

Thank you for choosing our spa for your relaxation, and we hope to welcome you back for another rejuvenating experience in the future. If you have any more insights or feedback to share, please feel free to do so. Your comments help us improve and provide exceptional service to our guests.

Best regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: Sienna Y
reviews.text:
아난타라 마사지 유명하다고해서
꼭가봐야지했는데 카사라 베네핏에 마사지
쿠폰있어서 방문했는데 그냥너무평범했음.
부드러운거 좋아하는데 압이 너무약했음.
이렇게 베네핏있다면 몰라도
내돈내고 방문할 의사는 없음.
reviews.textTranslated:
I heard Anantara massages are famous, so I really wanted to visit. I went because I had a massage coupon from the Casara benefits, but it was just too ordinary.

I prefer a gentle massage, but the pressure was too weak.

I wouldn't mind paying out of pocket, even if there were benefits like this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Sienna Y,

Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us.

We're sorry to hear that your massage, experience at Kasara Benefit did not meet your expectations. We strive to provide high-quality spa services, and your feedback is valuable to us as we continually work to improve.   

We encourage you to try our Anantara Spa on your next visit. Our therapists are highly trained and can customize treatments to your specific preferences. We're confident that you'll have a more enjoyable experience.

Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,

Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager
Anantara Chiang Mai Resort

reviews.name: 김수안
reviews.text:
마사지 최고였어요
적당한 압, 어디가 불편한지 딱 알고 만져주는,,
다시 간다면 또 만나고싶을 정도 ㅠㅠ
치앙마이에서 유일하게 미리 예약하고 돈을 좀 쓴곳인데 후회없고 다시 가고싶다 할 정도로 추천!!
reviews.textTranslated:
The massage was amazing. The pressure was just right, and she knew exactly where I was feeling.
If I were to go back, I'd definitely go back. ㅠㅠ
This was the only place in Chiang Mai where I had to make a reservation in advance and spend a bit of money, but I have no regrets and would definitely go back. I highly recommend it!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear 김수안,

Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback. We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your massage and that our therapists were able to provide just the right pressure and focus on your areas of discomfort.

It is especially gratifying to know that your experience exceeded your expectations and that you would love to return. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back to our spa for another relaxing and rejuvenating experience.

Warm regards,
Arnaud Béril
Cluster General Manager

reviews.name: HYEONJAE YU
reviews.text:
평소 마사지 좋아해서 자주 받는편입니다
오일2시간받았고 스트롱을 선호하는편이라 예약부터 스트롱으로 미리 이야기를 해놔서 그런지 아주 시원하게 잘 받고왔습니다
호텔스파라서 가격대는 좀 있지만 만족스러웠습니다 다음에 치앙마이 온다면 또 갈생각입니다
reviews.textTranslated:
I usually enjoy massages and get them often.

I received a 2-hour oil massage. Since I prefer a strong massage, I specifically requested it when booking, and perhaps because of that, I had a very refreshing and satisfying session.

Because it is a hotel spa, the price is a bit high, but I was satisfied. If I visit Chiang Mai again, I plan to go back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear 유현재,

Delighted to hear your fondness for massages brought you to our spa, and even more thrilled you left refreshed and satisfied! We understand seeking that perfect pressure, and appreciate you mentioning your preference for strong during reservation – sounds like it hit the spot! While we acknowledge our prices reflect the luxurious hotel setting, we prioritize an experience worth remembering, and we're glad you feel it delivered. Your promise to return to our massage haven on your next Chiang Mai visit warms our hearts – we can't wait to welcome you back for another revitalizing session! And if you ever have suggestions for how we can enhance your spa experience, please don't hesitate to share – your feedback helps us constantly evolve. Until then, happy travels and happy massages!

Best regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: ouahiba karri
reviews.text:
Le massage était incroyable en revanche pour le prix proposé en Thaïlande je suis très déçu de ne pas avoir eu accès à la piscine de l’hôtel ni au sauna ou autre activité normalement proposé dans un spa.

Par ailleurs juste près le spa vous êtes invité à vous reposer dans la salle de départ aucune salle de pause mise à disposition je m’attendais à des aménagements digne d’un grand spa ce ne fut pas le cas donc un peu déçu.
reviews.textTranslated:
The massage was incredible; however, for the price offered in Thailand, I was very disappointed not to have access to the hotel pool, sauna, or other activities normally offered in a spa.

Furthermore, right next to the spa, you are invited to relax in the departure lounge; no rest area was provided. I expected facilities worthy of a high-end spa, which was not the case, so I was a little disappointed.

reviews.name: 윤정원
reviews.text:
치앙마이에서의 최고의 마사지
3박동안 2번 방문했고 Sumitra 와 Tan 이라는 이름의 마사지사 추천합니다
마사지도 잘하고 친절해요
reviews.textTranslated:
The best massage in Chiang Mai

I visited twice during my 3-night stay and recommend masseuses named Sumitra and Tan.

They are skilled at massage and friendly.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear 윤정원,

Sawasdee jao!

Thank you for sharing your kind review for Anantara Spa. We're delighted to receive such a glowing review rating! And we hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you again very soon.

Best regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: 김스티브
reviews.text:
2024년 6월 22일 오후 6시에 다녀왔어요.
여행 마지막날 시그니처 맛사지 받았어요. 레이트체크아웃 후 비행기 시간이 남아 오일 마사지 후의 끈적임이 싫어서 좀 비싸지만 샤워가 가능했던 아난타라 스파를 예약했어요. 역시 비싼만큼 서비스 과정 하나하나가 너무 훌룽했어요. 특히 맛사지 침대는 온열기능과 그 푹신함이 이제까지 다녀본 곳 중에서 최고 였습니다. 그리고 어떤 오일을 사용하는지 몰라도 맛사지 후 샤워하지 않았는데도 끈적임이 전혀없고 너무 좋네요. ㅎㅎ
아난타라 투숙객은 해피아워(10시~14시?) 25% 할인 됐지만 몽키트래블이 좀 더 저렴했어요.
아난타라 투숙하면서 왜 싼 맛사지만 찾아 다녔는지 후회되더라고요. 리뷰에 압이 약해서 별로라는 분들도 계셨는데, 강력한 압을 원하시면 리조트 근처에 있는  “모란 타이 마사지 치앙마이 태국 Peony Thai Massage พีโอนีไทยมาสสาจ” 방문해 보세요. 가격 저렴하고 압은 최고 였어요.
아난타라 투숙하시면 꼭 한번 이용해 보세요.
reviews.textTranslated:
I visited on June 22, 2024, at 6 PM.

I received a signature massage on the last day of my trip. Since I had some time before my flight after a late check-out, and I dislike the stickiness often left after oil massages, I booked the Anantara Spa. Although it was a bit expensive, I chose it because showering was available. As expected, every single aspect of the service was excellent, living up to the price. In particular, the massage bed had a heating function and was the best I’ve ever experienced. Also, I don't know what kind of oil they use, but even though I didn't shower after the massage, there was absolutely no stickiness, which was fantastic. Haha.

Anantara guests get a 25% discount during Happy Hour (10 AM to 2 PM?), but Monkey Travel was slightly cheaper.

While staying at Anantara, I regretted only looking for cheap massages. Some reviews mentioned that the pressure was weak and not very good, but if you prefer strong pressure, please visit “Peony Thai Massage Chiang Mai Thailand พีโอนีไทยมาสสาจ” located near the resort. The price was affordable and the pressure was top-notch.

If you are staying at Anantara, be sure to give it a try.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear 김스티브,

Thank you for sharing your detailed experience at Anantara Spa. We're delighted that you chose to end your trip with one of our signature massages.

It's wonderful to hear that you found our spa services excellent, despite the higher price point. We're particularly pleased that you appreciated our massage beds with heating function and optimal softness. Your comments about the non-sticky quality of our oils are also gratifying - we carefully select our products to enhance our guests' comfort.

We're glad you were able to take advantage of our spa facilities, including the shower, after your late check-out. It's our goal to ensure our guests feel refreshed and relaxed, especially before a flight.

Thank you for mentioning our happy hour discount for Anantara guests. We'll ensure this information is more prominently displayed for future guests.

We appreciate your honest feedback about initially seeking cheaper massage options during your stay. Your recommendation to try our spa services is the highest compliment.

Your tip about "Peony Thai Massage" for those seeking stronger pressure is thoughtful. While we're glad you found a service that suited your needs, we'd love to hear more about your pressure preferences so we can better accommodate them in the future.

Thank you again for choosing Anantara Spa. We hope to welcome you back for more relaxing experiences in the future.

Best regards,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Khun 이서하

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. Your feedback is invaluable as it helps us identify areas where we can improve.

We are truly disappointed to hear that your massage did not meet your expectations. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional spa services, and it is clear that we fell short in this instance.

Your description of the massage is concerning, and we will investigate this matter thoroughly. We understand that you enjoy strong massages, and it is unacceptable that your requests were not honored.

We sincerely apologize for the disappointment and inconvenience caused. To ensure this does not happen again, we will be retraining our massage therapists on the importance of listening to and addressing guests’ specific preferences.

Again, we apologize for any disappointment caused and appreciate your honest feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to regain your trust and provide you with a massage experience that meets your expectations.

We believe that direct communication will help us understand the situation better and take corrective actions. Please contact Khun Panisara Narachotvanich, Spa Manager directly at her email address panisara_na@anantara.com 

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention.

Sincerely,

Chin Pitak Norathepkitti
General Manager

reviews.name: 陈蕾
reviews.text:
WORST MASSAGE SHOP IN PHUKET - AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
Total nightmare experience, absolute garbage service—never step foot here! It’s in a good location with nice decor, which tricked us into walking in, but what followed was the most terrible, infuriating massage I’ve ever had in my life.

No greetings, no service, no one even helped with our shoes—basic hospitality is non-existent here! They dumped freezing cold water on my feet for a foot wash; when I asked for warm water, the masseuse snapped at me rudely and yelled "NO", then roughly grabbed my feet and wiped them with a dirty towel that’s clearly been used for countless people. Disgusting hygiene, utterly vile attitude!

The massage was even worse—this masseuse has ZERO professionalism! She spent the entire time chatting nonstop with the male therapist next to her, staring around everywhere, and her hands were basically going through the motions. Her pressure was either painfully hard or so light it felt like nothing—complete random pressing with no skill at all.

I came here to relax and unwind, but instead I left fuming with anger and more stressed out than ever. This is by far the WORST massage shop in Phuket, and this masseuse is the most unprofessional one I’ve ever met. SEE THE PICTURES, BOYCOTT THIS PLACE—don’t waste your money and ruin your mood here!

reviews.name: Vinothienie Murugaiah
reviews.text:
Absolutely terrible service. The staff were extremely rude and unprofessional. We simply asked for slightly stronger pressure during the massage, and the response was to demand an extra 200 THB. When we politely declined, their attitude completely changed.

The massage became unnecessarily rough and painful, to the point where it felt like they were intentionally hurting us for refusing to pay more. This was completely unacceptable and far from professional.

The owner seriously needs to train the staff on basic customer service and respect. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

I had a very disappointing experience at Relax Massage in Karon Beach. The staff were rude, unprofessional, and made me feel unwelcome from the moment I arrived. Customer service was poor, and they did not treat guests with the courtesy and respect you would expect from a massage spa.

I chose this place based on its location, but I regret my decision. I would not recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing or professional experience. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and improves the staff's attitude and service.

I don't recommend it as I went there last year and the girl was good but this time I took family and we all had bad experience twice. Gave it a chance, but I don't recommend for anyone else who wants to enjoy. Bad massage, don't tip

reviews.name: Tristan Borgato
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience at this massage salon. The therapists kept talking to each other the entire time, which completely ruined any sense of relaxation. After finishing the full body massage, the therapist didn’t even wash her hands before moving on to my face — that’s absolutely unacceptable and unhygienic. I definitely do not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.name: Cindy
reviews.text:
The receptionist at this shop was extremely rude and kept giving people condescending looks. It really feels like people in Thailand have changed a lot. As soon as I walked in, she signaled with her eyes for me to take off my shoes, then immediately told me the price and said “Pay first!” in a very rude tone. If it hadn’t been raining and I didn’t want to walk elsewhere, I would never have chosen this place.

When I sat down and said I wanted to try some colors, she came over and said “One hand! One hand!” to me like that — completely lacking even the most basic professional manners. It was honestly very unpleasant.

On top of that, the color selection was limited, and they were not very willing to help me choose.

reviews.name: Christel
reviews.text: Definitely a 5 star. It's very spacious inside. Amazing staff. Professional and friendly. Fairly priced too. Highly recommend this spa 👌

reviews.name: Eve Richardson
reviews.text: Wish I read the reviews before stepping foot in here. Not friendly at all, the staff were laughing and talking throughout the entire service. Was taken upstairs to basically a room full of beds, no privacy, could see the people below in seven eleven eating their lunch. Terrible massage too

reviews.name: Ashwin Iyer
reviews.text:
The Therapist Bella was excellent and very professional 👏 foot massage was so relaxing ... good knowledge and very friendly...
Ashwin Iyer

reviews.name: Nebi Hailu
reviews.text: Worest place ever, for manicure and pedicure not clean trash place very rude customer service no English at all shouthing and treat customer if you need explanation don't know how this business exists. I would not recommend this place for anyone.

reviews.name: Ahmed Hadid
reviews.text: I gave two stars because the shop looked great but that’s kind of where it ends the lady on the door looked like she didn’t want to be there no greeting just talking with a condescending tone the massage was okay but they wouldn’t stop talking to each other not even focusing on what there doing there are better shops around I wouldn’t come back to this place

reviews.name: Mustafa Abu-hijleh
reviews.text: Massage places are places you go to relax and unwind , this massage place is different. From the door your met with a really impatient receptionist ( she really seemed like she hated her job ), she doesn’t speak English and is rushing!!! trying to upsell whatever she can . Voice is almost screaming , I mean I left without getting my foot massage that I wanted !! paying a penny there would be stupid at this point !! What about the people that are getting massages while she’s screaming … they have already payed and are stuck with this 1 star service !! I wouldn’t recommend this experience to anyone !! Service here is below zero !!

reviews.name: Наталья Гриценко
reviews.text: Braids started falling apart already on the next day and it costed 1800 bat… Foot massage is ok, but oil massage was disgusting, I was washed with oil by some kind of grandma rather than massaged.

reviews.name: NAZ 5.0
reviews.text: Great service and variety of options. Lots of specials on offer as well. The staff is very friendly and offer a great massage. Another customer extended his 1hr massage to a 2hr massage, so they definitely doing a great job. We loved our Foot Massage and Foot Scrubs. Thank you!

reviews.name: Shreya Batra
reviews.text: Massage was good but the ambience was not at all conducive to relaxation. The two therapists continued to chat between them making it very difficult to relax and enjoy the massage. The ambient noise was way too much for a good massage, there was no relaxing music in the background. Had way better massages at a better or same price at other places.

reviews.name: hritika shah
reviews.text: I’ve gotten quiet a few massages now in my trip to Phuket and this was honestly the worst one. I asked for Thai massage with oil, there was nothing Thai about it. It wasn’t even a proper basic oil massage and the staff is extremely rude. They’re not willing to listen to you at all. They act like they’re the best masseuses in the city without the knowledge or skills to back it up. Please don’t waste your money and instead go to better massage parlours near Bangla Road.

reviews.name: Avigail Perl
reviews.text:
Truly the worst place I’ve been at in all of Thailand…

Here’s why:
1) The lady had no clue what she’s doing. 2) They told me a pedicure is 250b but when I came to pay after it was all finished, they suddenly asked for 550b saying they also did a scrub (but no one told me they were doing a scrub and that it was an extra 300b on top of the 250 they offered!!!!!)
3) When the lady who started couldn’t even put nail polish, another woman came in and put more layers - it was so thick and clumsy looking!!!
4) I then had to argue with them regarding the price and felt so disgusting doing so (knowing they lied to me).
5) Just a few hours later - every single nail was completely ruined!!!! See the pics…

I literally wasted 400b on a horrible experience!

Shame on this place! I have never been so disappointed… Such a tourist trap.

reviews.name: Sapna Punjabi
reviews.text: Horrible place. Rude lady who gave massage. Just kept frowning all the time. Even the quality of the massage was really sad. Would recommend nobody to go there

reviews.name: Verônica Carvalho
reviews.text: Fha is the best nails artist ever. Very professional e take care about every single details .

Even pedicure was below basic, without puffing and proper removing cuticles and cost is 800 Bhatt...!! The way the staff dealt with us was very bad..
I don't recommend this place at all...

reviews.name: thay
reviews.text: I was careless. My cash was stolen. It was probably around 2,700 to 2,800 baht. I don't know if there was an accomplice or if it was a solo perpetrator. I didn't think the therapist would be able to handle it, so it may have been someone else who did it while I was showering. Maybe the therapist who helped me was innocent. The service was good, so I'm very disappointed. If you're going, please only bring cash that you need. I haven't had any card thefts so far, but if they do, I will file a complaint. The owner should educate the staff. I'll cooperate if an investigation is conducted. Please leave a comment.

reviews.name: Royal Pugness
reviews.text:
Women average to above average looking. Some cute, but no stunners.

I’d give the place 2.5 stars, but for a place which advertises “completely satisfactory service & price” I strongly disagree. I’ve given them 3 chances and tried 3 different girls and each time left “unsatisfied”. They were apologetic which is good, however I doubt customers go to these places looking for apologies.

It’s not the worst place,  but there are better options in bkk and unless there are some significant improvements I wouldn’t return or recommend at this time.

reviews.name: 曼谷上门服务escort service
reviews.text: 今天运气好，遇到了一个纯朴的女孩，身材好，皮肤白，没有纹身，感觉才下水吧，技术不好，但是我喜欢。
reviews.textTranslated: I was lucky today. I met a simple and kind girl. She had a good figure, fair skin, and no tattoos. I think she was a beginner in the water and her technique wasn't great, but I liked her.

reviews.name: 徐世陪
reviews.text: 有20岁美女，虽然灯光很暗
reviews.textTranslated: There was a 20-year-old beauty, even though the lighting was dim.

reviews.name: shima 565
reviews.text:
コロナ前は本当に良かった。タイの田舎出身で素朴なタトゥーのない子が温かく迎えてくれた。数多くのマッサージに行ったが、ここはお気に入りだった。
しかし、今は女の子は事務的でマニュアル通り。オリジナリティがないので満足度は低い。
他の方も書いてあったが、明らかに50くらいのおばさんが紛れている。パネマジにまんまとやられた。女の子じゃなくて、お母さんだよ。
26歳ってそりゃないよー！確かにマッサージはうまかったし、めっちゃイってしまった。情けなくて自分が嫌になる。日本人観光客もまだまだ戻ってきてないようだ。次はもうリピートはないかな。
reviews.textTranslated:
It was really nice before COVID-19. A simple, tattoo-free girl from rural Thailand welcomed me warmly. I've been to a lot of massage parlors, but this was my favorite.
However, now the girls are very businesslike and follow the manual. There's no originality, so satisfaction is low.
As others have written, there's clearly a woman in her 50s hiding in there. I was completely fooled by the photo manipulation. She's not a girl, she's a mother.
That's not 26 years old! The massage was certainly good, and I came really hard. I feel pathetic and disgusted with myself. It seems Japanese tourists haven't returned yet. I don't think I'll be returning.

reviews.name: H S
reviews.text:
明朗会計は言わずもがなですが、バンコクのエロマで過去最高と言えるほどサービスが良かったです。
120分でも2発目は追加料金なのが唯一マイナスかな。
隣にある別の店の客引きがよく周辺にいるので、入る店がお目当てのところかどうか気をつけるといいと思います。
reviews.textTranslated:
The transparent pricing goes without saying, but the service was the best I've ever experienced at an erotic massage parlor in Bangkok.
The only downside is that even with the 120-minute package, the second round costs extra.
There are often touts from another shop next door nearby, so be careful to make sure you're entering the right place.

reviews.name: 水瀬頼
reviews.text: 年齢サバ読みすぎだろ。表記22歳とか23歳なのになんで10歳も年齢サバよんでんだよ。おばさんしかいないお化け屋敷か。普通に30代抱くんだったらビワのがましだわ。
reviews.textTranslated: He's lying about his age way too much. He's listed as 22 or 23, so why is he lying about his age by 10 years? It's like a haunted house full of old ladies. If you're just going to sleep with someone in their 30s, Biwa is better.

reviews.name: S M. (S)
reviews.text: 素晴らしいです。安くて、ハッピーエンドもあります。
reviews.textTranslated: It's great, it's cheap and it has a happy ending.

reviews.text: Expert massage staff and I recommend all to go there 🙏☺️ just a well manared

reviews.text:
Just out from an excellent couples massage. I think our practitioners were twins too.

Both myself and my wife were really happy and both had different type of massages.

So five * here. Spot on.

reviews.name: HankA Jarosova
reviews.text: Not recommend. We made reservation for certain time for 4 people. But when we came, they said “sorry, we have delay, come in 90 minutes”. This is not fair, we left for another place.

reviews.text:
Very professional and real
traditional Thai massage

reviews.name: Thiparine Wat
reviews.text: Very good massage super relaxing

reviews.name: Marian Caballero Fidalgo
reviews.text:
Pongo una estrella porque no se puede poner menos. Mi pareja y yo acudimos a este lugar para darnos unos masajes: él de espalda y hombros y yo de cabeza, y la experiencia fue absolutamente decepcionante.
En el masaje de espalda y hombros, empaparon a mi pareja en aceite de forma exagerada, hasta el punto de estropear completamente su pantalón, que quedó lleno de manchas (como se puede ver en las fotos). Al comunicarlo al personal para buscar una solución, su respuesta fue que lo laváramos nosotros, sin asumir ninguna responsabilidad ni ofrecernos siquiera una disculpa.
En cuanto a mi masaje de cabeza, la experiencia fue igual de desagradable. Me taparon los ojos con un trapo con olor a rancio, acorde con el mal olor general del local. Durante todo el masaje, la masajista no dejó de hablar y reírse con otras empleadas, haciendo imposible cualquier intento de relajación. Para colmo, gran parte del masaje lo realizó solo con una mano, cambiando a la otra cuando se cansaba. He recibido muchos masajes en Tailandia y nunca había vivido algo así.
En resumen, un servicio poco profesional, sin atención al cliente ni respeto por quienes pagan. No recomendaría este sitio bajo ningún concepto y espero que nuestra reseña sirva para evitar que otras personas pasen por una experiencia tan mala como la nuestra.
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less. My partner and I went to this place for massages: he had a back and shoulder massage, and I had a head massage, and the experience was absolutely disappointing.
During the back and shoulder massage, they soaked my partner in oil excessively, to the point of completely ruining his trousers, which were covered in stains (as you can see in the photos). When we told the staff to find a solution, their response was that we should wash them ourselves, without taking any responsibility or even offering an apology.
As for my head massage, the experience was just as unpleasant. They covered my eyes with a musty-smelling cloth, matching the general bad smell of the place. Throughout the entire massage, the masseuse kept talking and laughing with other employees, making any attempt at relaxation impossible. To top it all off, she performed most of the massage with only one hand, switching to the other when she got tired. I've had many massages in Thailand, and I've never experienced anything like this.

In short, unprofessional service, with no customer service and no respect for those who pay. I would not recommend this place under any circumstances, and I hope our review helps prevent others from having such a bad experience as ours.

reviews.name: Александр «plumbody» Бутов
reviews.text: Лучший массаж на районе! Во многих соседних елозят руками без толку. Если нужен толковый массаж - то очень рекомендую идти именно сюда
reviews.textTranslated: The best massage in the area! Many of the neighboring ones just use their hands to no avail. If you're looking for a good massage, I highly recommend going here.

reviews.name: Pavel Vasilevykh
reviews.text: Noi Massage находился в нашем отеле Golden Sand Inn, но зашли мы в него, только за два дня до конца нашего отдыха. Хочу сказать, что перепробовав многие массажки в округе, многие из них нам понравились (мы всегда делаем Thai massage), НО Noi Massage оказалась лучшая!!! Лучшая на столько, что мы договорились накануне с массажистками и пришли на массаж в день вылета домой, в 6:00 AM, а трансфер в аэропорт был уже в 7:00 AM. В итоге: 3 лучших Thai massage в конце нашего очередного отдыха на Phuket. Обязательно посетим Noi Massage в следующую поездку!
reviews.textTranslated: Noi Massage was located at our hotel, the Golden Sand Inn, but we only tried it two days before the end of our vacation. I want to say that after trying many massage parlors in the area, we liked many of them (we always get Thai massages), but Noi Massage was the best! So much so that we made arrangements with the masseuses the day before and arrived for a massage on the day of our flight home, at 6:00 AM, and the airport transfer was already at 7:00 AM. Bottom line: 3 of the best Thai massages at the end of our latest vacation in Phuket. We'll definitely visit Noi Massage on our next trip!

reviews.name: Ирина Тинигина
reviews.text: Сорри но это не расслабляющий массаж! Брала ойл массаж 60 минут за 400 батт. Меня намазали маслом, погладили, а потом чуть не раздавили.. весь сеанс массажистки болтали, громко смеялись и обсуждали что-то.  Никакого расслабления, а потом даже больше скованности в теле стало. Не рекомендую,  мой мастер работала на отвали((
reviews.textTranslated: Sorry, but this isn't a relaxing massage! I had a 60-minute oil massage for 400 baht. They oiled me up, stroked me, and then almost crushed me. The entire session, the masseuses chatted, laughed loudly, and discussed something. There was no relaxation at all, and afterwards, my body even became more tense. I don't recommend it; my therapist was a bit of a jerk.

reviews.name: Joey
reviews.text: 在中国也经常按摩，但是我个人更喜欢这种泰式的按摩，舒服大于痛，而且这家店在酒店里面，里面的按摩师都特别友好
reviews.textTranslated: I get massages frequently in China, but I personally prefer Thai massages. The comfort outweighs the pain, and this particular shop is located inside a hotel, where the masseuses are all very friendly.

reviews.name: Елена Голикова
reviews.text: Ужасно. Что то ремонтируют во время массажа - дикий шум. Массажистка одной рукой умирая делает массаж. Худший опыт за всю поездку.
reviews.textTranslated: Horrible. They were repairing something during the massage – it was incredibly noisy. The masseuse was giving the massage with one hand, almost dying. The worst experience of the entire trip.

reviews.name: Георгий Рожков
reviews.text: В первый же день попробовали здесь тайский массаж и больше уже никуда идти не захотелось. Отличный традиционный тайский массаж. Также делали спортивный массаж (более интенсивный вариант с бальзамами), арома-массаж (с маслами). Делают очень профессионально и в течении полного часа. Цены как и везде, если не дешевле. Качество на высоте. Спросите Даа (протяжная "а" на конце), не пожалеете.
reviews.textTranslated: We tried a Thai massage here on our very first day and never wanted to go anywhere else. Excellent traditional Thai massage. We also had a sports massage (a more intensive version with balms) and an aromatherapy massage (with oils). They do it very professionally and last a full hour. The prices are the same as anywhere else, if not cheaper. The quality is top-notch. Ask for "Daa" (a long "a" at the end), you won't regret it.

reviews.name: Алексей Шмелев
reviews.text: Ресторан при отеле. Очень вкусная еда, приемлемые цены, приличная обстановка.
reviews.textTranslated: The hotel restaurant. Delicious food, reasonable prices, and a pleasant atmosphere.

reviews.name: Bernhard
reviews.text: Achtung: hier werden zwei Massage Shops vermischt (siehe Fotos):  Hier geht es um die wunderbare Noi Massage, aber viele Fotos und Rezensionen beziehen sich auf die Chang Noi Massage im Ortszentrum .. ein völlig anderer Ort.
reviews.textTranslated: Attention: two massage shops are being confused here (see photos): This is about the wonderful Noi Massage, but many photos and reviews refer to the Chang Noi Massage in the town center... a completely different place.

reviews.text: 環境好，按摩舒服，店面乾淨 非常喜歡這家餐廳 在#Chang Noi Phuket 商店再次見到你。
reviews.textTranslated: The environment was great, the massage was comfortable, and the shop was clean. I really liked this restaurant. See you again at the #ChangNoi Phuket shop.

reviews.name: Patrick Oskar
reviews.text: Haven't tried the massage.. Yet, but they were amazingly helpful and kept my luggage for me all day

reviews.name: Duckie M.
reviews.text:
Update 2025: Didn’t see the same masseuses from my previous visit, so the experience might differ depending on who you get.

I always get a Thai massage here when visiting Chiang Mai. During my last visit in mid-December, I didn’t mention my sciatica, but P’Oum — my masseuse — figured it out right away and worked on it with precision. Two weeks later, the sharp pain down my right leg is gone, leaving only mild hip discomfort. I wouldn’t call it a miracle fix, but the relief is real and lasting.

My husband had a hot oil massage and was equally impressed — strong, consistent pressure throughout. We forgot to ask his therapist’s name.

reviews.name: Rachel Powell
reviews.text: Good Thai massage for the expected prices in the Nimman area. Very nice staff. The restroom is in a separate building.

reviews.name: Kellie Brown
reviews.text: I loved the ladies here. They were very sweet and personable, and their hand strength was excellent. I’m shocked they have bad reviews at all, but I highly recommend.

reviews.textTranslated: The pressure was just right, the air conditioning was very cool, and the environment was very quiet. I'll definitely come again next time!

reviews.text: オイルマッサージ400bts少し値上がりしていたが、この近くに他もなかったのでお願いしたら、全く同じ動きをずっと続けるよーなマッサージで、体はあまりほぐれませんでした。足だけはすごく丁寧にして、むくみも取れました。フット専門でボディは初心者なのか⁈
reviews.textTranslated: The oil massage was a little pricey at 400 bts, but there was nothing else nearby, so I went for it. It was a massage that continued the exact same movements over and over, so my body didn't really get loose. However, they were very gentle on my feet, and they even managed to get rid of the swelling. Maybe they specialize in feet and are beginners at body massage?

reviews.name: Num Numwa
reviews.text: บริการดีมาก พนักงานนวดมีความชำนาญ เป็นการเอง ต้อนรับดี ผ่อนคลายจริงๆ หลังนวดรู้สึกสบายตัวมาก ราคาเหมาะสม จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent service. The massage therapists were skilled, friendly, and welcoming. It was truly relaxing; I felt so much better after the massage. The price was reasonable. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.name: 王筑瑩
reviews.text:
實在很少給一星評價，原本只是懶得走出去想說試試看吧也不貴，結果有夠雷，店裡霉味重就算了，偷時間還很嚴重，我們說要按摩兩個小時，結果一個半就結束！而且整個按摩期間都按得很隨便，根本用摸的，請他們大力一點還臭臉！然後講了以後也只有在一樣的地方一直滑來滑去！然後中間一直換人按，真的搞不懂在幹嘛，第一次按到這麼火大連小費都不想給
垃圾店家還想要我們付多的錢，還對我們罵髒話，噁心死了，要不是要評論讓大家避雷，連一顆星都不想給
reviews.textTranslated: I rarely give one-star reviews, but I was just too lazy to go out and thought I'd give it a try since it wasn't expensive. It was a total disaster! The place smelled musty, and they were incredibly slow with the massage. We asked for two hours, but it only lasted an hour and a half! And the entire massage was done very casually, basically just groping. When we asked them to use more pressure, they gave us a dirty look! After we told them, they just kept sliding around in the same spots! They kept changing masseuses, I really don't understand what they were doing. This is the first time I've had such a bad massage, I don't even want to tip them. The lousy business wanted us to pay more and even swore at us. It was disgusting. If I wasn't writing this review to warn others, I wouldn't even give it one star.

reviews.text:
고정된 테라피스트가 많지 않은 듯.. 손님 오면 전화해서 부르는 가게.. 풋마사지 300밧

It seems like they don't have many regular therapists... It's a shop where they call in a therapist when a customer arrives... Foot massage 300 baht.

They roughly dry your feet with a towel, the chubby owner lady massages them a bit, and then hands them over to the therapist who called when they arrive... What a waste of money.

reviews.name: Cynthia L
reviews.text: 點了肩頸按摩+草藥球服務，預定了兩小時，反覆和店家確認，結果按了快一小時以上服務都沒有，說是泰式手法，其實根本是台式按摩，和我在清邁別家按的泰式完全不同。而且師傅按腳底時還附帶用她的指甲施力，按哪哪都覺得不舒服，師傅邊按邊說你還要再來加強，今天沒時間明天得來，邊按邊和旁邊師傅聊天，且我按摩的床頭是一面鏡子，我的頭一直被頂到鏡子上，感覺不是很專業的店家。
reviews.textTranslated: I ordered a shoulder and neck massage plus herbal ball service, booking for two hours. I repeatedly confirmed with the shop, but after almost an hour, the service was still not completed. They advertised it as Thai massage, but it was basically Taiwanese massage, completely different from the Thai massages I've had at other places in Chiang Mai. Furthermore, the masseuse used her fingernails to apply pressure while massaging my feet, making everything feel uncomfortable. The masseuse kept saying I needed to come back for more intensive treatments, and that I had to come back tomorrow if I didn't have time today. She was also chatting with another masseuse while massaging me. Plus, there was a mirror at the head of the massage bed, and my head was constantly pressed against it. It didn't feel like a very professional establishment.

reviews.name: 沈宜凌
reviews.text:
防雷文/
以下資料感謝臉書網友GillPrincess Wang於泰國旅遊自助達人社團提供（2025年2月）

#避雷

今天在清邁最後一晚，原本要去另一間按摩，父子兩個懶得走我們就飯店旁一間隨便進去了

我們說要按兩個小時，他們人生不足，等了大概20分鐘才姍姍開始，結果同樣的地方摸了快一小時，請他大力一點還臭臉，就故意拿小棒子很大力搓我，我跟他說我不想用這個，他還故意說你不是要大力嗎，然後還臭臉，直到我變臉她才停止！

全程亂按就算了，中間還一直換人，然後一個半小時就結束了，還敢跟我收兩小時🤬🤬🤬我很不爽的跟他說我只願意付一個半小時，連小費都不爽給（只有我老公的一個半小時從頭按到尾，所以有給她）

離開後🍊爸發現手機忘了拿，回去拿他們又要跟我老公要錢說我沒付半小時差額要給他們，說她有登記開始時間，我說你們登記的時間我們在那邊等了將近20分鐘

🍊媽直接開🔥大戰泰國大媽，重點她還用髒話罵人說要報警，只是沒想到遇到一個硬茬，我直接說你去報警，我兩個小時後來找你！
放心，我絕對找觀光警察投訴你們啦🔥🔥🔥

按摩店在Kantary Hills Hotel, Chiang Mai對面，大家記得避雷
reviews.textTranslated:
Warning: This article is for reference only. The following information is provided by Facebook user GillPrincess Wang in the Thailand Travel Experts group (February 2025).

#AvoidThisIssue

Tonight is our last night in Chiang Mai. We originally planned to go to another massage parlor, but the father and son were too lazy to walk, so we just went into one near the hotel.

We said we wanted a two-hour massage, but they were impatient and waited about 20 minutes before finally starting. They ended up massaging the same area for almost an hour. When I asked them to use more pressure, they gave me a dirty look and deliberately rubbed me very hard with a small stick. I told them I didn't want to use that, and they deliberately said, "Didn't you want it harder?" while still giving me a dirty look until I changed my expression and they finally stopped!

The massage was haphazard and disorganized, with frequent changes of masseuses, and it was over in an hour and a half. They even dared to charge me for two hours! 🤬🤬🤬 I was annoyed and told them I was only willing to pay for an hour and a half, and they wouldn't even tip (only my husband received the full hour and a half, so he did).

After leaving, my husband realized he'd forgotten his phone and went back to get it. They then demanded money from my husband, saying I hadn't paid for the half-hour and had to pay them for it, claiming they had a recorded start time. I said we waited there for almost 20 minutes for that recorded time.

My mom immediately started a fight with the Thai masseuse, even swearing and threatening to call the police. I didn't expect to run into such a tough customer. I told her to go ahead and call the police, I'd be back in two hours!

Don't worry, I'll definitely complain to the tourist police! 🔥🔥🔥

The massage parlor is opposite the Kantary Hills Hotel, Chiang Mai. Beware!

reviews.name: J A
reviews.text: I highly recommend this place! After just one massage treatment, I felt completely cured. I had spent two weeks trying different places, but this one was by far the best for the condition I was experiencing. I’m extremely grateful for their care it truly made me trust in Thai holistic therapies and inspired me to want to learn more.

reviews.name: jhunt891
reviews.text: This is without a doubt the best massage I've ever had. Comes with an initial consultation so you can tell them your issues. The masseurs here seriously know what they are doing. It wasn't a 100% relaxing experience which is exactly what you need for a therapeutic massage. Some of it was quite surprising, to be honest. But after this massage I felt like a cloud. Very professional, I trust them 100%, amazing, friendly, knowledgeable, therapeutic service. Kap kon mak kaaaa!

reviews.name: Petteri Viitanen
reviews.text:
Got massaged by an old lady here. I booked 90 mins Thai + Toksen session.
It was perhaps the best foot massage I've had. I released a lot of tension. The massage wasn't particularly painful, only for short durations. Toksen was done without hammering, but instead drawing on muscle lines.
They also teach on the site. The old lady showed a young masseuse how tight my shoulder-chest area was. It was great to see that demonstrated. Seems like there's a lot of wisdom and expertise in this house. They know the typical pain spots people have. I screamed out of pain when she touched my lower back :D
So not particularly a relaxing session, but very therapeutical one.

reviews.name: A. Amen
reviews.text: The best Thai massage in Chiangmai mai, I had 90 minutes Thai massage from Mr. Nihn for 550baht, which was more than worth it. Me. Nihn is a true master of his profession, he did amazing stretches almost like Warrior Thai massage and was very intuitive. Only recommend, even greater after Workout muscle soreness days.

reviews.name: Kit Johnson
reviews.text: The quality of massage here is very high. It's therapeutic massage and the setting reflects that (it's not spa-style). The masseurs seem sensitive to the individual needs of the patients and I even saw one recommending physiotherapy exercises to do at home. This is the real deal.

reviews.name: Sanny
reviews.text: If you're looking for a real therapeutic though thai massage like they had them 10 years ago, with deep tissue pressure and some pain this is the place to be. Not like the relaxing massages that seem to be the standard now. I was so happy with Thuoy she knows the body well and i will definately be back! 1,5 hour 950 baht. Thai massages include Tok sen.

reviews.name: Huy Lam
reviews.text: Excellent! This is the best Thai massage I had in Thailand. It's more of a clinic than a spa. Their style is definitely therapeutic not relaxation. No private room, no A/C but other than that it is excellent.

reviews.text: Hard for me to rate this place - one time I went it was the best massage ever with great Tok-Sen and Thai Stretch. The second time I went another lady was elbowing bone to bone on my spine, leg bones, etc and it seemed like she was trying to injure me.

한국에서 부터 계속 어께 문제가 있어서 여러 마사지를 가봤는데, 복불복 인데, 여기는 전문적 입니다.

reviews.text: My wife & me had a very good experience here. The masseuse was well trained & did her job very well. I would surely recommend it. The only downer was that they charge an extra 3% if you use a card for payment.

reviews.name: Thoffy
reviews.text: The masseuse didn't ask a single question, is this weight enough? The massage was very painful. We chose a 2-hour massage. The massage was rushed. There was no feeling of comfort at all. It was a waste of time and money. It was the first and definitely the last time.

reviews.name: Bruce

reviews.text: Had a big headaches and courbatures coming in, i even vomitted 3 times that day... The massage was exellent and got me relaxed for sure. Really professional i would recommand to anyone who is looking for quality massage.

reviews.name: Amber Luk
reviews.text:
技師完全不會按摩，整個過程都感覺在混水摸魚。技師完全按不到正確的位置，該用力時不用力，不該用力時用力，這是第一次人生中有人按摩會不停按我的骨頭，弄得我很痛。
跟技師說冷要毛巾，正常按背的時候他會幫我蓋住雙腿，但是她只是把毛巾蓋在我屁股上。完全不細心及沒有尊重可言。

價錢在泰國相對來說也不是便宜，香薰推油兩小時要1550THB。

還有，用的毛巾和床墊感覺濕濕的不太衞生。

絕對不推薦，如果可以給零分我會給零分
reviews.textTranslated:
The masseuse was completely incompetent; the entire massage felt like she was just going through the motions. She couldn't find the right spots, applying pressure where it should and not at all. This was the first time in my life I'd had a massage where someone kept pressing on my bones, causing me a lot of pain.

I asked for a towel because I was cold. Normally, during a back massage, she would cover my legs, but she only put the towel on my buttocks. She was completely careless and disrespectful.

The price wasn't cheap for Thailand; a two-hour aromatherapy massage cost 1550 THB.

Also, the towels and mattress felt damp and unhygienic.

I absolutely do not recommend this massage. If I could give it zero stars, I would.

reviews.name: Маржан Саякова
reviews.text: Не советую вообще , изначально заказала массаж на 90 минут. Потом остановила когда 60 мин настал , кроме холода ничего не чувствовала.  Дрожала от холода , мастеру несколько раз сказала об этом она тупа улыбается и дальше делает , сервис никакой , когда сказала остановить мне холодно , сразу полотенце нашла говорит давай укрою , не могла сразу это сделать ? И массаж очень слабый , чем тут платить 1300 бат лучше в любом уличном массаже лучше делают и сервис лучше , админ даже не интересовалась почему 60 мин только сделала , понравилась или нет , по барабану , лишь бы оплатили и все . Не знаю откуда такие накрученные отзывы ! Ниже плинтуса сервис и массаж ,
reviews.textTranslated: I don't recommend it at all. I originally booked a 90-minute massage. Then I stopped when it was 60 minutes, and I felt nothing but cold. I was shivering from the cold, I told the therapist several times, but she just smiled and carried on. The service was terrible. When I told her to stop, I was cold, she immediately found a towel and said, "Let me cover you up." She couldn't have done that right away. The massage was very weak. It's better to pay 1,300 baht here; any street massage place does a better job and has better service. The administrator didn't even ask why I only did 60 minutes, whether I liked it or not. She didn't care, as long as I paid. I don't know where such inflated reviews come from! The service and massage are rock bottom.

reviews.name: Lee Lichin
reviews.text:
非常不推薦。

男技師對待客人態度隨便。

技術差到不行（有學過嗎？）
我已經選擇油壓了，卻完全無法放鬆。
沒順著筋絡紋理，不懂壓點，敲背像是在打拳。

Highly not recommended.

The male masseur was very casual with customers.

His technique was terrible (did he even have any training?). I chose an oil massage, but I couldn't relax at all.

He didn't follow the natural muscle lines, didn't know how to apply pressure, and the back massage felt like boxing.

After giving customers such a terrible experience, he still directly asked for a tip. (How confident is this masseur?)

reviews.text: Really nice thai massage for a great price. I recommend the two hour for just 100 baht more. We did an hour and wished we had time for more. There ambiance could use a little music, but not concerning. One of the best places I've been in Thailand and definitely the best value for the money.

reviews.name: George Borocz
reviews.text: Great massage and very reasonable prices. The lady giving me a 2 hour Thai Massage was fantastic. Went back the next day for an oil massage. It was good as well, though I would have preferred the masseuse from the night before. She was that outstanding.  Highly recommend this place.

reviews.name: Rachel
reviews.text: Never have I left a massage early. It was more worth it for me to pay them the money to stop touching me. The facilities were nice, private room, AC, smelled great. I was excited. Then she was too hard, I asked to be more gentle. She promptly wiped off the oil and moved on to the next task, which felt like it had zero training behind it. I felt like she was petting a dog. She also rubbed the tops of my hands and feet and not the palms or soles of them... who does that!! I've had a ton of massages and never have I been so angry about my experience.

reviews.text:
8月下旬の平日にいきました。
自分はタイ旅行が初めてで行く前に々調べて、夜の街も同様にしました。

グーグルマップや情報サイトを見る中で、駅が近くて優良店とあったので、こちらの店が良いかなと思い21時頃に入店。

店先で数名のスタッフさんが出迎えてくれて、店内で日本語の話せるオーナーと思われる方が対応してくれました。

店内は落ち着いた雰囲気でおすすめのスタッフを紹介してくれ、その中から好みの子を選びました。

コースはタイ式オイルマッサージ60分。
室内は清潔感があり、オイルマッサージ・サービスも自分が希望していた内容通りでとても満足できました。

マッサージ後もタイ語・英語が話せない自分に翻訳アプリでコミュニケーションを取ってくれて楽しく会話ができました。
可愛くて優しくて明るいとてもいい子に出会えて嬉しかったです。

初心者の自分でも安心してリラックスしてマッサージを楽しめたので、タイ語・英語を学んで次にタイに来た時もお店に行かせてもらいます。
ありがとうございました！
reviews.textTranslated:
I went on a weekday in late August.

This was my first trip to Thailand, so I did a lot of research beforehand, including looking at the nightlife.

While looking at Google Maps and information sites, I found this place near a station and it was listed as a good establishment, so I thought it would be a good choice and went in around 9 PM.

Several staff members greeted me at the entrance, and inside, a person who seemed to be the owner and could speak Japanese assisted me.

The interior had a calm atmosphere, and they introduced me to recommended staff members, from whom I chose the one I liked best.

I chose the 60-minute Thai oil massage course.

The room was clean, and the oil massage service was exactly what I had hoped for, so I was very satisfied.

Even after the massage, they used a translation app to communicate with me, as I don't speak Thai or English, and we had a pleasant conversation.

I was so happy to meet such a cute, kind, and cheerful girl.

Even as a beginner, I was able to relax and enjoy the massage with peace of mind, so I will learn Thai and English and visit this shop again the next time I come to Thailand.

Thank you!

reviews.name: Butaman
reviews.text: 平日の夕方に行ったところ、厳しめの4人。それでも確かに前評判通りちゃんとしたマッサージはよかった。力を入れてグイグイやってくれた。でもそれだけ。詳しくは書けないけどそれ以外が全くダメ。値段は安めだし、さらに値引きもしてくれたし、水も無料でもらえたし、最後にはデザート（きれいに剥いた冷たいミカン）ももらえたし、部屋もきれいだったけど、いろいろ手抜きがすごかった。もちろんたまたまこういう嬢にあたったんだろうけど、最初がこれだと2回目は厳しいんだよなぁ、1回目アタリ、2回目ハズレなら3回目もありだけど、1回目にハズレなら2回目はなかなか足が向かないんだよなぁ、この辺は激戦区だし。
reviews.textTranslated: I went on a weekday evening and there were four rather strict girls. Nevertheless, the massage itself was good, just as the reviews said. They put a lot of pressure on me. But that was about it. I can't go into details, but everything else was terrible. The price was reasonable, they even gave me a further discount, I got free water, and at the end I even got dessert (a nicely peeled, cold orange), and the room was clean, but they were really cutting corners in many areas. Of course, I probably just got a girl like that by chance, but if the first time is like this, it's hard to imagine going back a second time. If the first time is a hit and the second time is a miss, a third time is possible, but if the first time is a miss, it's hard to bring yourself to go back a second time, especially in this area which is very competitive.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your feedback. We're glad to hear that you were satisfied with the quality of the massage and our affordable pricing. However, we’re very sorry to know that your overall experience did not meet your expectations.

We take your comments seriously and are committed to improving every aspect of our service. If you're open to it, we’d love to hear more details so we can make things better for all our guests.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and provide a more satisfying experience next time.

reviews.name: cocoa aki
reviews.text: 金曜日の11:00オープン直後に入店。時間は80分が基本となっていて、アカスリ＋蒸しタオル（1080バーツ）にした。お湯を掛けられベッドに横たわりアカスリが始まる。身体が温まってないせいか、さほどアカが出ない。アカスリ終了後に対面の部屋に移動して熱めのタオルを掛けられ、なおかつビニールで包まれた。これ順番が逆じゃないのかな？と感じつつ、ぐっすりと眠ってしまいました。
reviews.textTranslated: I went in right after they opened at 11:00 on Friday. The standard session is 80 minutes, and I opted for the body scrub + hot towel treatment (1080 baht). Hot water was poured over me, and I lay down on the bed as the body scrub began. Perhaps because my body wasn't warmed up, not much dead skin came off. After the scrub, I moved to the opposite room where a hot towel was placed over me, and then I was wrapped in plastic. I couldn't help but wonder if the order was reversed, but I ended up falling fast asleep.

reviews.textTranslated: This isn't my first time at Haru Akasuri Massage in Bangkok. I had an excellent massage from Mayu. Last time, I followed the reviews and chose Imi. It was a terrible experience; she was very bored and didn't want to do a good job. The massage was supposed to last 70 minutes, but it ended after 45 minutes. reviews.text:
แหล่งพักผ่อนเพื่อสุขภาพในรูปแบบธรรมชาติแห่งใหม่ของนครศรีธรรมราช เพียง10 นาทีจากเซ็นทรัลเฟสติวัล เดินทางสะดวกผ่านถนนลาดยางตัดใหม่ที่สวยงาม แล้วเลี้ยวซ้ายตัดข้ามรางรถไฟ (ที่เราตื่นเต้นและลุ้นเสมอเวลาข้าม อิอิ) เดินทางตามป้าย บอกทางของ ร้านเลย (หรือ ตั้ง จีพีเอสเลย เราทดลองแระ.. ตรงเป๊ะ แน่นอน) จากจุดทางรถไฟ ใช้เวลาแค่ 6 นาที ถึงเป้าหมายเลย.. แวบแรกที่เห็นคือ.. เอิ่ม มันเหมือนบ้านสวนอ่ะ.. เราได้รีเล็กซ์ในสถานที่ สงบๆ ท่ามกลาง สวนป่าผสม ตามแนวคิดพระราชาเลยนิ มีร้านสวยๆ น่ารักๆ ตั้งอยู่ตรงกลางบึง ที่แวดล้อมไปด้วย ผักพื้นบ้าน ผักสวนครัว ตะไคร้หอม สวนกล้วย ฟัก แฟง แตงไท และโอ๊ยอีกมากมายเลย (พี่หมอ.. เจ้าของร้าน  สุดใจดี บอกเราว่า มีผักตามฤดูกาลด้วย) ส่วน ที่ อยู่รอบนอก ก็แซมด้วยไม้ยืนต้นที่เป็นไม้เศรษฐกิจ แนวคิดแบบหยอดกระปุกฝากธนาคาร แบบประจำ 20 ปีเลย เพราะ อีก 20 ปี ไม้เหล่านี้จะมีมูลสูงถึงต้นละล้านบาทเลยทีเดียว ตรงด้านหลังถัดจาก ร้านอาหารและกาแฟแล้ว ก็เป็น อาคารไม้ไฝ่อบสมุนไพรไทย แบบ ออริจินัล กันเลยทีเลยใช้ ไม้ฟืนสุมไฟ อัดเอาไอน้ำสมุนไพรจากหม้อต้มขนาดใหญ่ใส่เข้าไปในห้อง อบ ซึ่งแบ่งชายหญิง เป็นสัดส่วน มิดชิด สวยงาม อบได้ครั้งละ 4-6 คน ในแต่ละห้อง.. แถมมีน้ำสมุนไพรให้ลูกค้าได้จิบแก้กระหายกันตลอดเวลาที่อบสมุนไพร.. โอ้ย เยอะอ่ะ.. สาธยายไม่หมด ไปดูเองเถอะ.. ไม่ผิดหวัง..อ้อ เค้าเปิดเฉพาะเสาร์-อาทิตย์น้ะ เพื่อชัวร์ โทรจองก่อนเลย..
ทิ้งท้ายไว้กับอาหารของที่นี้สักหน่อยน่าาา.. ใครที่ ไม่ชอบทานอาหารรสชาดเข้มข้น จัดจ้าน ต้องแจ้งทางร้านด้วยน่ะ... เพราะที่นี่  รสชาด ..แซ่บเบอร์สิบ ขอบอก.. ที่เหลือลองเองเลยจร้าาา
reviews.textTranslated:
A new natural wellness retreat in Nakhon Si Thammarat, just 10 minutes from Central Festival. It's easily accessible via a beautiful new paved road; turn left and cross the train tracks (which always excites and scares us when we cross, haha!). Follow the signs to the shop (or use GPS – we tried it and it's spot on!). From the train tracks, it only takes 6 minutes to reach your destination. The first impression is… wow, it looks like a garden house! We relaxed in a peaceful place amidst a mixed forest garden, following the King's concept. There's a beautiful and charming shop located in the middle of a pond, surrounded by local vegetables, herbs, lemongrass, banana trees, pumpkins, gourds, cantaloupes, and much more! (The owner, a very kind doctor, told us they also have seasonal vegetables.) The outer areas are interspersed with economically valuable trees – a concept of saving up for 20 years, because in 20 years, these trees will be worth up to a million baht each! Behind the shop… Besides being a restaurant and coffee shop, it's also an original Thai herbal steam room made of bamboo. They use firewood to burn and compress herbal steam from large boilers into the steam rooms, which are separated for men and women, private and beautiful. Each room can accommodate 4-6 people at a time. Plus, they provide herbal drinks for customers to quench their thirst throughout the steam session. Oh, there's so much more... I can't describe it all. You have to see it for yourself... You won't be disappointed. Oh, they're only open on Saturdays and Sundays, so to be sure, call and reserve a table.
Finally, a little something about the food here... If you don't like strong, spicy food, be sure to let the restaurant know... Because the taste here is... a ten out of ten! You'll have to try the rest yourself!
