title: Iyengar Yoga Bangkok
ownerDescription: Yoga classes taught in the tradition of B.K.S. Iyengar
address: 3rd floor, FIFTYFIFTH BUILDING, 90 Sukhumvit Soi 55 (corner of Thonglor 2, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 3rd floor, FIFTYFIFTH BUILDING, 90 Sukhumvit Soi 55 (corner of Thonglor 2

reviews.name: Sucheewon Honglong
reviews.text:
I would like to share my inspiring experience practicing yoga with Justin at Iyengar Yoga. After undergoing hip replacement surgery due to a car accident, my doctor once told me, “You will never be able to sit cross-legged again.”

What’s truly incredible is that after practicing Iyengar Yoga with Justin consistently, my body gradually transformed in remarkable ways. Not only has my walking improved significantly, but I am now able to sit cross-legged again—something I never thought possible. I am deeply grateful to Justin for this.

Justin’s teaching is meticulous and attentive to every detail of posture, always adapting the practice to suit each student’s physical ability. This has made me feel confident and safe throughout my journey.

For anyone looking to improve strength, flexibility, and restore mobility, I wholeheartedly recommend Iyengar Yoga with Justin. This is more than just yoga practice—it has given me back my abilities and quality of life.

reviews.name: John
reviews.text: I did 1 month of classes here, I went almost every day. This is a wonderful Yoga studio. I've practiced at lots of Iyengar Yoga studios around the world and this is as good as it gets. There's a lot of classes at different times which is convenient, they have a lot of equipment, the classes are small so the very knowledgeable teachers are able to help all the students easily while the classes flow along nicely. A place of tranquility in the middle of the hustle and bustle of Bangkok

reviews.name: Tina Hirschbuehl
reviews.text: Everything you could possibly wish for from an Iyengar studio: experienced and knowledgeable teachers; a focus on precision, alignment, and attention to detail; and props galore. There's also a great sense of community.

reviews.name: Co
reviews.text: Visiting Bangkok for a week and came for a drop in on my last day, the class was very informative and definitely recommend for anyone that wants to learn the correct Asana alignments and practice mindfulness - suitable for any level. I took lots of notes :) Thank you and it was my first time trying shoulder stand foam block with blankets, really enjoyed it.

reviews.name: Betty Ford
reviews.text: Great studio for those looking for Iyengar style yoga. Will come back every time I visit Bangkok.

reviews.name: Nayantara Pai
reviews.text: It’s an inclusive & a safe place to start  or continue your yoga journey . All the instructors/teachers  are immensely knowledgeable, responsible & dedicated. I walked into the studio with chronic back pain, with consistent practice as guided by the instructors back pain is a thing of a past. If you want to learn yoga poses (asanas) the right way with the right alignment mindfully to get the maximum benefit physically & mentally then this is the studio for you.

reviews.name: Morna Robertson
reviews.text: This is a fantastic Iyengar studio. The quality of these experienced teachers is first class, extremely knowledgeable, helpful and kind. The Iyengar method is one of education and continual development and all the teachers here will help you on your yoga journey. It is a disciplined and professional studio and if you want to learn about this life changing yoga method - visit this studio. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Lucy Gardner
reviews.text:
A wonderful studio near BTS Thonglor with all the yoga props you could ever dream of. The teachers are dedicated and interested in helping students to progress, even those who drop in just for one class. The other students are friendly and welcoming.  Classes are from
Level 1 to 2.5 plus seniors and you can also join online.  I found the classes of Lek, Les and Bpaeng to be particularly helpful and enjoyable.

reviews.name: Beau Blank
reviews.text: I can see where young people would think this style of yoga is too slow and too precise, not enough “flow” but it is fascinating to me to learn the Iyengar method.  Really amazing physiology with its own language like “armpit chest” and just very deep and profound overall ... it’s even fun to try to make out the Thai pronunciation of the Sanskrit.  I love the ropes!  Highly recommend and in January 2018 they are starting a new beginners series.

reviews.name: Stuff the Magic Wagon
reviews.text:
I agree with what others have said here in saying that the owner Justin Herold is a very unpleasant person. It’s a pity he is the only certified Iyengar teacher giving regular classes in Thailand. I actually moved to Bangkok for the purpose of being near a real Iyengar studio.

One of his teachers, a gentle Thai man with a shaved head and the disposition of a monk, is very kind, patient, insightful and good. But Justin was extremely rude to me as were his female teachers who tried to force my body into their ideals. Despite my repeated explicit attempts to set boundaries, they stopped the class and kept trying to force me into the positions they thought I should be able to do - even as I pleaded with them to please leave me alone so I could relax, breathe, and benefit from the version of the asana I was able to do. It was humiliating. When I wrote to Justin about it, he blamed me and was defensive and hostile.

You can see a similar attitude in how he egoically responds to people’s negative feedback here, prioritizing his image over collective wellbeing, and blaming/gaslighting students for their experiences instead of taking ownership. Such an absolute pity. I have studied with many Iyengar teachers around the world, I know how a competent and respectful practitioner behaves, and beyond the one good teacher I mentioned, do not recommend this studio to anyone after such a disappointing and expensive choice.  Avoid.

ps. Apparently he doesn’t remember this exchange. It says something that the negative exchange does not stand out in his memory, since he must have so many of them. Because my “expectations” are what caused his teachers to ignore my explicit boundaries. Because my “expectations” are what caused him to be rude when I sought support for this. He is a discredit to the practice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I honestly don't know who you are nor recall sending you an email in response.  Please send me a copy to info@iyengar-yoga-bangkok.com.  We do our best to guide our students into the poses according to the proper alignment of the asana as we have been taught.  This may not always meet your expectations.

reviews.name: Cice Cice
reviews.text: I came today asking for a trial. The instructor allowed me to join the class. Then, at the end of the session, the instructor asked me 550฿. I said very politely that she told me I could try, that was my first time. But she said to me that “only Thai people can have the first session free as a trial”. Foreigners must pay. She told me that she was not the owner and that she doesn’t decide the rules. I found this disgusting. The owner is a foreigner as well and I can’t understand how he can set these kind of rules. Also the place doesn’t have any shower room, so after training you can not even get a shower. Definitely I won’t come back.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
As I wrote to you directly I tried to explain the misunderstanding and for which I apologize a second time.  Since I’ve had no reply from you I will respond here.
First we don’t discriminate against foreigners.  Our policy, for a first time free trial class, is for residents only.  We do not actively seek tourists (who are exclusively foreigners) to join our classes.  We fully welcome tourists who do want to join.  However, since most will attend only one class it makes no sense to offer to them a free trial class.
We are a small business and don’t always have a regular staff at some off peak hours.  The teacher, sometimes winds up covering some of those duties.  The person who taught your class is new to teaching here with marginal English skills.  Clearly, she chose the wrongs words when saying foreigner for tourist and Thai for resident.  I have since made clear to her the studio’s policy.
This is a matter of misunderstanding and I hope you see that no ill will nor discrimination was intended.
As to the matter of showers, many places such as ours don’t offer those facilities, especially since we don’t have “hot yoga” and our room is air conditioned.  If that is an issue for you then its best that you inquire first rather than being disappointed afterwards.

reviews.name: Michael Glennon
reviews.text: I love everything about this studio and it’s yoga community. The teachers are passionate, sharing and caring and there’s an abundance of yoga props. The aircon and fans run during class creating the perfect temperature so whenever I’m in Bangkok I try to get to the studio everyday. I’m so glad there’s a certified Iyengar school of this level in Thailand. Namaste 🙏

reviews.name: Hannah
reviews.text: Very unpleasant yoga studio. From the minute I walked in Justin Herold the owner and instructor made me feel unwelcome. I was right on time (I would have been early but it was confusing to find as they weren't listed on the sign outside the building so I had to look it up again.) but Justin told me I was supposed to come 15 minutes early my first time - but that isn't written anywhere on the website. He reluctantly let me stay. Then, about 15 minutes into the class, during downward dog, he came over and repeated told me to straighten my legs. I told him I had tight hamstrings and couldn't. My inability to comply upset him for some reason. He told everyone to move their mats to the wall but came up to me and told me we had a problem. He said this was why he liked people to come 15 minutes early, although coming in early wouldn't have solved the problem of my tight hamstrings. So he asked me to leave!  I did lower myself to his level when I told him the problem was that he was a very unpleasant man. Don't go to this studio!  Berating students and making them feel bad is not yoga.  I was very upset over this bizarre mistreatment and disappointed as I thought I had found a good studio.

reviews.name: Fred Harrington
reviews.text: This is high quality Iyengar yoga. All the teachers are a very good standard. I really enjoyed practicing here whilst I was in Bangkok and I learnt a lot. Thank you.

reviews.name: tak
reviews.text:
The massage here was excellent.

There were mats neatly arranged in an open space, and guests are massaged on each mat. All were occupied, indicating that they are very popular. The masseuses didn't often talk to each other, and you can tell that they are focused on the massage. The quality of the massage does not change even if the masseuses do talk to each other. This is what makes them different from other massage parlors in that they are very professional.

The masseuses in charge of me this time was very skilled. There was a massage to the stomach and a massage where she stepped on my body, which was very effective and not found in other massage parlors. The mild, homey, and nice atmosphere of the space was also very comfortable!

reviews.text:
너무 살살해요
무슨 아기 다루듯이 하네요
잘하면 팁주는데 대놓고 팁달라고하고

이거아니라도 베트남에서 태국온건데 너무 비교되네요 불친절하고 진짜 태국 다시는안옴
reviews.textTranslated:
They are too gentle.

They treat me like a baby.

I would give a tip if they did a good job, but they blatantly asked for one.

I went out of my way to take a taxi here because people on YouTube said they were good, but I’ve had massages at hundreds of places and this is the worst I’ve ever experienced. Also, they didn't even close the curtains, so I could see everything—the massage of the person next to me and mine.

Even without this, I came all the way from Vietnam to Thailand, and the difference is just too stark. They are unfriendly, and I will never come back to Thailand again.

reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience.
The massage felt completely impersonal and routine. For 20 minutes, the therapist repeated the exact same motion on my back with no variation or attention to tension points. This was followed by about 10 minutes of uncomfortable and seemingly pointless touches on my face. At no point did I feel genuinely cared for or listened to. It was so unpleasant that I seriously considered walking out mid-session. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this place

reviews.text: We had a foot massage with hot stones-we were told they are known for it and it was the best massage in Thailand so far. So relaxing for the feet. Highly recommend to try it! The atmosphere in the salon was nice too.

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: Decent massage. The woman doing the front desk was surprisingly unfriendly, but the masseuse was nice. The massage itself was too gentle and not really effective, but for 150 Baht for half an hour it was nice and relaxing enough.

reviews.text: Awesome Massage! I came here twice and loved it both times. If you get a standard 30 minute or 1 hr body massage they take you to a room in the back that's shared with many mattresses on the floor. But it's quiet and away from the street noise so I found it very relaxing. And both my masseuses did a fantastic job. Also it's one of the few places open til 3AM. Highly recommend.

reviews.text:
너무너무너무 시원해요
개극락임 그냥
근데 마사지 샵은 어쩔 수 없이 누가 해주냐에 따라 다른데 전 ruay이분한테 받았어요
다른데서 한시간 받으면 의미없는 들 쓰다듬기 10-20분 하는 곳 많은데 여긴 그런거 없음
한시간 꽉 채워서 마사지 해주는데 진짜 시원해요 가격도 한시간에 300바트면 안 받을 이유가 없음
진짜 내 승모근 없어진 거 같고 다리랑 발 아팠는데 다 풀렸어요ㅠㅠ 오늘 마지막날인게 아쉬울정도
그리고 직원들 다 친절해요
reviews.textTranslated:
It was so, so, so refreshing.

It was pure bliss.

However, the quality of a massage inevitably depends on who gives it, but I got a massage from Ruay.

Many places give you a one-hour massage where they spend 10-20 minutes just meaningless petting, but there is none of that here.

They give you a full hour of massage, and it is truly refreshing. At 300 baht for an hour, there is no reason not to get it.

It seriously feels like my trapezius muscles are gone, and my legs and feet, which used to hurt, are completely loosened up. ㅠㅠ It’s a shame that today is my last day.

Also, all the staff are friendly.

reviews.name: 오민호

남자라서 남자분이 해준신거같습니다.

환경은 잡담 별로안하시고 조용하고 깨끗하고 시원하고 좋습니다.

I'm a man, so I think a man gave me a foot massage.
I got a foot massage, and while it seemed like they were working hard, it wasn't at all refreshing.
All the massage parlors in the area seem to have colluded on the same price, so the price isn't anything special.
The environment is quiet, clean, cool, and pleasant, with little chatter.

We plan to visit again.

title: YOGA in Koh Lanta
ownerDescription:
14 years(seasons) teaching in Koh Lanta, Flow Yoga Lessons.Very qualified teacher with all knowledges and experience for lead our ALL LEVELS class, among of Reiki Therapist, Auto Healing facilitator and a none stop Anatomy and Neuroplasticity Pupil.
Checkour reviews on our Facebook page which always been 5 of 5. Who rated with 1 star NEVER attended to any lessons with us.
Our teacher give her best for you really learn different aspects of a Yoga Practice always considering the main key of a real Yoga practice. Come and try, it’s is a experience that you will really love it. Among all the teacher guidence, you will be practicing with an amazing View towards the SEA wich helps a-lot to really get conne!
See u on the mat!🧘🏼‍♀️🙏✨✨✨🪬
Namaste
address: Nakara Long Beach Resort, 120, Ko Lanta District, Krabi 81150, Thailand
plusCode: J26J+JJ Sala Dan, Ko Lanta District, Krabi, Thailand

reviews.name: Ian Mazerolle
reviews.text: A great few classes with Vivi….. it’s a rock up class, no need to book. She makes the class flexible for both beginners and above….. the phone number on google isn’t up to date, but I’ve attached a photo to give you Vivi’s number if you need it 👍👍

reviews.name: Marta Rocha
reviews.text: Great place to have a yoga class and the teacher accompanies everyone too and wants to help! Right by the beach which helps too. It’s a long yoga class and meditation of almost 2 hours so it can be a bit more difficult if you are not used to it

reviews.name: שרון זגורי
reviews.text: Almost two hours of yoga!! It's rare to find one like this, the instructor was professional and clear and challenging for all levels, the view is breathtaking and it's fun to do yoga in the morning in front of the sea, there is enough equipment for everyone and it's in good condition, worth going!!

reviews.name: Iwona Fodrowska
reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing!!

This yoga class is suitable for all levels! You can always take breaks if you need to! It is so relaxing and the view is amazing! The instructor is very kind, showing poses for all different levels. Thank you so much :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 🙏🫶🏻 Made me very happy to read you! Namaste

reviews.name: Nahoko Toyota
reviews.text:
Loved their morning class! Their daily 90-min class is led by a friendly teacher Vivi, starts at 9 am, costs 400 THB for drop-in, and includes a bit of meditation and breath work and different asanas.

This is for all levels and I am someone who works out regularly but is not too experienced in yoga. As Vivi gives different versions of the same pose with specific and helpful suggestions, I can sometimes go to the toughest forms and other times take it easy.

The place is clean with an amazing view, sound of waves and warm breeze. You will feel so good afterwards.

Highly recommended:)

reviews.name: Kary Rogney
reviews.text: Vivi’s classes have a nice progression of meditation, mindfulness, warmup, flow, balance, and cool down. I feel the 400Baht (or less if you purchase more sessions) is a good value for her knowledge and expertise. She was mindful of the different levels and experiences of her students. The view of the beach is amazing, too. Today was my 5th class with her and they’ve all been slightly different but had key components in each. I’ve thoroughly enjoyed my lessons with Vivi and have learned some new things to improve my future yoga practice as well.

reviews.name: Evelyn
reviews.text: I was late but still managed to join her yoga session and i really enjoyed it. Class started at 9am (90minute or more) Great flow and great view. Well recommended. Namaste 🙏

reviews.name: Jen Gerrard
reviews.text:
Vivi is truly amazing! The setting cannot be beat as you are right on the beach. She teaches daily during her season (Dec-March). Class is just over 90 minutes with meditation, breath work, asana, balance, some head stand work occasionally. There are options for all levels.
Price is only 400 B for one class or 1000B for a 3 class pass.

reviews.name: Charlie Smalley
reviews.text: Can’t recommend this class enough. A well-paced full class including meditation, breath-work and flow. What a beautiful place to practice with an incredible teacher. The class is suitable for all levels, and caters well for both beginners and advanced students. So perfect to start the morning facing the ocean and feeling grateful for our bodies and our health.

reviews.name: Kristen Kircher
reviews.text: I loved this class! The teacher was very experienced and welcoming, and taught with a great flow. She incorporated some pranayama (breath work) and gentle movement/mindfulness which made the two hour class fly by. Peaceful setting right on the beach. Would definitely recommend this class to yoga lovers!

reviews.name: Declan O Rourke
reviews.text:
To be in the presence of Vivi is inspiring and her life experiences have guided her to be the amazing yoga instructor you see before you today. Her voice both calms you and guides you. Her attention to detail helps correct you and improve your positions. Vivi only does 1 class a day which means her energy levels are always high, thus giving her utmost. All levels are welcome and during the class she will show you different positions for level, 1,2,3 ect....
As far as location goes, it doesn't't get any better.
The cool morning breeze and the sound of gentle waves on the beach is both calming and meditative in itself.
You can pop in on a daily basis but I would recommend booking a spot the morning before if you can.
I would like to thank you for your openness, guidance and for just being a wonderful giving human.
I wish you all the success for the coming 2024 and beyond.🥳
It was a joy to attend your class and I can highly recommend it.
Much Gracias 🙏

reviews.name: Meltem Binici
reviews.text: Had such an amazing morning yoga session. The instructor really takes her time and created an amazing flow for everyone. It was really suitable for beginners and advanced as you could hold the poses longer and had more variations. Really recommend coming here. Also the view is amazing

reviews.name: ando
reviews.text: Yoga in Nakara Resort is definitely on. An excellent teacher! (Based on my 40 years of yoga). Very good for beginners or advanced. Great location also.

reviews.name: Desiree Castillo
reviews.text: I just took an amazing yoga class with Vivi.  Beautiful views and feeling rejuvenated for the day. Super easy to find right on the beach and classes everyday starting at 9 am. I highly recommend it!! 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Anke S
reviews.text: I have attended Vivi's yoga session 3 times and it was one of the best sessions I have had. I think it is suitable for all levels, Vivi is very thoughtful and explains all the different levels so that everyone can follow along. Beautiful meditation at the beginning and at the end, gorgeous scenery. Highly recommended!  Many thanks dear Vivi 🩷

reviews.name: georgia walker
reviews.text:
Really Nice Environment.
Beautiful ocean breeze and sounds.
Teacher seems like a very experienced yogi. Good adjustments.
Not the greatest flow. Lots of pauses in the middle of sentences leaving the practitioner suspended with uncertainty in a transition. Higher risk of injury as a result.
A bit heavy handed on the esoteric instruction over anatomical instruction.
Overall  pretty good class!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Are you sure you attended to our class? We know there is a place asking people to write not good reviews (the jungle law unfortunately is going on in Lanta since years ago…) . Maybe u are one of the ones that never came. Whatever, just in case is good to let you know that: 
We don’t stop during the practice , is a Flow Lesson, where we really coordinate each single movement and alignment with the breath. I have several years of Anatomy lessons… I will not do any reference to your comment of higher risk of injury even less when I also do Therapeutic Yoga because my backgrounds. 
Daily I ask each of my students How they felt etc, 1 by 1 , and no exception they have expressed gratitude and full satisfaction about the experience with us. 
So thanks anyway. 
Have a good day and light in your way🙏🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: M.
reviews.text:
Hard facts: 9-10.45 for 400 baht. Just be on time and get a mattress, no booking before.
Amazing view!! But be aware it's more like a stretching class. Nothing spiritual or mind opening expectations! Teacher has a very strong accent so better if you are advanced in yoga.

Response to the comment: I have no idea what they talk about 😅 I was there with my fam and kids..
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: PLEASE, DO NOT try to spread hate and even less LIE , about the absolutely opposite regarding to our teacher lessons,  and even less when  YOU NEVER  attend to her class! . You GUYS  basically   "broked  in" to the shala,  ( WITHOUT PERMISSION), take out the equipment wich was locked,  make mess that  our Yoga Assistant had to even clean AFTER YOU ! . (He didn't understood at all what you were doing there using the whole place, etc) .  Among all some regular are important  guest for us, talk to the teacher as soon as she arrived  telling her about being  disturbed  while they were resting in  the area and waiting for the class,  because you were doing promotions business videos,  with a drone, etc ( for many  guest  can be very disrespectful). Contrary of what one of you (rudely) said to the Yoga Teacher,  the Shala IS IT NOT  a public place, and not even in not your own country could be !. Koh Lanta is an Island where people know each other and we make all possible for be as much  respectful we can as any other country we must behave!. So please,  we really ask you at least,  DO NOT spread hate and start a clear business "thing" in the wrong way.

reviews.name: Marek Helman
reviews.text:
I didn’t participate in the classes. I don’t assess the scope of the classes. I was observing the classes from the sun bed nearby.
I need to admit that the teacher was super committed, really focused on the classes. Also, something what is not visible from the classes, she spent a lot of effort cleaning the place and preparing it for the next day. This is something I would call passion.

reviews.name: Finga Finga
reviews.text: I had a strange encounter with that yoga teacher. We used the yoga space which looks like an open air area of the hotel before the yoga class for our own workshop, of course with consulting the hotel reception and cleaning the place beforehand. When her class starts, and we were enjoying the pool, she came yelling at me: „what you did was wrong. You are very disrespectful. Get out of the pool, its closed till yoga class is over.“ She harassed me for my personal information as she wanted to charge me for something … It‘s not only weird to talk to hotel guests like that and invade their spaces, if you have nothing to do with it as external, I also don’t know what you can learn from her about peace and harmony. She and her assistant radiate very hostile energy. After that encounter we were in contact with other yoga studios close by which have been friendly and very welcoming. Maybe just choose a teacher with a calmer aura….

reviews.name: Alicia Díez
reviews.text: Fantastic teacher who adapts to all levels, lessons are over 1.5 hours with plenty of variety, from short meditations, breath work to a wide range of Assanas all adapted to various levels. Together with the breathtaking location this is a must try for anyone wanting to experience yoga at Lanta! Gracias Vivi 🙏😊

The rental price is unbelievably cheap.

reviews.name: Larissa Hehnen
reviews.text:
What to Expect: Pick-up from the hotel, a trip to the grocery store to buy all the ingredients, and vegetable preparation. On Saturday’s menu: two stir-fries, two soups, fried rice, steamed fish with lime and garlic (we watched while Big Mom made the fish), and spring rolls. After cooking, we had lunch, then were dropped off at the hotel.

We chose this course solely because it was the longest available cooking class in the area. We expected to spend the full six hours preparing and eating the food. However, we didn’t realize that the pick-up and drop-off time (which took 1.5 hours for us) was included in those six hours, which was disappointing. Additionally, a significant portion of the time was spent just cutting vegetables rather than actually cooking or learning new techniques.

The grocery store visit was a nice experience. The driver (Big Mom’s husband) was able to answer most of our questions about the groceries.

I would have liked to have the recipes in front of me to follow along and take notes. They promised to send the recipes via email after the course, but even after repeatedly asking, they never provided them. Not all the food was tasted by Big Mom, and since we were only two participants and ate lunch by ourselves, we had no idea if our dishes could have been improved. That being said, the food itself was absolutely delicious, and we really enjoyed eating what we had prepared.

Hygiene was also not well attended to, and there were noticeable issues with cross-contamination, which was concerning.

If you’re looking for a relaxed and easygoing experience with the feel of backyard cooking with grandma, this is absolutely the class for you.

However, if you’re a somewhat experienced cook looking to make curries and pastes from scratch, discuss food and flavors, or learn about the history and culture behind the dishes, this is not the right class.

It pains me to give such a low rating because they were truly lovely people, and the food was delicious, but given how much time was spent on basic prep work, along with the lack of professional instruction, poor hygiene practices, I just can’t justify a higher score.

reviews.name: Hoàng Thông Nguyễn Đức
reviews.text:
This club is terrible. The coaches have no real expertise, and their teaching ability is even worse. If they cannot properly train boxing, they should not accept students in the first place. Yet they accepted me and charged me a much higher price than other people there.

After that, they made me train alone almost every day. The coaches have no responsibility or dedication. They let students spar without closely supervising them, and when injuries happen, they blame everything on the student.

Whenever I messaged the club owner or the management, they ignored me again and again as if nothing had happened. The training fees are extremely expensive compared to many other gyms, yet there were no proper sparring drills and no training partners. Most of the time the gym is empty because nobody wants to train there.

They were just lucky to attract some Vietnamese fighters who didn’t know much about them. Those fighters only needed a place in Thailand to practice elbows and knees, and honestly any gym in Thailand could provide that. If you want to train Muay Thai elbows and knees, go to another gym in Thailand instead. Avoid this place.

This gym has no professionalism, no proper schedule, and no serious training system. Some days there are only a few customers sleeping around the gym until 8 or 9 in the morning. The gym is dirty. When customers come, the coaches often do not teach them and just let them train by themselves.

When they saw many Vietnamese fighters coming, they suddenly became very friendly and started eating together with them because they saw an opportunity to make money. Normally they never do that with other people.

Do not train here. I wasted a lot of money for two months at this place. The owner always acts shamelessly. When there are no customers, he brings different girls back every 2–3 days. The gym feels like a dirty place instead of a professional training camp. There are many other disgusting things happening there too.

One of the coaches even borrowed money from students for gambling and then did not want to pay it back. Be careful with this club. There are many more bad things I could say. I am only speaking like this because I truly experienced it myself. If I had not gone through it, I would never say these things.

I sincerely advise everyone: do not come here. This place is dirty, unprofessional, and a complete waste of money. 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

reviews.name: Vinh Nguyễn
reviews.text:
I feel that this gym lacks professionalism and proper coaching. Fighters are expected to run and skip rope on their own, then the trainer only holds pads for a few rounds. After that, we have to train on the bag by ourselves without any clear training program.

During the Songkran holiday, even though fighters had upcoming fights, the gym was closed. We were told we could still train, but no fans were allowed, while personal training (PT) clients were still accommodated. I paid full fees but was not able to use the facilities properly. The gym closed for 3 days without any compensation or extension.

When it came close to the fight day, I was told that my opponent was injured. However, that was not true. When I asked the gym, they blamed the event organizers for lying. This caused me to waste my effort in training, dieting, and cutting weight.

This is very unprofessional. Fighters are not properly cared for or supported. I am extremely disappointed and frustrated. I will not come back a second time.

I came here to train and compete to improve my level, but instead I felt misled. My friend also paid for boxing training but was left to train alone without proper coaching. The gym does not follow a consistent schedule and only focuses on clients who pay for personal training.

I strongly suggest everyone reconsider before training here.

title: Rompo Muay Thai Gym
subTitle: ロンポームエタイジム
ownerDescription:
バンコク タイランドでムエタイトレーニング！！

ロンポームエタイジムはタイバンコク都市中心部にあり、一日体験から、中期、長期まで、プロ選手は元より未経験者並び女性の方も各自のレベル目的に合わせて、ムエタイを学び練習できる環境です。団体合宿も受け付けております。

「コンセプト」

タイ国の国技であるタイ式キックボクシング（ムエタイ）を世界各国に幅広く発信し、プロ選手を育成することを目的に掲げると共に、どなたにでも目的に応じて練習できる環境を整えたムエタイジムとして２０００年に設立しました。設立以来、各国の選手に練習から試合まで、数多くの機会を与えられるとの確信をもって取り組んでいます。数多くの経験と実績を持つボヘミアン的なプロトレーナーが連携し、独特のノウハウで運営にあたっていることも特徴の一つです。各自が練習時に抱くそれぞれの目標を達成すべく、サポート致します。

Muay Thai training in Bangkok Thailand! !

RompoThai Thai Gym is located in the heart of Bangkok city, Thailand. . We also accept group camps

คุณสามารถฝึกอบรมหลังเลิกงาน โรงยิมเปิดจนถึง 21.00 น.

reviews.text: Wife tried it out with her friend early Saturday morning. It wasnt crowded. The traoner was really nice and encouraged them to push 9n. I think its Japanese owned. The owner spoke fluent Japanese. The girls enjoyed their little workout. Everybody was noce and kind

reviews.name: Aki (อากิ)
reviews.text:
古くから知ってましたが中に入るのは初めてです。

小学生から大人まで日本から来て15歳から本気で頑張ってる17歳の少年‼︎最近ランクインしたそうです。

皆んな真剣に取り組んでる練習生礼儀や挨拶もしっかりしていてびっくりした。

是非頑張ってチャンピオンになって下さいね。
reviews.textTranslated:
I've known about this place for a long time, but this is my first time going inside.

There are people from elementary school age to adults, all from Japan, including a 17-year-old boy who's been seriously working hard since he was 15! Apparently, he recently ranked high.

I was surprised by how serious all the trainees were; their manners and greetings were impeccable.

I hope they do their best and become champions!

reviews.name: あおいうみ
reviews.text: 前日の予約にも関わらず快く対応していただきました。500バーツで貴重な体験ができるので、格闘技が好きな方はぜひ訪れてほしいです。ラインで、日本語で予約できます。
reviews.textTranslated: Despite booking the day before, they kindly accommodated me. It's a valuable experience for only 500 baht, so I highly recommend it to anyone who likes martial arts. Reservations can be made via LINE in Japanese.

reviews.name: KA Z
reviews.text:
レジェンドにお会いすることができました。
日本語で対応していただけます。
またタイに行った際には出稽古に行きます。
お世話になりました🙏
reviews.textTranslated:
I had the opportunity to meet a legend.

He spoke Japanese.

reviews.name: タイ在住歴5年以上
reviews.text:
500バーツの体験レッスンへ行ってきました！タイ人のトレーナーに教わったのですが軽く英語も話せる方で楽しく教えていただけました。初心者ということもあり、2時間のコースでもレッスン自体は1時間程度で終わりました。初心者には無理せずに対応していただけるのでオススメです。

因みにこのジム、昔はあの那須川天心選手や吉成名高選手、三浦孝太選手などといった有名所の選手も来ていたみたいです。

プロから初心者まで幅広い層までいるロンポージム。格闘技, ムエタイ好きなら是非行ってみたい場所です！

※因みに場所は、ロンポーマンションの敷地内にあります。Googleマップだと紛らわしいので注意です。
reviews.textTranslated:
I took a 500 baht trial lesson! I was taught by a Thai trainer who spoke a little English, so the lesson was fun. Since I was a beginner, the two-hour course only lasted about an hour. They're comfortable and accommodating to beginners, so I recommend it.

By the way, this gym has apparently been frequented by famous fighters like Tenshin Nasukawa, Nakataka Yoshinari, and Kota Miura in the past.

Ronpo Gym has a wide range of classes, from professionals to beginners. If you're a fan of martial arts or Muay Thai, this is a place you definitely want to visit!

*By the way, the gym is located on the grounds of Rompo Mansion. It's confusing to find the location on Google Maps, so be careful.

reviews.name: masa hase
reviews.text:
いい汗かきました♫
ロッカーあるけど小さい！！

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 練習お疲れ様でした。シャワールームはありますので、次回お越しの際は、お申し付けください。

reviews.name: Nozomi
reviews.text: 事前予約2人と、飛び入り1人の女3人で体験。500バーツ。外見からは、本格的な音が聞こえてかなりびびってたが、中に入ると1対1で教えてくれ優しかった。最初は、縄跳びから始まり、その後パンチ、キックと続きその後ストレッチをし、1時間。ムエタイ初体験で、激しい運動は普段はしないが、その人に合わせたやり方をしてくれるので、初心者でも安心。やってる間、他の事を考える隙間もないくらいの運動量なので、最高のマインドフルネス。キツイけど、体幹は鍛えられるし、くびれができるだろうなと思うと楽しい。タイらしい体験の為かなりオススメ。グローブは、かなり臭うので、軍手必要。またリング内は、みんなの汗が染み込んでいて、床が濡れていた。これも思い出。
reviews.textTranslated: We had a group of three women, two of us with a reservation and one who showed up. It cost 500 baht. From the outside, the sounds of the studio were quite intimidating, but once inside, the staff were very kind and gave us one-on-one instruction. We started with jumping rope, followed by punches, kicks, and then stretching. It lasted an hour. It was my first time trying Muay Thai, and I don't usually do strenuous exercise, but they tailored the training to each individual, so even beginners felt at ease. The intensity of the workout was so intense that there was no time to think about anything else, making it the ultimate mindfulness session. It was tough, but it strengthened my core, and I was excited to think about how I might develop a slim waist. It was a truly Thai experience, so I highly recommend it. The gloves were quite smelly, so you'll need to wear work gloves. Also, everyone's sweat soaked into the ring, making the floor wet. That's another memorable experience.

reviews.name: naoya aoki
reviews.text:
タイに来た際、ムエタイ体験には素晴らしい道場です👍
僕みたいな素人から経験者までレベルに合わせて本格的なムエタイ体験が出来ると思います。
日本語で指導して頂けるのでとりあえず経験してみたいと思ってる人は体験をオススメします。
僕のような根性の無い人にもそれなりに追い込んでくれます✨
貴重な経験ありがとうございました🙏
reviews.textTranslated:
This is a fantastic dojo for experiencing Muay Thai when you come to Thailand 👍
I think you can get an authentic Muay Thai experience tailored to your level, from beginners like me to experienced practitioners.
Since the instruction is in Japanese, I recommend trying it out if you're just curious.
They'll push even someone like me, who lacks willpower, to a certain extent ✨
Thank you for this valuable experience 🙏

street: Sirey Beach, 40-38 Sirey Beach Road, Ratsada, Mueang District, Phuket 83000
plusCode: VCQQ+W7 Ratsada, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Phuket Moonlit Bay Seaview Resort & Spa. The property is truly amazing — beautifully designed and set against some of the most stunning views we’ve ever experienced. Waking up to the sea each day felt like a dream, and the sunrise view was absolutely breath taking — easily one of the highlights of our stay. The location is incredibly peaceful and private; you really only encounter fellow resort guests, which makes it feel like a hidden escape. You can quite literally roll out of bed and be on the beach in moments — such an amazing experience.What really stood out was the people. Every single member of staff we encountered was friendly, warm, and genuinely helpful — their hospitality made a huge difference to our experience. A very special mention to Phyo from the housekeeping team, who was simply exceptional. Always attentive, thoughtful, and going above and beyond, Phyo made our stay extra comfortable and memorable.In terms of areas for improvement, the physical property could benefit from some updating and minor repairs. That said, it is still well maintained overall, thanks to the incredibly hardworking team who clearly take pride in keeping the resort running smoothly. One important note is that the villa pool could use clearer safety signage indicating its depth. At 1.63m, I could barely touch the bottom, which may not feel very safe for families travelling with children.All in all, a memorable and relaxing stay with breath taking views, a peaceful beachfront setting, and outstanding service. We were so sad to leave and can't wait to be back!

reviews.name: Lisa
reviews.text:
The staff at this resort were incredible, especially Tik and the other ladies at reception. The gentleman working at the front — either security or the porter (we wish we had gotten his name) — was exceptionally kind and friendly, and truly an incredible asset to your property.

The two ladies from housekeeping were fabulous, always warm and attentive. The gentleman working at the pool was also so thoughtful and helpful to my son, who was completing online schooling during our stay. He made sure the air conditioning was on for him and even had incense burning to help keep the mosquitoes away. Such a kind and considerate gesture.

All of the staff were genuinely caring and thoughtful, and the rooms were extremely comfortable. We stayed for two weeks and enjoyed every single day of our time there.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you and your family for staying at our resort and leaving a wonderful review. The hotel has rewarded the employee who was mentioned, and we have also reviewed the records of the security guard who was on duty for you and awarded him accordingly. We wish you and your family a pleasant trip and a happy life. Sincere blessings from a devout Buddhist.

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Luxury, Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value

reviews.name: rulzas
reviews.text: I booked Moonlit Bay Hotel through Hotels.com based on beautiful photos. |The reality was shocking: the property is in a state of disrepair and feels abandoned.  |- The room I was given and the private swimming pool were dirty on arrival.  |- The shower cubicle was blocked.  |- Some area of hotel is neglected, with broken facilities and unsafe conditions.  |- The architecture is beautiful but has been left to ruin, making the place feel like a ghost hotel.  |- Water pressure was extremely weak, and the temperature constantly switched from cold to hot without control.  |- Guest rooms are not cleaned in daily basis unless you specifically request it.||I complained at reception, they asked cleaners to go back and clean the room and swimming pool but,  the lack of maintenance was visible. |I also contacted Hotels.com for relocation, but their support process was slow and costly by phone.  ||Hotels.com should remove or update their advert to reflect the true condition of the property. Guests deserve transparency, not glossy photos of a past that no longer exists.  ||I strongly advise future travelers to avoid booking this hotel until it is properly renovated and maintained.

reviews.name: Diego Garrido Aparicio
reviews.text: I traveled with two friends and it was a wonderful experience. The staff is incredible, both in their attentiveness and hospitality. The hotel is wonderful; they helped us find activities, motorbike rentals, and more. Special mention must be made of the attentiveness and hospitality of the reception staff, particularly Suhanna Tik, a wonderful woman who takes great care of the guests. @garridiyo instagram
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 谢谢你的好评，我们酒店除了10分就是1分，所以酒店一直在寻找适合的客户群体，非常高兴满足了你的需求，希望你再次光临

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Luxury, Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Great value

reviews.name: Marián “Majči” Novák
reviews.text:
A huge disappointment. The hotel completely stopped communicating after we paid for the stay in advance. Due to the situation in the UAE, our flights were canceled, yet the hotel ignored all our requests for a date change or a refund. We received no response at all; they just took our money. I do not recommend this place due to their zero-level customer service.

Update: I would like to address the hotel's response. It is factually incorrect to claim that the hotel contacted me to resolve the situation. I attempted to reach out multiple times via both email and WhatsApp regarding a refund or a date change, but I received absolutely no response to any of my inquiries. Had the hotel actually contacted me as they claim, I would have gladly rescheduled our stay, as we were genuinely looking forward to visiting resort and had no intention of losing our money.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear customer, we are very concerned about the situation in the UAE. At that time, many of our customers in various regions were dealing with check-outs or extensions due to flight issues. The resort is handling all customer inquiries diligently. Our hotel records show that we contacted you promptly to discuss the situation before your check-in, so on behalf of the hotel, I would like to apologize to you.

reviews.name: Yannik S.
reviews.text:
This place is not taken care of. Paying 6000THB per night for a place presented on pictures like this hotel, we expected a really nice place to enjoy our holidays.

Basically everything was run down, dirty and in bad condition. The property is sold as a nice resort, but when you arrive you will be surprised how underwhelming it is. To be fair: the room was ok clean and big. But in an area as remote as this hotel and for this price, you also sell the resort (especially when you call it resort).

Following some of the things we observed:
- severe safety hazards due to missing railings next to a 3 m drop in the floor. I would not let children run around here.
- several rundown apartments
- a lot of dirt around our apartment (I don’t want to call it villa)
- one reason why we booked the place was the fitness center they presented. Machines didn’t work, they were rusty and it was dirty
- The beach area was very dirty
- there is nothing (stores, restaurants) around the property
- the pool looked very dirty

We left the same evening and had to book a new hotel. The hotel tried to upgrade us, but that would not have changed the listed things. After lots of discussions and after several days the agreed to refund two of the three booked nights and turned it like this is very nice of them, since we had a no refund policy on our booking. I would have agreed if we wanted to cancel the booking because for example a change of our plans. Absolutely agree. But if you sell something online and present something totally different that has nothing to do with no refund policy but with fraud.

Up until today, we did not receive the full amount they promised me. I cannot recommend this place to anyone. It is a shame that customers are tricked into paying for this hotel online to find a very bad surprise upon arrival. It ruined two of our precious travel days as well for replanning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We hope you treat other hotels with the same friendliness. We have been in communication with you. There are many of your requests that we are unable to fulfill. Regarding platform refunds, they will be credited to your booking account within a specified business day, as room fees are not settled immediately.

reviews.name: Csaba Orcsik
reviews.text:
The pictures i made are from the neighboring houses
Broken windows, ripped-out whirlpools and destroyed furniture can be seen in the neighboring buildings. Some ceilings are partially collapsed. The surroundings look like an abandoned construction site or like the aftermath of a very wild party where everything was smashed.
Of course you cannot officially enter these apartments because the small side streets leading there are blocked with wooden boards, but I managed to get into a few of them and they clearly showed signs of abandonment. There were no renovation works or any kind of maintenance happening.
It is quite irresponsible from the management that some of these apartments are partly open and accessible, meaning even small children could potentially enter.
The staff tried to help where they could, and this review is not about them but about the place itself and the room, which already had an unpleasant smell and very worn, old furniture.
The garden and pool were full of dry leaves and looked neglected. The beach was covered with trash and stones, and a local resident told me that even at high tide the rocks are still visible in the water.
I cannot recommend this place to anyone — maybe only to someone planning a full renovation, because the location certainly has potential.
So we cancelled our booking and looked for another hotel. Fortunately, we received a full refund from Booking.com and they even transferred some additional compensation. A top-class response — we really did not expect that.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Guest, thank you for choosing our resort. Because our hotel is jointly owned, we can only use half of the property, so we have been working diligently to maintain it. The damaged half belongs to a private owner, and we do not have the right to enter it, so I apologize for that. Regarding your refund request, the hotel always strives to provide excellent service to every guest. If you have any complaints, please don't deliberately smear our reputation. Maintaining a beachfront hotel is difficult, and our staff works hard every day to create a clean and comfortable environment. After seeing your feedback, we have applied to enter the room that is not ours for cleaning and closure. Finally, we wish you a pleasant trip.

reviews.name: Jack Robinson
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 nights and was amazing from start to finish! Stayed in the villa with private pool and jaccuzi and the location and views top service! Staff friendly breakfast is ok but we didn't eat much!

reviewContext.Hotel highlights: Luxury, Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Great value, High-tech

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: The hotel met my expectations; the rooms are spacious, though in some places it’s clear they need renovating. My room was on the second floor of the villa, and there was an issue with the water pressure in the shower. One of the highlights was the breakfast—it was good. The shower was also excellent.

reviews.name: Karel Peška
reviews.text:
Our experience was excellent.
What makes this hotel stand out:
excellent and very helpful staff, very good and generous breakfasts, all additional services at very reasonable prices (which is really not the standard in Thailand) and very good cuisine.
The accommodation is nice and very spacious. It is clear that the hotel is undergoing renovation, so some buildings are uninhabitable, and some parts of the space need a renovation, but if you are not expecting perfect and polished conditions and are looking for good value for money, then this is a great choice!
As for the location, it is ideal for those who want to stay away from the hustle and bustle of Phuket and its tourists, but still be within a few kilometers' driving distance.
We stayed at approximately 20 accommodations in Thailand, and this was one of the absolute best.
Thank you
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We bow in gratitude for your positive outlook and constant smiles. Our staff remembers you all and appreciates your politeness and good manners. We hope you'll return to Phuket soon and remember to book our resort again. We've noted your preferences; thank you.

reviews.name: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at this hotel, the rooms were very spacious. We had direct access to the beach, and staff were very friendly. we loved the restaurants just a short walk down the beach, and the Jetski hire right next door. Suitable for those wanting to get away from the noise of crowded beaches and locations. we used grab to order takeaway and drinks, food was arriving a little cold due to the distance from main area but never the less, it was great... Thanks to reception staff, and the male staff member that assisted us with Taxi.

reviews.name: Pioneer32947725358
reviews.text: A huge disappointment. The hotel completely stopped communicating after we paid for the stay in advance. Due to the situation in the UAE, our flights were canceled, yet the hotel ignored all our requests for a date change or a refund. We received no response at all; they just took our money. I do not recommend this place due to their zero-level customer service.

reviews.name: Madison Yanda
reviews.text: We stayed here recently and were a little bit nervous about the bad reviews in the past. I do see where some of the mold reviews come in as this is right on the water and there was definitely rooms that looked like they were damaged in what I’d assume was some sort of monsoon or other natural disaster. But the room we stayed in was magnificent. We had our own private condo right on the beach. We had so much room and could easily fit a whole family here. They did have a full size kitchen so if we wanted to cook we could but they didn’t have any dishes to cook with. The staff was incredible and kind, we were so sad to leave them. The location is perfect as it is right on its own very private beach. It’s a little bit of a drive outside of old town Phuket but it was easy to get food delivered and a short drive into town if needed. The breakfast was good and included for free with many different options. The property also had numerous stray cats and dogs that would frequently which we absolutely loved and fed them every morning.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your understanding. We have tried our best to keep the room dry during the recent typhoon. We will work harder to serve you next time you visit us.

reviews.text:
My stay was at Phuket Moonlit Bay Seaview Resort & Spa,
Catastrophic condition. The entire property is dirty, unhygienic, and severely neglected. Common areas and the beach were filthy, furniture was stained, rust was visible everywhere, and there was a strong, unpleasant sanitary smell throughout the resort.

Despite complaining, no immediate solution was offered. I checked out after only one night.
Only a partial refund was issued (4 out of 7 nights).
Not as described. Not recommended.

reviews.name: Denis
reviews.text:
Let me share my in-depth thoughts about our stay at this hotel. We spent 5 days here on a family trip with my wife and daughter — and it was amazing! Our villa was right on the beach, which made the whole experience feel incredibly private and relaxing. You wake up, and the ocean is literally in front of you. The entire villa itself was fantastic.

I’ve seen comments saying some rooms are in bad condition — well, as of November 9th, 2025, our villa was fully renovated, spotless, and perfectly maintained. I also noticed reviews calling the breakfasts “basic.” Not sure what “basic” means to those people, but as someone who enjoys a good breakfast, I can say theirs were absolutely more than enough. They even changed up the main dishes daily. Totally satisfied.

Our cleaning lady was extremely humble, kind, and efficient.

What matters most to us is privacy — and here you’re truly surrounded by nature. If you want to disconnect, relax your mind, and feel secluded, this place is 200% the right spot.

Special thanks to the manager, Lily, who personally oversaw and attended to several of our requests.

So honestly, I’m not sure where the earlier 1-star reviews are coming from. Maybe in the past the situation was different — or maybe some people are just unhappy in general and project that onto everything around them. But right now, Moonlit is doing great. Again, our review is specifically about the villa — it was amazing, and the service was superb!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely review! It has fueled our enthusiasm for our work. Many people are unaware of the harsh conditions in Thailand; seaside hotels are subject to severe corrosion, requiring annual renovations and repairs. Unfortunately, we encountered flooding, so we had to inspect and repair each hotel individually. Of course, as a service industry professional, accepting criticism is an inevitable part of the process. Therefore, we hope every guest who stays at our hotel has a wonderful trip and a pleasant stay.

At that particular moment I did wish I knew more Thai language so that I could converse more with God. He was very polite and friendly. Very mediocre experience… warm services but overall not great quality. For this price of massage I didn’t even get a welcoming tea. Also be careful about the tipping as well. Therapist said they are tipped by hours, which is not what I was told when I made the booking.

And the massage ended 10min earlier than it should, including the shower - which usually not included in a massage in many other shops.

I don’t usually mind if the massage ends a bit earlier if I was relaxed after the service. The therapist is clearly not very professional as he only repeats the same back and leg rub over and over again.

I do not recommend this place because it’s overpriced for the quality of services they provide.

Update: Right after my review there had been several new 5 star reviews popped up lol… guys see for yourself, just be careful!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Curtis Qiu,

​Thank you for your candid feedback. I am the owner of MENCARE Sathorn, and I was genuinely shocked and deeply saddened to read about your experience. Please accept my most sincere apologies for the unprofessional service you received.

​I would like to clarify that the individual who attended to you was a Guest Therapist who had only been with us for a month. It is now clear that his conduct and service quality did not meet our professional standards. Please rest assured that we have taken this matter very seriously; we have issued a formal warning and suspended him from our service roster indefinitely to protect our reputation and the quality our customers expect.

​Regarding the tipping and the service time: what you experienced was an isolated incident caused by this specific individual. Our regular team members are honest, straightforward, and highly trained professionals who do not engage in such misleading practices.
​I truly empathize with your frustration. We would love the opportunity to make this right. If you are open to it, I would like to personally invite you back to experience a session with one of our core Professional Therapists. We want to ensure you receive the high-quality care you originally sought and compensate for the disappointment of your previous visit.

​Thank you for bringing this to our attention, as it helps us improve. We hope to have the chance to restore your faith in our shop.
​Sincerely,

​The Management
MENCARE Sathorn

reviews.name: 黑目華
reviews.text:
I booked a massage at this shop on May 24, 2026. I chose the shop's top-recommended program — a 2-hour deep relaxation massage that costs 1499 baht. The shop claims to have been in business for ten years and provides professional massage and spa services, but I couldn't feel its professionalism at all. From start to finish, I felt ignored, neglected and deceived. It was absolutely terrible!
1.The temperature inside the massage room was too low, and I felt very cold when I got out of the bathtub.
2.The water in the bathtub was not hot enough, and there was very little water, which couldn't relieve my fatigue properly.
3.Technicians should not leave the room during the scheduled service time, but the technician who served me left three times halfway. Two times she left to get massage materials, which took about ten minutes in total. Shouldn't these be prepared in advance before customers enter the room? The other time she left for more than ten minutes on the pretext of going to the toilet, but the service didn't get extended at all in the end. Is this reasonable?
4.When I was washing my body, I was completely naked, but the technician actually opened the door. Other technicians who were eating outside saw me directly. Is this correct?
5.The technician was obviously very careless during the service. For example, she checked her phone, looked in the mirror, made unnecessary noises, etc. All these behaviors are inappropriate for a professional technician in my opinion.
6.The technician's massage skill is far from the introduction that the shop sent me when I made an appointment. The introduction is obviously exaggerated, and the actual experience doesn't show any professional level at all. It can almost be said that she doesn't know how to give a massage and doesn't understand the service. If she is really a professional technician, then she was just being deliberately careless.
Professional technicians should pay more attention to details during the service and always put the customer's experience first. For example, they shouldn't check their phones during the service time, and they can help customers dry their bodies after rinsing.
This consumption far failed to meet my expectations and was very disappointing. If this is a professional massage parlor, how could it have such terrible service and such unqualified technicians? It's simply incredible! But I still gave an extra 50% tip to the technician who served me, hoping that this technician named TOP can reflect on her work attitude, pay more attention to work details and be more professional in her future work. Finally, when I left, I didn't even hear a "thank you". From the moment I entered the shop to the moment I walked out, I didn't even get a glass of plain water. My feelings were completely ignored. Do you guys think this shop is worth visiting?
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Subject: Sincere Apologies Regarding Your Recent Experience

​Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback regarding your visit on May 24th. I am deeply shocked and saddened to hear about the numerous shortcomings during your session. Please accept our most sincere apologies for the distress and discomfort this has caused you.

​We are incredibly sorry that the room temperature and bath water were not up to standard, and most importantly, that the therapist failed to prepare the equipment beforehand. To provide some context, this individual was a Guest Therapist. While we strive to maintain strict quality control across all our services, we clearly fell short in this instance. However, please know that this is absolutely no excuse for the poor service and lack of privacy you experienced. Your privacy and comfort should always be our top priority.

​We fully accept responsibility for what happened. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we are treating this matter with the utmost urgency. We are immediately addressing these issues with our management team to ensure that strict protocols regarding professionalism, preparation, and privacy are enforced, so that no other customer will ever have to face an experience like this again.

​Once again, we are deeply sorry for failing to meet your expectations and for the lack of hospitality you received. Thank you for bringing this to our attention so we can improve.

​Sincerely,
​MENCARE, management team

reviews.name: 蔡洋洋
reviews.text:
超雷！完全不推薦 ZEE 師傅，請大家小心踩雷

為了不讓其他人花冤枉錢，分享一下這次給 ZEE 師傅按摩的崩潰經驗

首先，按摩技術只能用「爛透了」來形容
手法完全雜亂無章，左右邊按法根本不對稱，抹油的動作像機器人一樣生硬又粗魯，按摩點位完全沒按在位置上，感覺就像是沒受過訓的新手

或許冷氣很冷，技師全程裹得很緊，完全沒有任何氛圍可言，後來小費報價 1,500 泰銖，結果最後竟然只能靠我自己豐富的想像力來畫下句點，我不確定這是否是行情小費價位，但對我來說完全不會推薦朋友去

以這個預算，不管是看對方的外在條件還是服務誠意，在其他店甚至是同店的其他師傅絕對都好很多。

後來詢問同行另外兩位朋友，大家同樣都給 1,500 泰銖的小費，結果另外兩個人得到的服務品質比我好上幾百倍，完全就是看人下菜碟。

如果你追求的是專業按摩或是好的互動體驗，強烈建議直接跳過這位 ZEE 技師，完全不值得

不確定這家開多久，但整體環境其實看得出有歲月，盥洗空間比一般按摩店還簡陋，唯一硬要說的優點大概只有按摩床很大張
reviews.textTranslated:
Absolutely terrible! I strongly advise against ZEE masseur; please beware!

To prevent others from wasting their money, I'm sharing my horrific experience with ZEE.

First, his massage technique can only be described as "utterly awful." His movements were completely chaotic and disorganized; the left and right sides were asymmetrical; his oil application was stiff and rough, like a robot; and he completely missed the target areas. It felt like he was an untrained novice.

Perhaps because of the air conditioning, the masseur was wrapped up tightly the entire time, creating absolutely no atmosphere. He asked for a tip of 1,500 baht, but in the end, I had to rely on my imagination to decide what to tip. I'm not sure if this is the going rate, but I would never recommend him to anyone.

With that budget, considering both his appearance and the sincerity of his service, you could find much better masseuses at other establishments, even within the same establishment.

Later, I asked two other friends who were with me, and we all tipped 1,500 baht. However, the other two received hundreds of times better service than I did; it was clearly a case of tiered service based on the client's perceived status.

If you're looking for a professional massage or a good interactive experience, I strongly suggest skipping this ZEE masseuse; she's not worth it at all.

I'm not sure how long this place has been open, but the overall environment clearly shows its age. The restrooms are even more basic than those in typical massage parlors. The only redeeming quality I could find is probably the large massage bed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are deeply sorry to hear about your disappointing experience with Zee. It is disheartening to learn that your service fell short, especially compared to the experience your friends had.
​We are committed to improving Zee's massage quality to match our standards immediately. We have a team of over 30 other talented therapists, and we would be honored to welcome you back to experience their superior skills.
​We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your feedback, as it helps us grow.

​Sincerely,
MENCARE Management Team

A massage parlor near Chiang Mai Airport.

reviews.name: Cathy Thung
reviews.text:
環境衛生，司傅都好好。唯一不好的地方是價錢牌有4張不同。
我在剛開門的時候去，職員給我的價錢是正常。
在我們完成後，老闆給我們的價錢是兩倍。
原本因為環境和司傅會再訪，但係因為海鮮價。準備去這家的人要小心！
reviews.textTranslated:
The environment was clean, and the chef was excellent. The only downside was that there were four different price tags.

I went when they first opened, and the staff gave me the normal price.

After we finished eating, the owner doubled the price.

I would have returned because of the environment and the chef, but I changed my mind because of the seafood prices. Be careful if you're planning to go here!

reviews.name: 시호
reviews.text:
후식 과자랑 티 맛있고.. 시설 그럭저럭 깨끗해요. 근데 가게는 큰데 방이 나눠져 있는 구조가 아니라서 마사지 받는 내내 너무 시끄러웠어요 ㅠㅠ 마사지 압이나 코스도 개인에 따라 만족도가 다르긴 하겠지만 저는 다른 곳에 비해 만족스럽진 않았어욤..  뭐랄까 대량생산..? 공장형 마사지..? ㅎㅎ..? 표현할 말이 없는,, 그리고 90분 코스인데 마사지사가 중간에 화장실도 다녀오심...◜◡◝

단체 여행이라 큰 방이 필요하다 or 마지막 날이라 시간이 부족하다 둘 중에 하나면 여기서 받으시고 아니라면 다른 곳을 가보시는 것도 좋은 것 같아요..!^.^
reviews.textTranslated:
The dessert cookies and tea were delicious, and the facilities were reasonably clean. However, although the shop is large, the rooms aren't separated, so it was incredibly noisy the entire time I was getting the massage ㅠㅠ. While satisfaction with the pressure and course might vary by individual, I wasn't as satisfied compared to other places... How should I put it... mass-produced...? Factory-style massage...? Haha...? I can't find the words to describe it... Also, it was a 90-minute course, but the masseuse even went to the restroom in the middle... ◜◡◝

If you are on a group trip and need a large room, or if it is your last day and you are short on time, I recommend getting your massage here. Otherwise, I think it would be a good idea to try somewhere else..!^.^

reviews.name: 이동경
reviews.text:
일주일에 2번은 마사지를 받는곳입니다
마사지 받을때 사장님께서 신경을 많이 써주셔서 매번 마사지를 잘 받고 옵니다.
자주 가다보니 저와 잘 맞는 마사지사도 생겨서 예약할때도 그분으로 예약해주십니다.
마사지끝나고 다과를 먹으면 꿀맛입니다
괜찮은 마사지샵을 알아보려고 리뷰확인하신다면 여기를 추천드립니다
reviews.textTranslated:
This is where I get a massage twice a week.

The owner pays close attention to me during the massage, so I always leave feeling satisfied.

Since I visit so often, I’ve found a masseuse I get along well with, so they make sure to book that person for me whenever I make a reservation.

The snacks after the massage are absolutely delicious.

If you are checking reviews to find a good massage shop, I highly recommend this place.

너무 시원합니다 🥹 치앙마이 와서 극락을 맛보네요.. 약하지도 세지도 않게 딱 좋은 강도로 마삳지해주셔서 뒤에는 꿀잠 잤습니다.. 사장님이 한국분이셔서 더 신경써주셔서 감사했어요.. 모먼트너티스 재즈바 가시는 분들은
근처 마사지샵 추천드립니다 넓고 쾌적해요 👍

It was so refreshing 🥹 I feel like I’m in paradise since coming to Chiang Mai.. The massage was done with just the right intensity—not too weak, not too strong—so I slept like a baby afterwards.. I was grateful that the owner is Korean and took extra care of me.. For those visiting Moment's Jazz Bar,

I recommend this nearby massage shop. It is spacious and comfortable 👍

reviews.text:

Are there any negative stars? The masseuses ask for tips, and the massages are incredibly painful!

When Taiwanese tourists go, the owner tells us to be quiet, but treats Korean tourists completely differently.

reviews.name: 성규
reviews.text:
귀국전에 기분좋게 마사지받고 가려고 방문함 타이마사지 1시간에 팁 100바트 ( 선불인데 카운터에서 요구함 ) 포함 총 500바트 결제함
30개국이 넘게 돌아다니며 다양한 마사지를 받아봤지만 단연코 제일 별로였음... 마사지 좋아하시는 분들은 아시겠지만 잘하는 마사지사들은 압을 떠나서 시원하다는 느낌이 듦
받다가 편안해서 잠이 올 정도로

처음에 마사지 해주시는 분이 너무 아프기만해서 아프다고 쩹을 연발했으나 계속 아프기만 함 너무 아프다고 강하게 어필하니 이제는 또 하는 둥 마는 둥.... 마사지하시는 분중에서 손바닥이 이렇게 건조하고 딱딱한것도 처음이었음 강도가 아주 강하게 아니면 아주 약하게 밖에 없는 건지는 모르겠으나 받다가 손톱까지 느껴져서 15분 되기 전에 교체요구 , 교체 해서 새로 오신 분도 영 아니었음  전반적으로 내 몸을 함부로 대한다는 느낌이 너무 많이 들었음.마사지사들이 자세 바꿀때 내 몸을 지탱하면서 자세를 바꾼다거나 꺾는 정도가 너무 지나쳤음 마치 주짓수 관절기 사용하는것마냥....

안그래도 감염이 신경쓰이는데 여러모로 힘들고 불편했음

평소에 압을 세게 받기도 하고 다양한 마사지를 많이 받는 편임에도 불구하고 그냥 아프기만 해서 속상했음 귀국전에 마사지 받으실 분들은 차라리 여유있게 시내에서 받고 가시는 걸 추천
reviews.textTranslated:
I visited the massage parlor to enjoy a relaxing massage before returning home. I paid a total of 500 baht for a one-hour Thai massage, including a 100 baht tip (prepaid, but requested at the counter).
I've traveled to over 30 countries and received a variety of massages, but this was by far the worst... Those who enjoy massage know that a good masseuse feels refreshing, regardless of the pressure.
I was so comfortable that I almost fell asleep.

At first, the masseuse kept complaining that it hurt so much, but it just kept hurting. When I insisted, she just stopped.... I've never seen a masseuse's palms so dry and hard. I'm not sure if the pressure is too strong or too weak, but I felt my fingernails during the massage, so I had to ask for a replacement before the 15-minute mark. The replacement was also not very effective. Overall, I felt like they were being too rude to me. The masseuses were too aggressive in supporting my body while changing positions, or even bending it. It felt like I was being rude. It was like using a jiu-jitsu joint...

I was already worried about infection, but it was difficult and uncomfortable in many ways.

I usually get a lot of pressure and a variety of massages, but I was upset that it just hurt. If you're getting a massage before returning home, I recommend getting one in the city at your leisure.

reviews.name: Angel Barcelona
reviews.text: Hemos ido un grupo de amigos, dos horas, masaje completo, pies, piernas, espalda, cabeza, hombros. Espectacular, nos ha encantado a todos. Muy higiénico y profesional. Presión adecuada, algunos pedimos fuerte y otros suave. Muy recomendable.
reviews.textTranslated: A group of friends and I went for a two-hour full-body massage, covering feet, legs, back, head, and shoulders. It was spectacular; we all loved it. Very hygienic and professional. The pressure was just right—some of us asked for firm pressure, others for gentle. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Jon
reviews.text: Visited recently . Met by male receptionist showed me the listings for massages . The place was ok but a little untidy.  Was shown on phone 10 ladies , one I liked picture of was off today so settled for choice 2.  Was given a glass of water and led upstairs by a lady.  Told to take shower then left for a while.  The place has lots of individual rooms , sone with massage tables & others like mine a mattress on the floor .. the lady appeared not quite looking like the photo , but was pleasant enough , English limited. Dress in t shirt & tracksuit bottoms which I did not expect . She gave a very good oily massage and was a little bit subtle at times.  She asked if I was ok. She was pleasant enough without being too over the top , a little mechanical in her route but it ended well , was then offered shower & served tea downstairs. Overall a very good massage and I felt relaxed.  Shall visit again ka. Thanks

reviews.name: Hiro HASEGAWA
reviews.text:
タイマッサージ1時間のコースが比較的リーズナブルだったので試しに訪れてみました。
結論から言うと、マッサージ以前の問題がありました。部屋に通されてから15分以上待ったにもかかわらずマッサージ師が現れなかったため、キャンセルして退店しました。
オンヌット駅周辺には同価格帯の優良なマッサージ店が多数ありますので、わざわざここで不快な思いをする必要はないかと思います。
reviews.textTranslated:
I decided to try this place because the 1-hour Thai massage course was relatively reasonably priced.

To put it bluntly, there were problems even before the massage itself. After being shown to my room, I waited for over 15 minutes, but the masseuse never appeared, so I canceled and left.

There are many excellent massage parlors in the On Nut area at similar price points, so I don't think it's worth having an unpleasant experience here.

reviews.name: Gabriele Liedtke
reviews.text: I’ve had many massages in Thailand over the years and I’m usually very satisfied with the high standard. Unfortunately, this was the first time I had a really uncomfortable experience. Even though I booked a neck and shoulder massage, the first half hour was mostly focused on my head, with a lot of stroking and pressing rather than proper massage. The technique overall felt very repetitive, with only a few movements, and at times the pressure was too strong and quite uncomfortable. I just wanted to share this as constructive feedback.

reviews.name: Blake Harris
reviews.text: Let’s Massage offers a fantastic foot massage experience for just 350 baht. The air-conditioned environment, possibly the only one on the beach, adds an extra level of comfort. I had a really refreshing massage. I can't believe a full-body Thai massage is only 300 baht. May you be blessed and your business prosper!

reviews.text: Единственное место с кондиционером ТОЛЬКО из-за этого мы сходили на массаж здесь. Массажировали кое как, палочкой пользоваться не умеет, ругалась на меня, что я с песком с пляжа пришёл. Ещё и ждать пришлось, не рекомендую!!
reviews.textTranslated: It's the only place with air conditioning, and that's the only reason we went for a massage here. The massage was poor, she didn't know how to use a stick, and she scolded me for coming back from the beach with sand. We also had to wait. I don't recommend it!

reviews.name: Dorota
reviews.text: Fajne miejsce przy plaży. Klimatyzowane pomieszczenie i co ważne czyste. Odejmuje gwiazdkę za to, ze masażystka była zakatarzona, ale jak poprosiłam o maskę dla siebie to przyniosła ją już inna Pani i dokończyła masaz. Masaz bardzo o.k.
reviews.textTranslated: A nice place by the beach. The room is air-conditioned and, importantly, clean. I'm taking a star off because the masseuse had a cold, but when I asked for a mask, another lady brought it to me and finished the massage. The massage was very good.

reviews.name: Ki Ads
reviews.text: Хочу порекомендовать мастера Tata. Настоящий профессионал , один из лучших массажей в моей жизни. Ходил сюда несколько раз, хочется возвращаться. Сами говорите мастеру свои предпочтения : easy, medium or strong. Не стесняйтесь говорить свои предпочтения если они у вас есть )
reviews.textTranslated: I would highly recommend Tata. A true professional, one of the best massages I've ever had. I've been there several times and always want to come back. Tell the massage therapist your preferences: easy, medium, or strong. Don't hesitate to express your preferences if you have any.

reviews.name: Alex Lee
reviews.text:
Nai han beach에 스노클링 좀 해보려고 왔는데, 파도가 너무 쎄서 커피 시켜놓고 해변에서 멍때리고 있었는데요.. 저희가 커피를 주문했던 haha 레스토랑 직원 분께 영업당해서 마사지하러 오게 되었습니다. 이분, 매우 무뚝뚝한 표정으로 영업을 하시다니... 믿음이 갔습니다.

가격 저렴하고, 발마사지와 오일마사지 다 잘하시는 듯 합니다. 9살 아이와 함께 발 마사지 받았는데, 친절하고 실력 좋습니다. 내부도 깔끔하고 에어컨 빵빵합니다.

Nai han beach 가시면 한번 마사지받으러 가볼만 한 곳입니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
We came to Nai Han Beach to try some snorkeling, but the waves were too strong, so we just ordered coffee and zoned out on the beach. However, we ended up coming here for a massage after being persuaded by a staff member at the Haha Restaurant where we had ordered our coffee. I was surprised that this person was selling us something with such a stoic expression... it actually gave me confidence.

The prices are affordable, and they seem to be good at both foot massages and oil massages. I got a foot massage with my 9-year-old child, and they were friendly and skilled. The interior is clean, and the air conditioning is powerful.

If you visit Nai Han Beach, this is a place worth checking out for a massage.

reviews.name: Nikita
reviews.text: Мне все понравилось, дешевле чем на пляже на 100 бат, мне попалась старше всех массажистка, палочкой управляет клево, массаж ног
reviews.textTranslated: I liked everything, it was 100 baht cheaper than on the beach, I got an older masseuse, she uses a wand really well, foot massage

reviews.name: Elmira Saturnova
reviews.text:
Сегодня здесь случился один из самых худших массажей за год с лишним жизни в Таиланде - и самый травматичный как физически, так и морально.

Мастер Mingkamol (не знаю ее никнейма) не должна работать с людьми!

Делала Thai Mix с маслом.
Во время массажа спины локтями эта женщина постоянно задевала мой позвоночник и с силой проводила по нему, что ни в коем случае нельзя делать. Я ей сказала об этом, но это не сильно помогло.

Все элементы тайской растяжки были выполнены так резко и так небрежно, что повредили мне связки колена - помазала тигровым бальзамом и сказала Сорри.

У меня было ощущение, что это был не массаж, а какое-то издевательство.

Я никогда в жизни не испытывала на себе НАСТОЛЬКО ГРУБЫХ прикосновений массажиста. То, как она обращалась с моим телом, как перекладывала мои конечности и сгибала суставы, было просто ужасно - грубо, резко, бесчеловечно, как будто я просто мешок с костями, который ей подбросили разбирать.
Даже мясники с мясом бывают нежнее, честное слово! Как можно так ненавидеть то, что делаешь?

Ощущения отвратительные.
За 500 бат (причем я была со своим маслом) я получила болящие позвонки, травмированное колено, «сорри» и ощущение абсолютно бесчеловечного надругательства над своим телом.

Никогда, никогда не ходите к этому массажисту!!! Берегите себя!
Менеджменту заведения необходимо обратить внимание на это зверство. Просто ужас.
reviews.textTranslated:
Today I had one of the worst massages I've had in over a year of living in Thailand – and the most traumatic, both physically and mentally.

Mingkamol (I don't know her nickname) shouldn't work with people!

I was doing a Thai Mix with oil.
During the back massage, this woman kept hitting my spine with her elbows and dragging her elbows down it, which is absolutely not allowed. I told her about it, but it didn't help much.

All the Thai stretching techniques were performed so abruptly and so carelessly that they damaged my knee ligaments. She rubbed tiger balm on me and said "sorry."

I felt like it wasn't a massage, but some kind of torture.

I've never experienced such a rough touch from a massage therapist in my life. The way she handled my body, the way she rearranged my limbs and bent my joints, was simply horrific – rough, harsh, inhumane, as if I were just a bag of bones thrown to her to sort through.
Even butchers are more tender with their meat, honestly! How can you hate what you do so much?

It felt disgusting.
For 500 baht (and I brought my own oil), I got sore vertebrae, an injured knee, a "sorry," and the feeling of absolutely inhumane abuse of my body.

Never, ever go to this massage therapist!!! Take care of yourself!
The management needs to look into this atrocity. It's simply appalling.
