reviews.text:
This was the worst hatha yoga class I have had. The teacher Linda is experienced at yoga but her teaching was poor. She didn't support the beginners, just saying the names of the postures and not explaining what to do with their body to get in to the posture. She also encouraged them to keep pushing further when it was clear they were already at their limit. She made everyone 1 by 1 stretch against a beam and then commented on their flexibility, I saw a lot of people were embarrassed by this.

To be fair to the establishment I got a free ginger tea before the class and I have heard their other classes are good. I personally wouldn't go back after this experience, not with so many other places to choose between.

reviews.text: One of the best yoga classes I have ever been to! Harry was our teacher for the 5.30pm Vinyasa Hatha and he was so great. There were three of us in the class all with different abilities and he still managed to make the practice flow beautifully. I left the class feeling so refreshed and also happy to have learnt some new poses! Would recommend to everyone passing through Pai to practice here :)

reviews.text:
Unfortunately I can’t recommend the yoga classes.
I joined to different classes and both weren’t good. Both teacher don’t speak English very well, so I really struggled to understand what the said.

The Asthanga Yoga Teacher didn’t really gave easy options for people who don’t have much experience in yoga. I am also a yoga teacher so for me it was easy, but I saw how other students struggled to do the asanas.
The Vinyasa Yoga Teacher made, in my opinion, too many jokes during the class and talked too much random stuff.

Yoga is an ancient practice and should be taken serious. It’s okay to make fun, but not all the time.

reviews.name: jacqueline mitrovic
reviews.text: I was lucky enough to go on a quiet day and got a 121 with Linda the wonderful yoga teacher. It is a lovely, typically Thai place, which is what I like. Linda took me through a thoughtful Hatha practice and gave me some adaptations for when my body didn't want to go fully into the pose. As Linda is Thai I didn't expect her English to be perfect but it is very good. I listened carefully and was able to follow well. This helped bring me really into the session too. I've come away feeling like I've got a new body. kob kun Kah Linda 🙏

reviews.name: Vadim Vdovin
reviews.text:
I was looking for a dedicated hot desk for about three weeks, and this company offers that option. Unfortunately, the experience with pricing was disappointing.
First, I received an email with pricing that turned out to be misleading. Then, the offers were provided without VAT for private clients. Finally, when I decided to take a 10-day membership just for limited visiting hours, I was informed about an additional activation fee.
Overall, the pricing model feels unclear and discouraging, so I decided not to proceed. I hope the company can improve transparency and communication around pricing in the future.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Vadim, thank you for sharing your feedback and we’re sorry to hear about your experience with unclear and inconsistent pricing. We understand how frustrating it is to receive differing information regarding VAT, activation fees, and overall costs, and this is not the level of transparency we aim to provide. To ensure your concerns are properly reviewed and addressed, we recommend raising this directly by creating a support ticket so the team can look into the pricing communication and provide clarification.

reviews.name: Antonio Diaz
reviews.text:
I initially subscribed to this company’s office service. After the subscription period ended, I confirmed that I wanted to renew at the same price for another year. However, after agreeing to renew, the price was raised without any prior notice. I tried explaining this issue multiple times, but my concerns were ignored, and I was told that the only solution was to accept the price increase. Now, for a second time, they are trying to raise the price again.

This company seems to take advantage of the difficulty involved in changing a registered business address, knowing how much of a hassle it is for clients to switch providers. Raising prices like this after an agreement has been made is both unethical and unfair. I would not recommend this service to anyone who values transparency and professionalism.

As you can also see in the most recent reviews, their support is totally nonexistent and shows no sign of understanding the situation. Of course, the only solution they offer is to commit to another year and accept a price increase.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Antonio Diaz, thank you for taking the time to leave us feedback. We are so sorry to hear that you have had a less than positive experience with us. Please rest assured that your concerns were escalated to our global customer services and your centre team to provide further support. Your ticket reference number is C-1436498-Y4F7. Thanks.

NOTE:
Be warned 1 : There is this rediculous "exit fee" where you will be charge a hefty 30% of the rental fee.
Be warned 2 : Late payment of exit fee will be charged as well even though there is not a single word from the staff and written text about the late payment of this fee
Be warned 3 : They operates through app and email only. So be warned of the random ridiculous surplus charge such as "exit fee" throw into your email and force you to pay before their required date.
Be warned 4 : Reception helps nothing to make thing any better at all and can only say what they are programmed to say, "the systems blah blah blah". Discuss anything with them makes no progress.

If you think these 4 option is acceptable then go. For me, this place is the worst nightmare.

P.S. After 2 months, I still have not had my deposit fee back.

reviews.name: НатусЯ НатусЯ
reviews.text:
Хочу висловити щиру вдячність цьому салону за чудовий досвід масажу.

Окремо хочу відзначити майстра Кіту — вона зробила масаж просто неймовірним: дуже професійно, з відчуттям кожного м’яза, і водночас максимально делікатно та турботливо. Після сеансу відчувається повне розслаблення і легкість у тілі.

Сам салон залишає дуже приємне враження: чисто, спокійна атмосфера, уважний персонал.

Щиро рекомендую це місце всім, хто хоче справжній якісний масаж і відпочинок для тіла та душі. Обов’язково повернуся ще.
reviews.textTranslated:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to this salon for the wonderful massage experience.

I would like to specially mention the master Kita - she did an incredible massage: very professionally, feeling every muscle, and at the same time as delicately and caringly as possible. After the session, you feel complete relaxation and lightness in your body.

The salon itself leaves a very pleasant impression: clean, calm atmosphere, attentive staff.

I sincerely recommend this place to everyone who wants a real quality massage and relaxation for body and soul. I will definitely come back again.

reviews.text: Не понравилось! 😡 Я считаю если умеют делать массаж но, значит салон хороший, но тут говорю больно, тайка сменится и продолжает давить ещё сильней, пока не убрала ногу, так и продолжала, и ещё мне не понравилось, что ноги не мыли а протерли тряпкой!
reviews.textTranslated: I didn't like it! 😡 I think if they know how to give a massage, it means the salon is good, but then I said it hurt, the Thai woman changed and continued to press even harder until I removed my foot, and she continued like that, and I also didn't like that they didn't wash my feet but wiped them with a rag!

reviews.name: Brian Jungwiwattanaporn
reviews.text: Took my ten year old here for private lessons. The coaches are good with kids and he learned some Muay Thai basics, which along with exercise is what we were looking for. Seems like a good gym for people to drop in and try Muay Thai through an hour class. Instruction looked solid and the variety of activities/drills kept my son engaged.

reviews.name: T T
reviews.text: I absolutely love training at this Muay Thai gym! The classes are the perfect pace — challenging enough to push you, but never overwhelming. The instructors are incredibly kind and patient, yet still very professional. They really take the time to make sure our form is correct and that we understand each movement. What I love most is that it doesn’t matter if you have any prior training — they meet you where you are and help you build real skill and confidence. I always leave feeling stronger, more supported, and inspired to keep improving. Highly recommend for anyone looking to learn Muay Thai in a positive, encouraging environment! Thank you Mr. Kwan, Hongte and Gaow

reviews.name: Elisabeth Marie Kongssted
reviews.text: I had the best time training at this gym! Very friendly trainers, great English and just very skilled and super friendly. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.name: i
reviews.text:
Champions Gym Chiang Mai is hands-down one of the best experiences we’ve ever had! We came in with zero experience, and in just one month, the progress has been incredible.

Huge shoutout to Mr. Kwan, Gaow, and Hongte — they’re patient, motivating, and genuinely care about helping you improve. Every session pushes you in the best way, and the energy in the gym is always positive and supportive.

Whether you’re a complete beginner or already experienced, this place will make you stronger, more confident, and totally addicted to training. We couldn’t recommend Champions Gym Chiang Mai more!

ownerDescription: Proud Thai Massage sits just steps from the Shangri-La Hotel at 64/1 Charoen Krung Road in Bang Rak — walk straight down from the hotel entrance and you're there in about a minute. Our skilled therapists offer traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy oil, foot massage, and hot stone treatments, each session adjusted to your pressure preference and time available. It's the easiest possible stop to recharge mid-trip or unwind at the end of a day exploring Bangkok, without needing to go far from your hotel. Walk-ins welcome, no appointment necessary. Comfortable rooms across two floors in a calm, professional setting. Proud Thai Massage — authentic technique and honest prices, right outside the Shangri-La.

title: Suvarnaveda Wellness | Ayurvedic Spa in Bangkok
ownerDescription: Suvarnaveda, Ayurvedic Wellness Center Thailand aims at helping right balance of Body, Mind, Spirit and Social Well being. Keeping our visitors heath and well being at core, we have developed some of advanced wellness programs for chronic Aliments like hypertension, Diabetics, Indigestion etc. With a strong team of in house expert therapist and doctors we have helped hundreds of people in Thailand and abroad.
address: 5, 1-3 Soi Sukhumvit 12, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

reviews.name: Veena Sethi
reviews.text: Love your new relocated Ayurvedic center!! Such beautiful calming relaxing healing energy I’m experiencing here. I’ve been going to your old center since 2018 & will surely continue in your new place now. I come for your Ayurvedic therapy to help improve my weak ENT area, my childhood best friend😉. The consistent therapy I receive here continues to be amazing because it helps reduce my intake of allopathic medicines and its side effects. With each visit I make, I receive very precise & incredible feedback from your doctor & that helps me improve my health every single day to a huge extent, alongside the Yoga I do. I also believe that “prevention is better than cure”. Thank you for having your Center in the heart of our busy city. Your center is truly a blessing. I hope many take advantage of what you’re offering. Wishing you all the very BEST in your new center🙏🏼😇🌺🌸🪷🩷
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Veena,

Thank you for your kind words! We are truly glad to be part of your healing journey. At Suvarnaveda, we remain committed to following authentic Ayurvedic practices to support your holistic well-being.

It is our privilege to help you on your path to health and happiness, and we look forward to continuing this journey with you.

With Gratitude,
The Suvarnaveda Team

reviews.name: Silje Cook Fischer-Jørgensen
reviews.text:
This place fortunately crossed my path in life when I needed it the most, and I am deeply thankful.
I had just spent six months working intensely on myself, bouncing back from a rough patch in life. After driving myself hard, I felt I needed guidance in integrating back into normal life – support with diet, routines, and releasing the tightness in my body after long periods of intensity.

The doctor offered very generous and insightful conversations with me over several days, following up closely, guiding me, and helping me gain a deeper understanding of my own state of being.

I was prescribed an oil and heat treatment over four days, where I gradually and gently landed back in my own body. Session by session, with the amazing and professional therapists taking such good care of me, I felt more and more at ease. I truly felt in safe hands and deeply cared for.

I wholeheartedly recommend this establishment to anyone who finds themselves in need of realignment, nourishment, and gentle guidance back to their own self.

Namaskaram,
Sincerely,
Silje Maria

Regarding the massage, our therapies adhere to the principles of Ayurvedic therapeutic techniques. Strokes, pressure, and duration are carefully planned according to individual health requirements, ensuring a personalized and holistic experience.

reviews.name: Dan Pieloch
reviews.text:
I visited before noon on 8 July. I intended to visit a competitor, but when I walked past this place, three attractive ladies waved to me to come inside. I asked do they accept American Express, and one lady said yes. They handed me a treatment card, and I chose body scrub with aromatherapy oil body massage for 1.5 hrs for 1000 Baht.

My masseuse Amy (or Ainy) took great care of me. She is thin and light, so I thought it would be a gentle massage. I was wrong. She put her frame into it and, while I wouldn't call it the firmest massage ever, it was not light, so it was a good fit for me. The scrub that came first was brisk, and honestly my skin is more soft than I'm comfortable admitting.

After the scrub, Amy told me to hit the showers, which was inside our private room on the third floor. The massage table had a face hole, but had a fitted sheet over it. So I was provided a pillow instead, which was acceptable but not optimal. Also, the AC in my room was off and it was hot when I first got there. But once I got oil all over me, I was cold just from the fan, even covered with a towel. There was no aggressive upselling and I left there with no stress once the service was completed.

Back downstairs I learned they do NOT accept Amex, but will take Visa for a 3% fee. Overall I had an excellent experience, and I'd be happy to return.

When I told her she was disrespectful by being on her phone, she just went to the front door to wait for me to leave.

The irony is that there is a sign on the wall asking for silence. But they are all very noisy. Masseuse in other massage shops make a very conscious effort to speak in hushed tones, and even remind customers to be quiet. Not here. So it’s very disturbing.

I returned for another session as the masseuse was so good before. But this time, it was another one and the sports massage was not good at all. Strength, pressure, consistency in strokes & technique was very poor. Coupled with the noise again, I cannot recommend this place on the Soi.

reviews.text:
A Wonderful Pampering Experience at Chalong Thai Massage – Great Service, Amazing Results and Excellent Value! 💆‍♀️💅🦶(If you don’t mind whispers and their funny chats)

I had the 2.5-hour Whole Body Restoration package, and what an amazing experience it was! I ended up extending my pampering time to around 5 hours or even more because I decided to treat myself to extra services. 😂 My poor partner had to wait a few more hours than expected, but I was enjoying myself far too much to rush!

The experience started with a relaxing full-body massage, followed by a 30-minute foot scrub that worked wonders on my stubborn calluses. I was genuinely impressed with how thoroughly the therapist worked on my feet. My feet felt so much smoother afterwards, and I was very happy with the results.

I also had a manicure 💅 and pedicure, which made the whole experience even better. The staff member who looked after me was friendly, attentive and thorough. The service felt personal, and I never felt rushed. She took her time to do a good job, and I left feeling relaxed, refreshed and very satisfied.

I usually prefer Chinese massage back home in Sydney because I have a good one close to home, so I haven’t really been looking for Thai massage there. However, after this experience in Chalong, I have to say that the therapist did a fantastic job! It was a lovely surprise, and I would happily come back again when I visit Chalong in the future.

The pricing is another big plus! The package and additional treatments offer excellent value for money. Honestly, the prices are hard to compare with what we pay back home in Sydney, where appointments can feel a little rushed when everyone is trying to fit into a busy schedule.

Here in Chalong Thai Massage, I felt well looked after and could enjoy my treatments at my own pace. It was wonderful to have the time to relax, take care of myself and enjoy every part of the experience without constantly watching the clock.

If you’re visiting Chalong, Thailand, and looking for an affordable massage, foot scrub, manicure and pedicure with friendly service, I would definitely recommend giving this place a try.

Five stars from me! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great service, a lovely therapist, thorough treatments, happy feet and excellent value for money. I walked in for a few hours of pampering and practically turned it into a full-day spa retreat! 😂 Also reminded me that I left my wallet in the cashier.

Thank you, Chalong Thai Massage, for such a wonderful experience. I’ll definitely keep you in mind for my next visit! ❤️

reviews.text:
We discovered this massage studio by chance while walking to the beach. The woman standing outside had such a warm and welcoming presence that we immediately decided to book a treatment. We chose the coconut massage twice and even spontaneously added a manicure and pedicure.
The massage was the best I’ve had in Thailand so far—and I’ve been here for four months for my semester abroad. Both therapists were incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely caring. Despite being in a touristy area, the prices were no higher than in Kathu.
Highly recommended! If we have enough time, we’ll definitely come back again.

reviews.name: Shya Pinky
reviews.text:
I would like to express my disappointment with the service my friend and I received during our recent visit to your spa. We booked the Aromatherapy Hot Stone package, but the entire session felt like a waste of time and money.

The hot stones were not properly prepared, and the therapist left me multiple times to arrange them, making the session feel disjointed and unprofessional—almost as if she was skipping or slacking. The massage itself was extremely weak and ineffective, more like applying lotion than a real therapeutic massage. The therapist clearly lacked proper skills and professionalism. My friend also experienced the same level of dissatisfaction.

When we arrived, instead of helping us feel relaxed, the staff pressured us to purchase expensive oils. Everyone was talking at once, which created a chaotic atmosphere and left us feeling confused and uncomfortable. Communication was also difficult as most of the staff struggled with English, making it even harder to express our concerns.

To make matters worse, we were promised transportation back to our hotel, but were left behind without any responsibility taken. I had informed the staff that we would briefly stop at a nearby shop to buy food, as our hotel is in a remote area. Despite that, we were abandoned and forced to walk back on our own.

This experience was highly disappointing and not worth the price paid. I would not recommend your spa, especially due to the lack of skilled therapists and poor customer service. Your team needs further training and research to meet basic spa service standards.

I hope you will take this feedback seriously and improve your services accordingly.

reviews.textTranslated:
Koreans are good at massages, but absolutely do not get a pedicure from them! My husband got a massage, and I got a pedicure.

I showed them the Kitty design on the left, and they said they could do it, but... this is the result.

I couldn't tell if the tools were sterilized; they just brought it in a basket, and during the basic care, they pretended not to notice even when I bled.

Ow! I screamed, and they just said "Sorry~" and that was it.

• I asked about the gel color before they started (since I couldn't see the equipment).

• The silver color was too dark, so I tried to say "Gemini" indirectly, but they said it was magnetic gel and the color varies depending on the direction.

Just because I mentioned it twice, they started badmouthing me and their colleague?

They also got the Kitty's eyes and nose positioned wrong, so when I asked them to redo it, they got angry. I wasted my money and time, and they completely ruined my mood on the first day of my trip.

I should have just said it was fine when they wiped off the Kitty face once, even though I should have paid the full 35,000 won.

I wanted an apology and a refund, but we couldn't communicate.

It's my fault for not being able to speak Thai.

And to make matters worse, this is the level of work they drew by looking at a reference.

I ended up with a bruised toenail... I am writing this with the intention of saving a fellow Korean. Seriously, don't do this!!!!

reviews.name: Moe Ashor
reviews.text:
I have to admit, I was genuinely impressed by the decor and overall atmosphere of the place. The design was beautiful, and the vibe immediately set high expectations for a relaxing experience. My wife and I each booked a two-hour session — she chose a facial and hand & head treatment, while I opted for a Thai massage.

Unfortunately, the therapists assigned to us were completely unprofessional. Throughout the session, both were talking and laughing, which completely disrupted what should have been a calm and peaceful environment. About 15 minutes into my massage, I noticed my therapist was using an excessive amount of oil and applying almost no pressure, despite my repeated requests for more. To make matters worse, I realized she was actually texting on her phone while pretending to massage me — I could feel her forearms resting on me while her hands were clearly elsewhere.

At that point, I decided to end the session early. When I went downstairs to report the issue, the front desk attendant appeared more annoyed by my complaint than concerned about the unprofessional behavior. She simply asked if I wanted a new therapist or a refund — no apology, no acknowledgment, nothing that suggested genuine customer care.

It’s a shame because the facility itself is stunning — from the lobby to the treatment rooms, the design is truly exceptional. However, the lack of professionalism and poor customer service completely ruined what could have been a wonderful experience.

reviews.text:
Overall, a nice experience. I had the Aloe sunburn massage, and my wife chose the Thai plus neck & shoulder combo. The treatments themselves were great, and we both felt real relief. However, like other reviewers, the therapists talked and laughed quite a bit during the session, which made it less relaxing than it could have been. We shared a few laughs ourselves when our backs and hips cracked, but a calmer atmosphere would have made the experience even better.

Prices were fair and competitive, and the interior was clean and pleasant. The hostess's interaction was a bit confusing at first—she initially said there was no room, but when I asked if we could sit inside, she said yes. We returned the next night for a back, neck, and foot massage and were mostly satisfied again. The pressure was good, and we felt relief, though oddly, my wife’s back massage only covered about half of her back. When we asked, they explained it was due to the shorter session (30 minutes feet, 30 minutes back). This is why im giving 4 stars.

reviews.name: Phoebe
reviews.text:
2 hour package 650
baht (1h foot massage + 1h back & shoulder massage). Very clean facilities and clean toilets in a large shop. Serene environment with a dedicated foot massage room at the back (g/f) and the massage tables are on 1/f. Great prices with lots of massage package options for the relaxing environment you get to have it done in. My masseuse was very skilled in releasing all the tension and knots from my back, shoulders and neck. Worth visiting!

reviews.name: Cookie Dave
reviews.text:
Firstly, I can’t understand the negative reviews.
The prices were good for this place, the ladies outside were lovely and friendly.
I had a Thai massage, the first one of our holiday which was excellent.
My wife had her nails done on a separate day and a foot massage which she loved again in a good price. And she recommended plc to other folk in hotel.
Highly recommend this place. And competitive pricing.

reviews.name: charlotte longstaff
reviews.text: Amazing experience I loved this spa and the staff. The atmosphere is perfects and the price is really good. Staff is well trained and good at what they do. It’s always busy because it’s great! Shout out to the lady who did my nails 💕

reviews.name: Gina Brink
reviews.text: Terrible experience after asking for pressure on a foot massage I was told no it’s for relaxing. Then I asked just a little more please it’s very soft and she pushed so hard on my leg I’m sure going to be bruised! Do NOT recommend, such a rude therapist! What a shame as the place is beautiful!

reviews.name: sky ming
reviews.text:
Very bad experience. I felt bad from the moment masseur washed my feet, she did not wash or dry my foot clean. I chose a foot massage and asked the masseur to press harder twice,  but I was told that I had to pay extra. They said the money I paid was only enough for 'relax'. I just felt my feet were touched for an hour and I didn't feel comfortable at all.
300 baht  for 1 hour foot massage is a common price in Phuket. I don't know why the masseur asked for extra money to press harder. The key is after having tried many times foot massage in Phuket , it's not about money or pressure, It's just not comfortable.

reviews.name: Hannah Vale
reviews.text: Had a good 1hr coconut oil massage, firm pressure she got a few good cracks in too! Super clean, white space and heaps of staff and treatment rooms so i cant imagine youd have to wait long. I came late morning and walked straight in. I also had a mani pedi with a foot scrub. Note they dont do nail art (lady was super sweet and tried for me but didnt really work). Be sure to specify foot scrub though because otherwise i dont think you get the full pedicure you expect. Amazing scrub though- podiatrist quality. Such good attention to detail on the nails and good quality polish, great gel range (not so big normal colour range fyi). Honestly dont understand the negative reviews here - have you people never had your nails done at a classic salon? Not sure what your nail salons are like but maybe you would prefer the 5000baht+ you'd pay at the luxury resorts instead. Youre in Thailand and this is pretty good.

reviews.name: Cris
reviews.text: Find another place. The place looks great. Went twice. The first time was pretty good so we went back the following day. Different ladies. They were rude and uncaring and kept laughing and speaking in Thai. Not exactly ideal for a good massage. I was glad when it was over. I informed the young lady at reception who only seems to be there because she can speak some English. She said sorry then went back to her phone waiting for the next mugs to walk in and waste their money. I get an employee can let a whole place down, but if the receptions had care I would have chalked it to a bad one off. Go to a smaller place that needs customers more than a large franchise.

reviews.name: Jack Tran
reviews.text:
This was hands down the worst experience of my Phuket trip. I wanted to treat myself to an authentic Thai massage and was ready to book the best combo package, not looking for anything cheap. I showed up at 10 AM, full of excitement, only to be greeted by staff with an attitude so rude it killed the mood instantly. I had no choice but to walk away.
Maybe the staff had just broken up with their boyfriend - who knows - but taking it out on paying customers is a terrible business strategy.
During my trip, I visited countless restaurants, cafés, and tourist attractions around Phuket, and everywhere else the people were warm, welcoming, and kind. This place was the one ugly exception.
If you want your trip to be filled with good memories of Thai hospitality, do yourself a favor: skip this place.

reviews.name: Áine O Neill
reviews.text: Wonderful lady completed my pedicure she took her time and was diligent. After a significant wait with fans the paint didn't dry. Looks terrible quality dissapointed.

reviews.name: Ben Burnley
reviews.text:
Both me and my partner had a foot massage and Thai massage combo for 400 baht.

The place itself is the nicest we have seen in Phuket feels like a spa.

The foot massage was great and relaxing.

The Thai massage was unbelievable. Felt like a brand new man

Highly recommend

reviews.name: Brandon
reviews.text: Would give 0 stars, but they are some nice ladies here. The Thai economy is bad so make sure you pick and plan your massage and then pay. Do not let them talk you into adding or changing anything once you walk upstairs or into the massage chair area. The foot massages were fantastic, but as I said the Thai economy is not what it was. They will do anything for extra money even if it means sacrificing their tips. Thank you to the ladies who work there and did great. This is not about you 🙏

reviews.name: Melissa Ortiz Aranguren
reviews.text: Poor experience for manicure and pedicure. Sam, the manicurist, had a very bad attitude. I clearly asked her not to cut the cuticles but she did it anyway and ended up cutting me, causing many wounds and burning sensation when she applied a liquid (simple things that turned into paintful experience). This was supposed to be a relaxing time, not a hurting one

reviews.name: Mayjun Ong
reviews.text:
Very bad experience. They didn’t wash or scrub my feet properly.
When I asked the masseur to massage harder because I couldn’t feel anything (it felt like she was just lightly touching my feet), she said, “This is relax.” If I wanted it stronger, I would need to pay an extra 500 baht.
I didn’t like the overall massage or their attitude.

reviews.name: Emilie Plesset
reviews.text: Don’t go here. During my gel removal the nail technician filed two of my nails down so much that they hurt and had red patches. I had to ask her multiple times not to thin out my nails so much. I’ve never had a technician file at my nails so aggressively. I stopped service and asked to be refunded for the manicure I initially paid for, then went straight to the pharmacy to purchase antibacterial lotion.

reviews.name: Prakhar Jain
reviews.text: Went there with my wife for foot massage, thai massage and facial. Very neat and clean establishment, appears to be newly built. Good professional service. Both of us liked it.Prices are also reasonable 👏

reviews.name: H Krieg
reviews.text: Had a great full body massage up stairs in private. Excellent facility

reviews.name: Amy Ross-Hodges
reviews.text: Great spa and massage place! I had three visits, got my nails done the first time and they are still going great and then two massages and they were great! Would definitely go back again on my next visit!

reviews.name: Malinee Panpum
reviews.text: I recommend using the service here because my daughter really likes Thai massage. There are clothes to change into after the massage. The staff serves hot water and snacks. It's very good and not too expensive. There are masseuses on duty until late at night. From what I've seen in the reviews, everything was good. I highly recommend it. My daughter and my family really like it.

reviews.name: Lucie Suchá
reviews.text:
I received friendly assistance in choosing a massage tailored to my needs. I mainly wanted to relax, and that's exactly what happened. The place is clean, traditional, and has transparent prices.
The owner and staff are very nice, and there's no need to feel shy. All the products used were pleasant.

reviews.name: echo lei
reviews.text: As soon as I walked in, there was a strong smell of stinky feet—maybe it's because of poor ventilation. At Thai massage, the massage felt the same whether they pressed or not; both the technique and the pressure were not good.

reviews.name: Kimfoong Phanphoom
reviews.text: I went in for a Thai massage and I explained my back pain to the staff and they recommended a neck and shoulder massage. After I received the neck and shoulder massage, I felt that the pain was much better. Please ask the staff before the massage to get the massage that is right on point as desired. I highly recommend this place, it is excellent.

reviews.name: Bassam Bandak
reviews.text: The worst massage I  ever had in Thailand. The masseuse didn't have any skill or proper training. She was all over the place without any structure. I don't recommend at all and it was more expensive than other more professional places.

reviews.name: มินตรา ปานพุ่ม
reviews.text: I visited a hotel in this area and I used the massage service at this shop. I was very impressed because the shop smelled good and was very clean. The staff provided good service and were all lovely. I recommend that you all come to use the service here at least once and the price is very cheap.

reviews.name: Caitlin Taylor
reviews.text: I had my nails done here. She did a Russian manicure, very neat and clean job. Better than the nail salons in Australia. Super cheap for a Russian manicure.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you. I am happy that you have come to use our shop’s services and thank you for the good review. Thank you for meeting us again ❤️

reviews.name: นคฤกษ์ ละงู
reviews.text: Good service, cheap price, recommended. We came late at night, but the staff is still waiting for good service.

reviews.name: Karoline Eide
reviews.text: Good service, clean, cheap price, recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for using our massage shop and thank you for your review. We will try our best and welcome you back again ❤️🙏

reviews.name: Kritsada Talom
reviews.text: Good massage

reviews.name: Lksk Js
reviews.text: Very good , massger so power ,feel good

reviews.name: Celia Yang
reviews.text: 特别棒的按摩店，按摩师的力度刚刚好，非常专业。一个小时的泰式按摩只需要300🐷，非常推荐大家来！按摩结束之后还有茶和电信。整个泰国旅行中性价比最高的按摩店。连续两天我都过来按摩，晚上睡得很好，脸浮肿的情况也得到改善，第二天非常上相hh。点赞我的按摩师Prapai moric 小姐，她是非常好的人。另：她们可以说一点点🤏中文。按摩需要现金
reviews.textTranslated: A fantastic massage parlor! The masseuses had just the right amount of pressure and were very professional. A one-hour Thai massage only costs 300 baht 🐷, highly recommended! They even offer tea and phone service after the massage. The best value massage parlor I visited during my entire trip to Thailand. I had massages there two days in a row, slept very well that night, and my facial puffiness improved; I looked great in photos the next day! Thumbs up to my masseuse, Ms. Prapai Moric, she's such a wonderful person. Also: they speak a little bit of Chinese 🤏. Cash is required for the massage.

reviews.name: Victoria Elsner
reviews.text:
Sehr gute Massage! Sauberer Laden. Hier kann man auch Haare und Nägel machen.
Sie benutzen ein Cocos Öl welches sehr angehen riecht! Ich hatte eine Fußmassage und dazu wurden auch die Arme+ Hände und der Nacken massiert - scheint normal zu sein in Thailand. Kann ich nur empfehlen 👍🏼😊
reviews.textTranslated:
Excellent massage! Clean shop. They also offer hair and nail services.

They use a coconut oil that smells wonderful! I had a foot massage, and they also massaged my arms, hands, and neck – seems to be standard practice in Thailand. I highly recommend it! 👍🏼😊

reviews.name: Chanti
reviews.text: Wir waren zu zweit dort, haben extra gefragt ob wir parallel massiert werden können (Fußmassage), dies wurde bejaht. Leider wirkte die eine Mitarbeiterin als würde sie eigentlich nicht massieren. Sie wirkte extrem lustlos und zudem war die Massage nur streicheln und wirklich GAR KEINE Massage, nur Öl verstrichen. Die Massage bei meinem Partner war sehr gut, klassische Thai Fußmassage diese Masseurin (ältere Dame) war sehr freundlich und wirkte motiviert.
reviews.textTranslated: We were there as a couple and specifically asked if we could both have simultaneous massages (foot massages), which was confirmed. Unfortunately, one of the staff members seemed like she didn't actually give massages. She appeared extremely unenthusiastic, and the massage consisted of nothing more than stroking and really no massage at all – just oil being applied. My partner's massage, however, was very good; it was a classic Thai foot massage. This masseuse (an older lady) was very friendly and seemed motivated.

reviews.name: Derya Özcan
reviews.text: Tolle Massage. Kann ich nur empfehlen. Bisher die beste die ich in Thailand hatte. Danke an das liebe Team.
reviews.textTranslated: Great massage. I highly recommend it. So far, the best I've had in Thailand. Thanks to the lovely team.

reviews.name: Régine Raymond
reviews.text: Nous avons fait 1 thai massage et ensuite un foot massage. Très bonne expérience!
reviews.textTranslated: We had a Thai massage followed by a foot massage. A very good experience!

reviews.name: Wojciech Stegna
reviews.text:
Jesteśmy w Tailandi 3 raz i byliśmy na wielu masażach ,ale tu wymasowano nas na prawdę dobrze i profesjonalnie.
Jest czysto,kameralnie,obsługa bardzo miła polecamy w 100%
reviews.textTranslated: This is our third time in Thailand and we've had many massages, but here we had a truly good and professional massage. It's clean, intimate, and the service is very friendly. We recommend it 100%.

reviews.name: Rowena Kirchberger
reviews.text: Gute und professionelle Thai Öl Massage erhalten, die Damen sind sehr freundlich und es gab danach noch ein kaltes Wasser, top!
reviews.textTranslated: I received a good and professional Thai oil massage; the ladies were very friendly and afterwards they even offered me some cold water – excellent!

reviews.name: MdM “Frodo” Y
reviews.text: Mi esposa y mi prima quedaron encantados con el trabajo de las chicas. Nos atendieron bastante tarda y aún así no tuvieron problemas en quedarse hacer el trabajo. Muy agradecido
reviews.textTranslated: My wife and cousin were delighted with the girls' work. They arrived quite late and still had no problem staying to finish the job. Very grateful.

reviews.name: Maxo Indies
reviews.text: Très belles endroits les masseuses très gentille et agréable professionnelle
reviews.textTranslated: Beautiful place, the masseuses are very kind, pleasant, and professional.

address: 554 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

reviews.name: Hanwen Mi
reviews.text: very good muay thai training center! The coaches here are very kind. Also the price is very reasonable, probably the best in Bangkok, highly recommend to come here for a free try!

reviews.name: PAWz Jong
reviews.text: If you want to do boxing,this place is available daily for 9.00-21.00 . reasonable price and many courses of activities. Training and Pilates also

reviews.name: M Lee
reviews.text:
Better attend to the group class.

Even that the private class is 900-1,000 thb/class, quality of training is depends on trainer.

reviews.name: Kyle Noble
reviews.text: Great facility and staff.

reviews.name: Chayanis Chimin
reviews.text: ได้มีโอกาศไปทดลองเล่นพีลาทิสมาค่ะ ผู้สอนน่ารัก อารมณ์ดีใจเย็น สถานที่ก็ไม่ได้ใหญ่มาค่อนข้างเล็ก มีสอนมวย มีเล่นเวท อยู่ชั้นสอง เมเจอร์ปิ่นเกล้า คลาสพีราทิสพร้อมเทรนเนอร์จะอยู่ที่ประมาณ 1100-1500บาทต่อครั้ง ครั้งละ 1ชั่วโมง ราคาขึ้นอยู่ว่าจะซื้อครอสสั้น หรือยาวค่ะ เผื่อใครสนใจก็ลองสอบถามหรือไปลองเล่นดูกันค่ะ ยิมเล็กๆ
reviews.textTranslated: I had the chance to try Pilates there. The instructor was lovely, cheerful, and patient. The place isn't very big, quite small actually. They also offer boxing classes and weight training. It's located on the second floor of Major Pinklao. A Pilates class with a trainer costs around 1100-1500 baht per session, which is one hour long. The price depends on whether you buy a short or long-term course. If anyone is interested, you can try inquiring or giving it a try. It's a small gym.

reviews.name: NC
reviews.text: เมื่อวานไปทดลองมวยมา1ชั่วโมง กับครูอักษรย่อ ธ ส่วนตัวคิดว่าครูโดนตัวเยอะเกินไปค่ะ ตั้งแต่เริ่มยืด ถึงแม้ว่าครูจะบอกว่า โดนตัวนิดนึงนะครับ แต่ส่วนตัวคิดว่าโดนเยอะมากๆเลยค่ะ ยกตัวอย่างคือเราเดินลงมาจากลู่วิ่ง ครูก็เอามือมาโดนหลังเหมือนโอบ ซึ่งตอนนั้นเราเริ่มไม่โอเคแล้วแฟนเป็นโค้ชมวยเหมือนกันที่อยู่สิงค์โปรทเขาบอกว่า เขาไม่เคยโดนตัวลูกเทรนเลย เลยคิดว่าอันนี้รู้สึกไม่สบายใจเท่าไหร่คะ แล้วก็มีสตาฟผู้ชายอีกคนถามเราว่า มาคนเดียวหรอคับ เราตอบว่า ใช่ค่ะ ก็เหมือนแซวๆ พอจบเทรนครูก็โน้มน้าวขายคอร์สส่วนตัว
reviews.textTranslated: Yesterday, I had a one-hour boxing trial with an instructor whose initials are Th. Personally, I felt the instructor touched me too much. It started from the stretching session. Even though he said, "Just a little touch," I felt it was excessive. For example, as I was walking off the treadmill, he put his hand on my back like he was putting his arm around me. At that point, I started to feel uncomfortable. My boyfriend, who's also a boxing coach in Singapore, said he never touches his clients like that, so I felt uneasy about this. Another male staff member also asked me if I was alone, and I said yes, in a playful way. After the training, the instructor tried to sell me a private training course.

reviews.name: Aurirat Thongpot
reviews.text: คลาสมวยตอนเย็นคนเยอะสนุกดีค่ะ บรรยากาศครึกครื้นครูมวยก็สอนดี
reviews.textTranslated: The evening boxing class is fun because there are a lot of people. The atmosphere is lively, and the boxing instructor is good.

reviews.name: Gunya Najaingam
reviews.text: จะจับตัวขออนุญาตก่อนก็ดีค่ะ ส่วนตัวไม่ประทับใจไม่ซ้ำ
reviews.textTranslated: It would be better to ask for permission beforehand. Personally, I wasn't impressed and wouldn't repeat the experience.

reviews.name: Pichsinee Jaroen-a-riyakul
reviews.text: ยิมมีพื้นที่โปร่งโล่งสบายตาดีมากค่ะ มวยสนุก พิลาทิสก็มี โดยรวมดีมากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The gym has a very spacious and comfortable area. Boxing is fun, and they also have Pilates. Overall, it's great.

reviews.name: Pathomporn ChanCharoen
reviews.text: สะดวกดีครับ พื้นที่ดูกว้างขวาง มีทั้ง โซนยิมเล็กๆ มวย และ พิลาทิส แบบall in one
reviews.textTranslated: It's convenient and the area seems spacious. It has a small gym, boxing, and Pilates area – an all-in-one facility.

reviews.name: เพชร รื่นบุตร
reviews.text:
ยินดีต้อนรับ สายลุย สายระเบิดพลัง  นะครับ
เจอกันได้ที่ เมเจอร์ปิ่นเกล้า ชั้น2นะครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
Welcome, adventure seekers and power-packed types!
See you at Major Pinklao, 2nd floor.

reviews.name: Petrea K. Petrea K.
reviews.text: ยิมมีทั้งมวยและพิลาทิส มวยเสร็จ ยืดพิลาทิสต่อได้เลย สะดวกดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The gym offers both boxing and Pilates. You can do boxing first, then stretch and do Pilates right away. Very convenient.

reviews.name: jckmillxr
reviews.text: Hard sell มาก บอกไม่เอา ให้ฟังก่อน ละไปเอาผู้จัดการมานั่ง ละถามสะดวกชำระยังไงดีครับ
reviews.textTranslated: They were being very pushy. I said no, but they told me to listen first. Then they brought in a manager and asked how I preferred to pay.

reviews.name: Rada Rinrada
reviews.text: ไปลองพิลาทิส ครูสอนดี คนไม่เยอะ ไม่แออัด ติดอย่างเดียว ขายคอร์สหนักมากกกกกกก ปฏิเสธยังไงก็ไม่ยอมให้ออกมาซะที ตอนแรกว่าจะไปซ้ำ เจอแบบนี้ไม่ไปแล้ว อึดอัด
reviews.textTranslated: I went to try Pilates. The instructor was good, and it wasn't crowded. The only downside was the aggressive sales tactics; they wouldn't let me leave no matter how much I refused. I was initially planning to go again, but after that experience, I won't be going back. It was too uncomfortable.

reviews.name: นันธิดา เจริญจิตร
reviews.text: ครูสอนดี ใส่ใจรายละเอียด เป็นกันเอง🥰💕
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher is excellent, attentive to detail, and friendly. 🥰💕

reviews.name: Pang Lee
reviews.text: ครูมวยสอนดี ดูแลดี มากค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The boxing instructor is excellent and provides great care.

reviews.name: Gray'N이한나 (Hanna)
reviews.text: แนะนำ ดีมากเล่นค่ะ น่ารักทุกคนเลย
reviews.textTranslated: I recommend it. It's very good to play. Everyone is cute.

reviews.name: เสือโอ๊ต
reviews.text: สนุกมากครับ
reviews.textTranslated: It was a lot of fun.

reviews.name: นพรุจ เลิศเกริกไกรกุล

title: Classic House Massage
ownerDescription: Classic House Massage has been serving gay Chiang Mai for over five years, offering a variety of massages by a skilled and attractive staff of young men. It provides a friendly, relaxing experience in private, air-conditioned rooms decorated in traditional Thai Lanna style. The menu offers a wide range of massages and treatments, with hot showers included before and after each session to ensure satisfaction. Located on Thapae Road Soi 4, next to Thana Hotel, it's a short walk from Thapae Gate and the Night Bazaar. Open daily from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 11:00 PM, it also features a garden bar for drinks and socializing with staff.
address: 27/2 Thapae Rd Soi 4, Tambon Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand
plusCode: QXPW+J8 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Shawn Patrick
reviews.text:
90 minute massage lasted about 45 minutes, maybe 30 if you take out the shower before and after.

The place was clean. I was offered water and tea after.

When I went, there were only 2 guys to choose between.

reviews.name: Ludwig Wiedemann
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Chiang Mai every year since 2018 and have always been very satisfied with the massages at ART, CHAI, THIW and so on. They also ask in between whether you like the massage. Massages are arranged by appointment, which means that the customer and the masseur decide what happens during the massage time. In the end, it can also be a bit more erotic and lead to a happy ending.
It should be noted, however, that the fee for the massage room is paid at the counter. The masseur's fee is determined as a tip depending on satisfaction and the duration of the massage and is paid directly to the masseur. Depending on the duration, a minimum tip applies, which you are informed of beforehand at the counter. Please be fair, because some of the boys and men make a living from their massage job.
Finally, it should be noted that this is a MANbyMAN massage.

Some statements in other reviews are unfortunately incorrect. Examples: showering at the end of the massage is not included in the massage time, unless the masseur is taken along to shower. There is water at the beginning and very good green tea afterwards.

Day trips can also be booked with the manager Woody in his car. His prices are reasonable. He drives quickly, but is a safe and reliable driver. I have already visited many interesting destinations with him.

reviews.text: This place is absolutely not suitable for anyone. reviews.text: I read quite a lot of comments before I visited this massage shop; both bad and good comments. Personally I always follow "seeing is beliving". As for all this type of massage place in Thailand, always provides good, bad or so so experience; all depends on the boy whom one had chosen. Classic House during afternoon and early evening usually provides over a dozen boys to choose from. I had both chosen from personal taste and owner's recommendation. I have to say, good experience are those times with owner's recommendation. So I would say, don't dismiss this shop just because you have one bad massage from one boy.
